title: 把表妹介绍给大家
material:
Girl: Come in, everyone. This is my cousin. She is staying with us this week.
Boy: Nice to meet you.
Girl: She is in Grade Nine like me, and she plays the guitar very well.

questions.question: What instrument does the girl's cousin play?

title: 邻居帮忙搬箱子
material:
Woman: Excuse me, could you help me carry this box upstairs?
Man: Of course. Where are you taking it?
Woman: To the flat on the fourth floor. My old flat was on the second floor, and my son is away at school this week.
Man: Let me take it. It looks heavy.

questions.question: Which floor is the woman's new flat on?

title: 周末的早餐安排
material:
Man: On weekdays I get up at six and leave home at seven twenty.
Woman: Tomorrow is Saturday. You don't have to leave so early.
Man: You are right. I'll have breakfast with you at eight.

questions.question: What will the man do tomorrow morning?

options.A: Have breakfast with the woman at eight.

title: 请邻居代收快递
material:
Woman: Hello. I am in flat 302. A parcel came for me this morning, but I was out.
Man: I am your neighbour. I have it here.
Woman: Could you leave it at my door? I am home at six.
Man: Sure. I am going up now, so I will put it there.

questions.question: What will the man do with the parcel?

options.A: Take it to the post office.
options.C: Leave it at the woman's door.
options.D: Open it and check the address.

title: 改约看电影的时间
material:
Boy: Shall we go to the film on Saturday afternoon?
Girl: I would love to, but I have to look after my little brother then. Could we go on Sunday morning?
Boy: Sunday morning suits me. Shall we meet outside the cinema at nine in the morning?
Girl: See you there.

questions.question: When will the two friends meet?

title: 送给奶奶的围巾
material:
Girl: This scarf is for you, Grandma. I bought it with my own money.
Woman: How kind of you! But you students should save your money.
Girl: Please accept it. You always help me with my homework.
Woman: All right. Thank you, my dear. I will wear it this winter.

questions.question: When will the woman wear the scarf?

title: 晚餐面条里放什么
material:
Man: I am making noodles for dinner. Would you like some beef in them?
Woman: I am afraid I can't eat beef. Could you make them with vegetables instead?
Man: All right. I have mushrooms and cabbage in the fridge.
Woman: That would be lovely, thank you.

questions.question: What will be in the noodles?

title: 打电话找不在家的家人
material:
Girl: May I speak to Tom, please?
Man: I am sorry, Tom is not here. He has gone to the sports centre with his father.
Girl: Oh. When will he be back?
Man: He said he would be home at half past four.

questions.question: Where is Tom now?

title: 约定下次互相帮忙
material:
Boy: Thanks for helping me clean my room yesterday.
Girl: You are welcome. You helped me with my maths last week.
Boy: Let's help each other from now on.
Girl: Good idea. I am free next Monday, but I am busy this weekend.

questions.question: When will the two students work together again?

title: 请邻居照看金鱼
material:
Woman: Ms. Chen, we are going to our hometown for the Spring Festival. Could you look after my goldfish?
Ms. Chen: Of course. Two fish, an orange one and a white one, right?
Woman: That's right. Please feed them in the morning and in the evening.
Ms. Chen: All right. I'm at home all day, so they won't go hungry.

questions.question: How many goldfish will Ms. Chen look after, and what colour are they?

options.B: One orange goldfish and one white goldfish.

title: 改骑车去公园爬山
material:
Boy: Mr. Wang, shall we still go hiking on Saturday morning?
Mr. Wang: Yes, but the route has changed. This time we start at the north gate at eight.
Boy: Shall we take the bus to the park?
Mr. Wang: The bus doesn't stop at the park. We're going to ride our bikes there.

questions.question: How will they go to the park?

title: 为什么选象棋俱乐部
material:
Ms. Liu: Which club have you chosen this term?
Boy: Yes, the chess club. It meets on Wednesday afternoon.
Ms. Liu: Not the piano club? You have learnt all the songs.
Boy: That's why I chose chess. I've never played it before.
Ms. Liu: Why not join both clubs?
Boy: No, thanks. One club is enough this term.

questions.question: Why does the boy choose the chess club?

options.A: Because he wants to try something new.
options.B: Because the chess club meets on Wednesday afternoon.
options.C: Because the piano club meets on Wednesday afternoon.
options.D: Because he wants to join two clubs this term.

title: 中秋节晚餐的人数
material:
Girl: Ms. Xu, how many people are coming for the Mid-Autumn dinner?
Ms. Xu: Four. My two kids, my mother and you.
Girl: Shall I bring anything?
Ms. Xu: Please bring a small box of moon cakes.
Girl: I'll bring them at six. What time shall we start?
Ms. Xu: At six thirty. You can set the table first.

questions.question: How many people will have the Mid-Autumn dinner with Ms. Xu?

title: 遛狗要用绳子牵着
material:
Boy: My dog runs after every cat. Should I let him run free there?
Mr. Guo: No. Keep him on a rope. If he pulls hard, stop walking for a minute.
Boy: Is the dog park open?
Mr. Guo: Yes, but only on Saturday morning. Let him run with the other dogs there.
Boy: Thanks. I didn't know that.

questions.question: What should the boy do when his dog pulls hard?

options.A: Let him run free in the park.
options.B: Take him to the dog park at once.
options.C: Let him run after the cats.

title: 断了长尾巴的风筝
material:
Woman: The wind is strong. Shall we fly a kite?
Girl: I'd love to, but our kite is broken. Its long tail has come off.
Woman: I've got some tape in my bag. Give the kite to me and I'll fix the tail.
Girl: Thanks. Will the kite fly high?
Woman: Of course. Let's go before ten o'clock.

questions.question: What will the woman do to the kite?

options.A: Fix the tail with some tape.
options.B: Buy a new kite in town.
options.C: Put the kite back in her bag.
options.D: Leave the kite at home and give up the plan.

title: 奶奶喂鸟的照片
material:
Man: Ms. Zhao, congratulations! I heard you won the photo contest.
Ms. Zhao: Thank you. I took the photo in my grandma's garden.
Man: What's in the photo?
Ms. Zhao: My grandma feeding birds. She has done it every morning for ten years.
Man: Ten years! Will you enter again?
Ms. Zhao: I'd like to, but I need a camera.

questions.question: How often does Ms. Zhao's grandma feed the birds?

title: 走失的猫被找到了
material:
Woman: Ms. Tang, have you seen my cat? She got out on Saturday.
Ms. Tang: My son saw a white cat near the market yesterday.
Woman: White? My cat is grey and big.
Ms. Tang: Then a man called me. He found a grey cat near the station.
Woman: Thank you! I'll go and get her at once.

questions.question: What will the woman do after the phone call?

options.A: Ask Ms. Tang's son about the cat near the market.
options.B: Go to the station at once.
options.C: Wait at home until the man calls again.
options.D: Go to the market with Ms. Tang.

title: 元旦的火车班次
material:
Ms. Sun: Tell me about your class party on Friday.
Boy: It was great fun. We played games and sang English songs.
Ms. Sun: Nice! What's your plan for New Year's Day?
Boy: We're going to my grandparents' home in the countryside, by train.
Ms. Sun: You'll have to get up early. The train leaves at six forty.

questions.question: What time does the boy's train leave on New Year's Day?

title: 火山模型缺一包小苏打
material:
Man: Ms. Zhao, what are you making?
Girl: A small volcano model. The show is next Thursday.
Man: Do you have everything?
Girl: Not yet. I can't find the white powder. Ms. Hu said she has some.
Man: She usually has a club after class. Go and ask her before lunch.
Girl: All right. I'll go before lunch today.

questions.question: When will the girl ask Ms. Hu for the white powder?

title: 长跑要怎么练
material:
Woman: My daughter wants to run the 400-metre race on Friday.
Mr. Xu: Has she run 400 metres?
Woman: She runs every morning, never round a track.
Mr. Xu: Then she should run round the school track twice a week.
Woman: She doesn't like the high jump. She wants to run.
Mr. Xu: She can run on Tuesday and Thursday.

questions.question: What does Mr. Xu advise?

options.A: The girl should run round the school track twice a week.
options.B: The girl should run round the school track twice a day.
options.C: The girl should take part in the high jump event.
options.D: The girl should run the 400-metre race on Monday instead of Friday.

title: 生日聚会要加两把椅子
material:
Man: Ms. Li, my son is having a birthday party on Sunday.
Ms. Li: How old is he? How many guests?
Man: He's ten. Six friends are coming, so eight of us in all.
Ms. Li: Do you need more chairs?
Man: Yes, two will be enough. Could you bring them?
Ms. Li: Sure. I'll bring them at ten.

questions.question: How many more chairs does the man need?

title: 音乐俱乐部的吉他课
material:
Girl: I want to learn the guitar. Does your music club teach it?
Ms. Wu: Yes, but only on Friday afternoon. We have six guitars now.
Girl: Is it hard to learn?
Ms. Wu: A little. Most students need three months.
Girl: Three months! My cousin learned in one month.
Ms. Wu: He was lucky. I'll add your name.

questions.question: When can the girl learn the guitar at the music club?

title: 湖边露营带什么
material:
Boy: Ms. Fang, do I need a sleeping bag for camping?
Ms. Fang: Yes. You'll sleep in a tent by the lake on Saturday night.
Boy: What else should I take? A big bag?
Ms. Fang: Take a small one, and bring a warm coat and a bottle of water. You don't need much food for one night.

questions.question: What should the boy take besides the sleeping bag?

options.A: A big bag and a big tent.
options.B: A big bag, a warm coat and a bottle of water.
options.C: A small bag, a warm coat and a bottle of water.
options.D: A small bag, a warm coat and some food for two nights.

title: 楼里能不能养小狗
material:
Boy: Ms. Liu, may I keep a puppy in my flat?
Ms. Liu: You can, but only a small one. Big dogs aren't allowed here.
Boy: Mine is brown, only six months old. Will it grow big?
Ms. Liu: It will. Never let it out of the flat alone.
Boy: I'll take it to the park with my father.

questions.question: What does Ms. Liu advise the boy to do?

options.A: Never let the puppy out of the flat alone.
options.B: Keep a big dog in his flat.
options.C: Take the puppy to the park with his father.
options.D: Let the puppy run in the park by itself.

title: 熬夜后该几点睡
material:
Boy: Ms. Wu, I stayed up until twelve last night. I feel sleepy now.
Ms. Wu: Then how did you get to school?
Boy: My father drove me. I slept in the car on the way.
Ms. Wu: Go to bed at about ten, not at twelve. You left at six.
Boy: I see. Class begins at eight.

questions.question: What time should the boy go to bed?

title: 跑前热身十分钟
material:
Girl: Mr. Liu, can I run on the track right now?
Mr. Liu: Not yet. Do some warm-up exercises first.
Girl: How long should the warm-up last? My friend says three minutes.
Mr. Liu: Run slowly for five minutes, then five minutes of jumping. Ten minutes in all.
Girl: Then I'll run for twenty minutes and stop.

questions.question: How long should the girl warm up before running?

title: 牛奶过期了
material:
Boy: Hi, Ms. Chen. Is there any milk in your fridge?
Ms. Chen: Yes, but look at the date on the milk box. The orange juice is for the picnic.
Boy: The milk says the tenth, and today is the eighteenth.
Ms. Chen: Then you can't drink it. Buy a small box at the shop, not a big bottle.

questions.question: What will the boy do now?

options.B: Buy a big bottle of milk at the shop.
options.C: Drink the milk in Ms. Chen's fridge.
options.D: Buy a small box of milk at the shop.

title: 扭伤膝盖要冰敷
material:
Girl: Mr. Zhao, my knee hurts. I fell off my bike.
Mr. Zhao: Can you walk?
Girl: Slowly. I'd like to go to the gym and swim after school.
Mr. Zhao: No. The gym is closed today, so no swimming. Put ice on it for fifteen minutes and rest at home. See a doctor tomorrow if it still hurts.

questions.question: What will the girl do this evening?

options.A: Go to the gym after school.
options.B: Use ice and rest at home.

title: 接力赛训练安排
material:
Boy: Ms. Wang, where and when shall we train for the relay race?
Ms. Wang: The track is closed for repairs all week. In the gym tomorrow at four.
Boy: What about Wednesday morning? I have no classes then.
Ms. Wang: Good. Meet in the gym at seven in the morning.
Boy: Four tomorrow, then seven on Wednesday. Understood.

questions.question: How will they train on Wednesday?

options.A: In the gym at seven in the morning.
options.B: On the track at four in the afternoon.
options.C: In the gym at four in the afternoon.
options.D: On the track at seven in the morning.

title: 体检先做哪一项
material:
Girl: Ms. Gao, what shall we do at the health check?
Ms. Gao: A blood test first, then an eye test, a tooth check and a height test.
Girl: Shall I eat my breakfast first?
Ms. Gao: No. Come at seven forty. We'll give you bread and an egg after the test.
Girl: All right. Thank you, Ms. Gao.

questions.question: Which test will the students do first?

title: 看手机后护眼
material:
Girl: Hello, Ms. Yuan. My eyes hurt after I finish my homework.
Ms. Yuan: How long do you spend on your homework every evening?
Girl: About two hours. Half an hour of that is looking at my phone.
Ms. Yuan: Look away for a minute every twenty minutes, not every ten. Reading in the car is bad too.

questions.question: How often should the girl look away from her homework?

title: 考前紧张睡不着
material:
Boy: Ms. Yang, I'm so nervous about tomorrow's test that I can't sleep.
Ms. Yang: Don't drink coffee, and don't read in bed.
Boy: I asked my classmates about the test, but I'm still worried.
Ms. Yang: Write your worries on paper, then walk around the room for ten minutes.
Boy: Writing? I never thought of that.

questions.question: What will the boy do to help himself sleep?

options.C: Ask his classmates about the test.
options.D: Write down his worries on paper.

title: 换牙刷挑软毛
material:
Girl: Ms. Shen, my toothbrush is nearly a year old. Should I buy a new one?
Ms. Shen: Yes. Change it every three months. Buy a soft one, not a hard one.
Girl: What about the handle?
Ms. Shen: A big handle is fine. Don't buy a small one.
Girl: OK. A soft brush with a big handle.

questions.question: What will the girl buy?

options.A: A soft brush with a big handle.
options.B: A hard brush with a big handle.
options.C: A soft brush with a small handle.
options.D: A hard brush with a small handle.

title: 早上没时间吃早饭
material:
Boy: Hi, Mr. Guo. I often skip breakfast on school days.
Mr. Guo: When do you leave?
Boy: At seven ten. I sleep until six fifty, then hurry out.
Mr. Guo: Set the clock ten minutes earlier. Milk isn't breakfast, and an apple is only a snack. Have some bread and an egg.

questions.question: What will the boy have for breakfast from now on?

title: 发烧在家休息
material:
Girl: Excuse me, Ms. Xu. I have a fever and a headache.
Ms. Xu: How long have you had the fever?
Girl: Since last night. My friends want to play basketball after school.
Ms. Xu: Then stay home and miss PE class. The school clinic is closed this afternoon, so take your medicine at home after breakfast and rest.

questions.question: What will the girl do this afternoon?

options.B: Go to the PE class at school.
options.C: Take the medicine at the school clinic.
options.D: Stay at home and rest all day.

title: 改在体育馆打球
material:
Girl: Hello, Ms. He. Where shall we play basketball tomorrow?
Ms. He: Not on the playground. It may rain tomorrow.
Girl: The classroom is too small. Is the hall booked?
Ms. He: That's right. Meet in the gym at four, after your PE class.
Girl: Four o'clock. Thank you, Ms. He.

questions.question: Where will they play basketball tomorrow?

title: 跳高赛前先体检
material:
Ms. Kong: The nurse checks your feet at seven on Monday morning, before your high jump on Tuesday.
Boy: My first class starts at eight. Will I be late?
Ms. Kong: No, it is quick. The clinic is busy at nine.
Boy: Shall I bring my student card?
Ms. Kong: Yes, and come to room 12.

questions.question: When will the boy have the health check?

title: 朋友不开心怎么办
material:
Girl: Hi, Mr. Sun. My friend looks unhappy today.
Mr. Sun: Did she lose something or get bad news?
Girl: She got a low mark in the maths test.
Mr. Sun: Don't say "cheer up". Take her for a walk, not to the library. Talk about the test later, when she is ready.

questions.question: What should the girl do now?

options.A: Take her friend for a walk.
options.C: Talk about the maths test with her.
options.D: Go to the library with her.

title: 四百米跑步节奏
material:
Girl: Ms. Pan, in the 400-metre race, should we start fast?
Ms. Pan: No. Start slowly and run fast in the last hundred metres.
Girl: My friend starts fast and gets tired.
Ms. Pan: Practise on Monday and Wednesday. Not on Friday. You'll be tired from the sports meeting on Thursday morning.
Girl: I see. Slow first, then fast.

questions.question: When will they practise for the 400-metre race?

title: 课间借尺
material:
Boy: Ms. Hu, may I use your ruler? Mine is in my bag.
Ms. Hu: Take it. Please give it back before the bell.
Boy: The bell rings at ten. Class Two begins at ten fifteen.
Ms. Hu: All right. You have enough time for the map test.
Boy: Thanks. I'll draw the river on it now.

questions.question: When must the boy give the ruler back?

title: 早餐两杯茶
material:
Mum: Ben, it's Saturday. Get up, or we'll miss the train.
Ben: What time does it leave?
Mum: At seven twenty. I want eggs and toast, not cereal.
Ben: Shall I make some tea?
Mum: Yes, two cups. One is for your father and one for me.

questions.question: Who will drink tea with the breakfast?

title: 买十二元的本子
material:
Boy: Good afternoon, Mr. Sun. I need a notebook for science.
Mr. Sun: We have four, five, twelve and twenty yuan ones.
Boy: My friend buys the four yuan one for every subject.
Mr. Sun: Science notes are printed on thick paper. Take the twelve yuan one.
Boy: All right. Twelve yuan, please.

questions.question: How much will the boy pay?

title: 米饭要炒的
material:
Waiter: Good evening. What would you like to eat?
Girl: I want the chicken and rice, not the beef.
Waiter: How would you like your rice? Fried or boiled?
Girl: Fried, please. Boiled rice is too plain for me.
Waiter: Right. And the chicken — with soup or without?
Girl: Without soup. I'll drink water after.

questions.question: How will the girl have her rice?

title: 周六坐公交
material:
Boy: Excuse me. How can I get to the museum?
Man: Take bus No. 15 and get off at the third stop.
Boy: Is there a train as well?
Man: Yes. It leaves from the north station, but it does not run on Saturdays.
Boy: Saturday. Then I take the bus.

questions.question: How will the boy go to the museum?

title: 周五上午看牙
material:
Boy: Doctor, my tooth hurts, and I love ice cream.
Doctor: I can see a small hole. Come back on Friday morning.
Boy: I have a maths test on Friday afternoon.
Doctor: Take the medicine twice a day. Eat no ice cream until Friday.
Boy: All right. Friday morning, then.

questions.question: When will the boy see the doctor again?

title: 借书两周
material:
Librarian: Can I help you?
Boy: I'd like to borrow that book about the sea.
Librarian: I'm afraid you can't. You can only read it here.
Boy: Then I'll take this one about birds.
Librarian: You may keep it for two weeks. One week is too short, and one month is too long.
Boy: Two weeks. Thank you.

questions.question: How long may the boy keep the book about birds?

title: 平寄五日到
material:
Boy: Hello. I want to send this box to my aunt in Nanjing.
Clerk: It weighs three kilos. Do you want express or post?
Boy: Post, please. I have no express money.
Clerk: Then it will take five days. Express takes one day, the train two days.
Boy: Five days is fine. My aunt's birthday is on Sunday.

questions.question: How long will the box take to reach Nanjing?

title: 周一上午报名
material:
Girl: Mr. Li, how can I join the photography club?
Mr. Li: Bring your camera to Room 6 on Monday morning.
Girl: What time should I come? My lunch is at twelve.
Mr. Li: At nine, before lunch. The room is free then. After nine it is busy.

questions.question: When will the girl come to Room 6?

title: 第几节上地理
material:
Girl: Mr. Fang, which period is our geography lesson today?
Mr. Fang: The fourth, not the third. The third is free study.
Girl: I have music in the fourth then.
Mr. Fang: Music moved to Thursday. Take your geography book.

questions.question: Which period will the class have geography today?

title: 雨伞不要帽子
material:
Boy: Mum, may I wear my new shoes and a hat today?
Mum: It may rain this afternoon. Take an umbrella, not a hat.
Boy: Then what shall I wear? My thick coat?
Mum: No. It's only fifteen degrees. Wear your old shoes, not the new ones.

questions.question: What will the boy take with him?

title: 决赛对手
material:
Boy: Ms. Pei, our class is Class Two. Who do we play against in the final?
Ms. Pei: Class Two against Class Five. The match starts at three on Friday.
Boy: Is it on the big playground?
Ms. Pei: No, the small one. The big one is under repair this week.
Boy: Fine. Friday, then.

questions.question: Who will the boy's class play against in the final?

title: 七月十五夏令营
material:
Girl: Mum, when does the summer camp start?
Mum: On the fifteenth of July, not on the first.
Girl: My cousin goes on the fifth. May I go with him?
Mum: No. You have an exam on the tenth. Then come to the camp on the fifteenth.

questions.question: On which day will the girl go to the summer camp?

title: 周六校门集合
material:
Boy: Ms. Wei, where do the volunteers meet on Saturday?
Ms. Wei: At the school gate at eight. Not at the library or the bus stop.
Boy: What shall we do there?
Ms. Wei: Read to the children in the old people's home. We finish at eleven.

questions.question: Where will the volunteers meet on Saturday?

title: 家长会提前半小时
material:
Teacher: Ms. Li, the parents' meeting is on Tuesday at four. Can you come?
Ms. Li: I work on Tuesday evening. Is there another meeting?
Teacher: No, only one. But you can come at half past three.
Ms. Li: Then I'll come early. Which room?
Teacher: Room 2 on the second floor, not Room 5 on the ground floor.

questions.question: When will the mother go to the parents' meeting?

options.B: On Tuesday at half past three.

title: 顺带买两袋面包
material:
Shop assistant: Good morning. Is that all for the washing powder?
Boy: Yes. Is the milk on sale today?
Shop assistant: No. The milk is eight yuan, and the bread is three.
Boy: I'll take two loaves then. How much is that?
Shop assistant: Six yuan for two, so fourteen yuan in all.

questions.question: How much will the boy pay for the milk and the bread?

title: 裤腿改短三厘米
material:
Girl: Good afternoon. Can you shorten these trousers?
Ms. Zhou: Of course. How much shorter do you want them?
Girl: Three centimetres. My cousin's wedding is on Friday.
Ms. Zhou: Come on Thursday afternoon, and bring white shoes.
Girl: Both? My shoes are white too.
Ms. Zhou: Yes. They'll be ready at four.

questions.question: When will the girl get the trousers?

options.B: On Thursday at four in the afternoon.
options.C: On Friday at four in the afternoon.

title: 请邻居代喂狗
material:
Mrs. Sun: Mr. Xu, I'm away for two days. Can you feed my dog?
Mr. Xu: Of course. How often does he eat?
Mrs. Sun: Twice a day, seven and six. Never at noon.
Mr. Xu: Can I take him out too?
Mrs. Sun: Only round the block. The park is too far.

questions.question: What will Mr. Xu do for Mrs. Sun's dog?

options.A: Feed him three times a day and walk him in the park.
options.B: Feed him once a day and walk him round the block.
options.C: Feed him twice a day and walk him round the block.
options.D: Feed him at noon and take him to the park.

title: 改看六点那场
material:
Boy: Two tickets for the seven o'clock show, please.
Clerk: Sorry, that show is full. We still have the two and the six o'clock show.
Boy: Six o'clock, then. How long does the film last?
Clerk: Two hours and thirty minutes, I'm afraid.
Boy: Good. I can still catch the nine o'clock bus home.

questions.question: At what time will the film end?

title: 约好下午一点半
material:
Guide: Welcome to the zoo. The elephants are fed at half past ten.
Mr. Li: My daughter wants the pandas. When do they eat?
Guide: At nine and at two. The keeper is off today.
Mr. Li: Then we'll come after lunch, at one thirty.
Guide: Right. Meet me at one thirty.

questions.question: When will Mr. Li meet the guide?

options.A: At half past ten in the morning.
options.B: At half past one in the afternoon.
options.C: At two o'clock in the afternoon.
options.D: At nine o'clock in the morning.

title: 钢琴课练到几点
material:
Girl: Mr. Hu, may I begin with the easy piece today?
Mr. Hu: No. Finish the hard one first, for twenty minutes, not ten.
Girl: Then how long will the whole lesson be?
Mr. Hu: Forty minutes. We start at half past three and stop at ten past four.

questions.question: At what time will the lesson end?

title: 带猫去打针
material:
Vet: Is this your cat?

material:

title: 去图书馆的路线
material:
Tom: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the City Library?
Woman: Of course. Go straight along this road and keep going.

Woman: Yes, but turn left at the second set of lights, not the first one.
Tom: I see. And then what should I do?
Woman: You'll see a small park on your right. The library is the white building across it.
Tom: Is there a bus stop nearby? I don't want to be late for my lesson.
Woman: Yes, there's a stop at the corner. Buses number 3 and 12 stop there.

title: 校运会800米
material:
Peter: Lucy, are you going to run the 800 metres in the school sports meeting?
Lucy: I am, but I'm not sure. My leg still hurts from the training.
Peter: How far do you run each day now?
Lucy: About three kilometres, but I train after dinner, and my leg aches in the morning.
Peter: Maybe you should run earlier, before breakfast.
Lucy: My mother says the air is cleaner at that time, too.
Peter: Our coach told me to stop the night training a week before a race. Have you asked him about your leg?
Lucy: I did this morning. He said I should see the school doctor.
Peter: Then go this afternoon. The sports meeting is only three weeks away.
Lucy: All right. If the doctor says I need rest, I'll run the 400 metres instead.
Peter: Better to finish the season safely than to run with a bad leg.

options.B: Because she trains after dinner every day.

options.B: She will give up all the races this term.

options.D: She will train twice as hard every morning.

title: 自做月饼
material:

Mia: But Grandma always says those cakes are too sweet. Last year she only ate one.

Mia: She wants us to make them at home together. She has a good recipe.
Dad: Making them at home? I've never done that before.
Mia: Neither have I, but Grandma says it is easy. We need eggs, sugar, milk and something for the middle.
Dad: That sounds difficult. How long will it take, and can my sister join us?
Mia: About three hours. We can start in the afternoon, and your sister is welcome.
Dad: Then we'll start early. But we only have one big bowl at home.
Mia: Don't worry. We can borrow a big bowl from Uncle Wang on Saturday. He has six in his kitchen.
Dad: Then let's do it. A shop box is nice, but home-made ones taste better.

title: 周六去公园拍照
material:
Chris: Nina, why do you always carry that camera to the park?

Chris: Don't you think a phone is good enough for that?
Nina: I tried that last year, but most of my pictures were too dark.
Chris: How did you learn to use a real camera?
Nina: My aunt taught me. She has been a photographer for ten years.
Chris: What's the best picture you have taken so far?
Nina: One of the birds in a tree. I waited for nearly an hour in the cold.
Chris: It sounds exciting, but doesn't that take a lot of time?
Nina: It does, but I only go there on Saturdays, so it doesn't affect my study.

title: 眼睛不舒服
material:
Kate: Daniel, why are you rubbing your eyes all the time?

Daniel: About two hours, with my phone right beside the book.
Kate: That light is too close. Reading on a screen like that is bad for your eyes.
Daniel: I know, but I always think I can finish the last chapter first.
Kate: You need to see a doctor. My mother used to work in a hospital.
Daniel: Really? She knows an eye doctor, doesn't she?
Kate: Yes, she does. You can go to see him with her on Sunday.
Daniel: That's kind of you. But what about the homework? It's really heavy.
Kate: Tell your teacher. My sister once asked for less homework and got a lighter schedule.
Daniel: All right. I'll talk to her this week, and then see the doctor on Sunday.

Amy: Let's make twenty of them before Wednesday. I can draw the animal pictures.

title: 学校回收项目
material: Last spring, Green Middle School in Suzhou started a project called the "Green Corner". Every Friday afternoon, students stand at the school gate with two big cloth bags. They ask people walking past to put empty bottles and used paper into the bags instead of dropping them on the ground. In the first three months, the students collected 1,240 bottles and 60 kilos of paper. The school sells the paper to a paper factory in the county and sells the bottles to a small recycling shop. The money is not spent on the students themselves. It is used to buy books for the reading room in the school library. Last term the students also wrote letters to younger classes, telling them why throwing rubbish on the street is not a good habit. Now the project has 34 student volunteers, and two primary schools nearby have asked to join it next year. Mr. Wang, who teaches in one of them, says the two schools want their own pupils to learn the same habit. title: 会修旧物的学生
material: Chen Mo is a fourteen-year-old student in Suzhou. Last year his phone fell into a bowl of soup and it never worked again. Instead of asking his parents for a new one, he took the phone to his school's old computer room and started learning how to fix it. Now he spends most Friday afternoons there with three other students. They repair old phones, small radios and toy cars, and they keep a notebook that records every problem and the way they solved it. Last term they fixed ninety-one things for free. Parents in the neighbourhood now come to the room with old radios, and Chen Mo and his friends listen to the problems, open the back cover, and try to find the broken part. Chen Mo says the work is slower than playing games, but it teaches him something games cannot. He has learnt to be patient, because a small screw can take half an hour to open. He also learnt that most broken things are not broken at all; they are simply not cleaned for years. Chen Mo hopes to become an engineer one day.

title: 睡得好，学得好
material: Good sleep is not something middle school students can do without. It is part of school work. During sleep, the body grows and repairs itself, and the brain sorts out everything it has learned during the day. This is why students who sleep nine hours at night usually find it easier to remember new words than students who sleep only six. Many teenagers lose sleep for the same reason: a phone. When the phone is beside the bed, "one more minute" easily becomes forty minutes, and the next morning arrives too early. A short nap of twenty minutes after lunch can help a student feel fresh again, but a long nap of two hours will make it harder to fall asleep at night. Doctors suggest three simple rules for students. First, go to bed and get up at the same time every day, even at weekends. If these times change from day to day, the body never gets used to the daily pattern, and a student can feel sleepy in class even after nine hours in bed. Second, keep the bedroom dark and quiet. Third, put the phone in another room half an hour before bed. Two weeks later, most students find that they need less time to fall asleep. The result is simple: longer sleep and better memory.

title: 社区里的书柜
material: A small wooden bookcase now stands at the entrance of Xinglong Community in Suzhou. It has no door and no glass. Anyone may take a book from it, and anyone may leave a book in it. The bookcase began in March, when Mr. Wu, a retired driver living in Building 3, carried it up from his own home and painted it blue. At first only his family used it. Then a woman on the fourth floor left four books about plants, and a boy from Building 7 left a football story. Today most of the shelves are always full, and readers take a short note and write down their names and the day they finished the book. Books stay about two weeks before they travel to the next reader. Mr. Wu checks the case every evening. If a book has been there for more than a month, he reads it and then pushes it down to the lower shelf, where a reader can still find it and take it to the next one. Last month the community office asked Mr. Wu whether more bookcases could be put up near the small garden. He said he would rather have one good bookcase than four empty ones.

options.B: He wants the community office to pay for more wood.

title: 山坡跑步俱乐部
material: On the last Saturday of every month, about sixty students from three schools in Gusu District meet at the small hill behind Wenyi Park. They are members of the Hill Runners, a running club started four years ago by a sports teacher, Mr. Qian. The club now has 128 members between 12 and 16 years old. Members run the same 2.4-kilometre path every time, but they do not run alone. The club's rule is simple: everyone runs with someone of about the same speed, so that the fastest runner does not leave the slowest behind. The teachers also keep a notebook. After each run, members write their time down, and once a month the fastest times are put on the wall of the park. In May, twelve members ran the path in under twelve minutes and got free entry to the park for a month. Mr. Qian says the notebook matters more than the prizes. "If you write down your time every month, you cannot hide from it. Slowly the number gets smaller, and that is the real prize." Two new clubs in other parts of the city have asked him for his advice this year.

title: 慢旅行
material: Last summer holiday, Zhou Ye, a Grade 9 student from Suzhou, took a slow train to a small town in the north. The journey took about six hours, and the train stopped nine times on the way. His friends laughed at him for choosing a slow train when a fast one was available. Yet by the time the train reached the town, he had already seen everything worth seeing: long fields beside the rails, small houses with grey roofs, and a river that turned silver in the afternoon sun. Zhou Ye now says slow travel suits students. It costs less, it lets you sleep in a real bed in a small hotel instead of a train bed, and it gives the body time to slow down. He also believes the best part of a journey is the walk before the first visit. When he got off the train, he walked for twenty minutes along the river before he looked for food. His advice for other students is simple: take one slow trip this year, and take a notebook with you. Photos show what you saw, but notes show what you thought.

title: 怎样买得聪明
material: Shopping well is not about spending less money. It is about getting what you really need. The first rule is to write a list before you leave home, and to keep the list in your pocket. Most unplanned things in a shopping bag were bought without a need. The second rule is to look at the price per hundred grams instead of the price on the front of the packet. A packet of washing powder at a lower price often holds less powder, so it is not cheaper. The third rule is to wait one day before buying clothes. Clothes are the easiest things to buy too many of, and a coat bought in a hurry is often a coat that is never worn again. Shop assistants can also help. If you tell them how much you want to spend, they can show you the smaller and cheaper size, or a product with almost the same quality. Some shops offer a cheaper box of the same brand, and old things in good condition can be a good choice if you look at them carefully. Wise shoppers are not people who never buy anything; they are people who know why they are buying it.

options.A: You should buy food only at the end of the day.
options.B: You should write a list before leaving home.

title: 一家人的年夜饭
material: On New Year's Eve, the kitchen of Longhua Community was open from early afternoon. Twelve families came together to cook one dish each, and by six in the evening the long tables in the square were full. The idea began three years ago, when a few older neighbours found that some families ate alone on that night because their children worked far away. One family brought a big pot, another brought a table, and by dinner time everything was shared. This year the oldest cook was eighty-one years old and the youngest helper was six. Each family also wrote its dish name on a paper card and put the card beside the bowl, so guests could try a little of everything. After dinner, nobody washed up alone. People cleaned the tables together, put the bowls away, and swept the square. The twelve families have kept the plan for three years, and this year eight more families asked to join. Two neighbours said they will bring the recipe cards, so that next year the young cooks can make the same dishes themselves.

options.C: One dish they had cooked themselves.

options.B: The kitchen in the square was too small.
options.C: The community office asked families to join.

title: 上山的两个小时
material: When Gao Wei was a university student, his first trip into the forest ended badly. He wanted to know why a small white plant grew well on a hill but died in the valley below it. He collected plants from both places and put them in the same pot at home. Within a week the valley plants were dead, and so were the hill plants. He felt sorry for himself and nearly gave up. Then his teacher took him back to the hill, and the climb took them two hours. When they arrived, Gao Wei noticed something he had missed before: the air on the hill was much colder, and water came out of the rocks all year round, while the valley was hot and dry in summer. He understood at last that nothing had gone wrong in his own work; the plant needed cool air and clean water, and a pot in a room could give it neither. Gao Wei has studied this one plant for twenty-six years since then. His team knows that only about four hundred plants like it are still alive, and every spring they climb up and count them. The number is always smaller. He says the work is slow and often disappointing, but every spring he goes up the hill again.

title: 河边的第二个学年
material: Mei Lin is seventeen years old and goes to a middle school in a small town. She began running when she was eleven, and the reason was practical: her school is six kilometres from her home, and no bus went there. She ran the way to school every morning, in the rain and in the snow. At fourteen she joined the county running team, where she was the shortest and her results were ordinary, so her coach did not give her much attention. In her second year at school she started to run beside the river after dinner, one hour, five evenings a week. She was hard on herself and kept a small notebook: the date, the distance and how she felt. She still keeps it today. Last autumn she ran her first half-marathon and finished in under two hours. This spring she won a place on the city team. Her coach now says the notebook was the best thing in her training, but Mei Lin does not agree with him. She says the notebook did not make her fast; it only made her honest about what she could and could not do on each day.

title: 剪纸的邻居
material: I live next door to Tan Bo, and for four years I have watched him cut paper. Last autumn he handed me the scissors. Tan Bo is sixty-eight. He began when he was ten, the winter his grandfather died. His family had no money for paper, so he drew his first birds on old newspapers, following the black lines of the sports page as branches. Later the paper factory in the town gave away its waste paper every Spring Festival, and he had white paper of his own. He has cut more than six hundred designs in his life. Many show animals and plants, but he says the paper in his village is full of rivers and bridges, so bridges are what he cuts most often. A few years ago a young designer asked why none of his work had people in it. Tan Bo was quiet for a long time. Then he said a face is the difficult part; if the eyes are wrong, the whole thing looks like a mask. Since then he has cut three windows with people in them, and he keeps a paper face to check the eyes. He says that in a village paper is not decoration. It is what a family puts on a window and looks at every day.

title: 药瓶上的小画
material: Zhou Meilan has worked as a nurse in a small community clinic for eleven years. The clinic has three doctors and four nurses, and she likes the place because everyone there knows her name. In her first years she was afraid of the older patients, who often came in with angry faces and said very little. One winter evening an old man came in, put a small paper bag on the desk and walked out without a word. Inside the bag were three medicine boxes he had never opened. Zhou Meilan ran after him into the snow and asked what was wrong. He said he could not read the instructions on the boxes, so for months he had put the boxes away and never taken the medicine at all. That night she began to draw a small picture of how to take the medicine on the label of every bottle she handed out, and to ask each patient to repeat the instructions back to her before leaving. She also learnt to speak more slowly and to wait for an answer, because she noticed that old people often said yes too quickly. Zhou Meilan says a picture is understood by everybody, but handwriting is not.

title: 每周五的信
material: Xu Lan has walked the same road for sixteen years. Every morning at seven she takes forty-three letters and goes up to Green Stone Village, four kilometres from the post office. Her daily walk has never been easy: in winter the path is covered with ice, and in summer the river rises so high that she must wait for the water to go down. Still, she knows every family on the road. Seven years ago an old man asked her a favour. He wanted to write to his son far away, but his hands shook too much to hold a pen. Xu Lan bought a writing pad and began to write his letters for him. Since then she has gone to his door every Friday for seven years. She says the letters are always short, but she has learnt to ask the right questions, because a letter that says only hello makes people worry. Last year the old man's son came back for two weeks to visit him. Now the letters are coming back unopened, and Xu Lan is waiting.

title: 会走的水
material: A tap in the school toilets had been dripping for months, and nobody knew. Last March, four students in Class Three asked to see the school's water meter. They came in early every morning, read the number, and wrote it down. When they compared their first reading with the number their science teacher had copied in January, the gap was far larger than any change they had seen before. One student worked out that a tap dripping once a second loses about thirty litres a day. In three months that is close to two thousand seven hundred litres, enough to fill more than twenty small bathtubs. The four students asked to see the manager, and they walked with him to the toilets. He heard the sound himself, and the old tap was taken out and a new one fitted the next day. The class went on reading the meter for one more month. The number rose by only about the same amount as in an ordinary month, and the students put a short report on the classroom wall. Before winter came, they also checked every other tap in the building.

title: 楼下的红箱子
material: Every Wednesday an old man walks slowly around the block with two cloth bags. He has done this for six years, and the bags are for the wrong things he takes out of the box. People should not put used batteries, old medicine or broken lamps in the normal rubbish bin. The city has put a small red box at the corner of the block, and anyone can drop these things there free of charge. The box is often full by the end of the week, and the city weighs the whole box and tells him the number. He writes the number in a book, and a sudden rise in it makes him check the box for something wrong. His record for one week is a hundred and eighty kilograms, while in his first year it was less than fifty. He says this is the most useful thing he has ever done, not because the numbers are important, but because many neighbours still put a paper cup or a broken phone into the red box. He does not get angry. He takes out only a few wrong things and shows them to their owners at the next gate. Last year four hundred families learned to use the box correctly because of those short talks.

title: 十六次日出的地方
material: In a space station above the earth, the sun does not rise once a day. The station goes around the earth about sixteen times in twenty-four hours, so the sun goes up and goes down sixteen times as well. People who stay there say the first few weeks are hard, because the body never gets a real night to rest in. They sleep with their sleeping bags fixed to a wall, or they would float away when they turn over. They do not pour water from a jug either. Every drop is packed in a small bag, and the crew drinks it through a straw. The same is true of food: it is never served on a plate, because anything loose would slowly float to the ceiling. Fresh fruit and warm bread are the things they miss most. When a supply ship arrives with fresh food and water, the crew first count the boxes together and then sit down to eat at the same time. It is one of the quietest meals in space, and nobody leaves the table until everyone has finished.

options.B: From a small bag through a straw.
options.C: From a bottle with a wide mouth.
options.D: From a pipe fixed to the wall.

options.A: Because loose things would float to the ceiling.
options.B: Because there is no table in the station.
options.C: Because the crew eats much faster than usual.
options.D: Because the plates cannot be washed in space.

options.B: They eat only after the boxes are empty.
options.C: They eat together and wait for one another.

title: 拔掉的插头
material: Many people believe that a machine which is not in use takes no electricity. That is not true. A television, a computer and a small TV box all keep a little electricity going, so that they can answer at once when you press a button. The set is waiting for a signal from the remote control, the computer slowly goes to sleep, and the little box keeps a light burning all night. Last July, during the summer holiday, a family in Building Six did a simple test. On Monday morning they pulled out the plug of every machine in the living room except the fridge. The fridge was left alone because it makes its own cold and keeps the food safe. One week later the family had used one unit less than in the week before. That one unit was enough to run a rice cooker for two hours. The family had expected a much bigger number, so the father went back through the old bills in the box and found that the numbers matched.

title: 树荫下的地面
material: On the hottest afternoon of last July, a science club of Class Two put one thermometer in each of four places around the school: under a big tree, on the open playground, beside the wall of the teaching building, and on a small grass field. They read the four thermometers at one o'clock, two o'clock, three o'clock and four o'clock, and they wrote the numbers down. At three o'clock the playground was eleven degrees hotter than the ground under the tree. The place beside the wall was cooler than the playground, but it was still four degrees warmer than the tree. The grass field was only two degrees warmer than the tree. Then the teacher showed them how a tree cools the ground. The roots take water from the ground and send it up to the leaves, and the water leaves the leaves as a gas. When water turns into gas, it takes heat away from the leaf and from the ground around it. That is why the air under a tree stays cool. Nobody in the club had known this before. Now they measure the same four places every May, and they have asked the school to plant three young trees on both sides of the playground.

title: 银发食堂
material: Last spring our neighborhood opened a small canteen for old people. It stands in a quiet building next to the community clinic, and the kitchen is run by four volunteers who are all over sixty. They cook lunch from ten to two every day, and a full meal costs only twelve yuan. Old people who live alone can eat there free on Wednesdays. Mrs Zhang is seventy-eight and goes three times a week. She says the food is simple but warm. "The meal is only half of it." "It is that somebody is waiting for me." The canteen also packs takeaway boxes for people who cannot walk well. On rainy days two of the volunteers carry hot soup to ten families. A board near the door lists the dishes of the day, and anyone can add a dish to tomorrow's list. Last month sixty-one dishes were suggested, and eleven of them are on the menu now. The cooks do not think of themselves as a restaurant. They say their real work is to make a noisy, bright room where old neighbors meet every day, and to notice at once when somebody does not come.

title: 周二的法律咨询台
material: Every Tuesday morning a small legal advice office opens in our community center. Two lawyers and three student volunteers work there, and anyone can walk in without an appointment. Most people come with small problems: a landlord who will not return the deposit, a second-hand phone that stops working, or a shop that keeps changing its price. Mrs Chen is seventy-two. Last spring she signed a paper she did not understand. A volunteer, Wen, sat with her for forty minutes and explained every line. He drew a simple table on paper so that she could see what she had agreed to and what she could still refuse. She kept her money, but, as she said later, she also kept her calm. The office does not fight every case. Sometimes the answer is simply that the shop is right. Last year two hundred people came, and for sixty of them the situation changed. The others left with advice that saved them from a worse mistake. The workers say the best part is not winning. It is showing people that a rule is something everybody has to follow, including the person in front of you.

title: 老公园的春日庙会
material: The old park in our town holds a temple fair every spring. The fair has run for more than sixty years, and the fair is still the one my grandmother knew. On the first day children carry lanterns and the opera group sings on a small stage. On the second day the shops sell dumplings, rice cakes and new-year couplets. Behind the opera stage sits Mr Wu, who draws sugar pictures with a small spoon, a hot piece of stone and melted brown sugar. He learned the skill from his father in one winter. Today he is the only one in the town who can do it, and he gives a free lesson to any child who brings an old spoon. Eight years ago Mr Wu almost stopped. Sugar became expensive, and few children wanted to stand beside a hot stone. Then a school asked him to come and show the skill to a class. One year became eight, and a young man now drives him home after the fair each evening. He says a sugar picture is not real art. It lasts about ten minutes before somebody eats it. That, he laughs, is why he keeps making it.

title: 楼道下的修理桌
material: A small table appeared under the stairs of our building six years ago. On it there were four things only: a box of screws, a pair of pliers, a small electric drill and a tin of oil. Above it somebody had written, "Bring it, and I will fix it. No money, only parts." The man behind the table is Mr Qian. He worked in a factory until he was sixty; now he opens his door at eight and closes it at five. People bring kettles, desk lamps, walking sticks and radios, and once a small wooden chair with three loose legs. Mr Qian never keeps a borrowed thing longer than one evening. Nothing at the table is free except the work. A kettle needs a new switch for four yuan; Mr Qian writes the number on a slip of paper and never says what his labour was. Last year he wrote the cost of every repair on a small slip of paper and posted all forty-one of them on the wall. The table has become a small shop without a roof. Mr Qian says he never learned to run a shop, but people come back because they have nowhere else to go.

title: 图书馆下的快递点
material: Our community opened a small parcel point under the library two years ago. Workers put every parcel into a numbered locker and send a short message. People who do not like lockers can leave their name and get a phone call instead. The point is free, but it does more than store boxes. Many people here are old, and the post office machines are hard for them. So a volunteer, Uncle He, comes every afternoon to show people how to take a photo, pay for a box and ask for a refund. He uses his own phone and never takes money for it. A year ago the workers removed the small shelves for people who cannot use the lockers. Then an old woman could not fetch her parcel for six days, because she was in hospital and nobody knew her name. The shelves stayed, and today there are four of them. There are two hundred and forty lockers in the room. Last month only seven parcels stayed for more than a week, and the workers gave them to local families. A service point, they say, is also a place where nothing is thrown away.

title: 地下室里的合唱团
material: Guan Laoshi taught maths for thirty-four years, and when he retired nobody expected him to become a singer. Two winters ago the women in his building asked whether the empty room on the ground floor could be used on Wednesday evenings, and he said yes. He expected five people to come. Twenty-six came. They meet from seven to eight thirty, so every rehearsal lasts ninety minutes, and they begin by singing the same slow song twice, because a choir cannot listen to itself while it is hurrying. Most members are women over fifty, but four are men, and two of them are still in their twenties. Auntie Lin is seventy-three and cannot read music at all. She keeps the second row on the left and learns every song by ear. The piano in that room is tuned twice a year. Mr. Guan says a choir of twenty-six does not need a full hall; what it needs is a quiet room. Last winter the choir gave its first concert, and in the first hour only thirty people came in. Mr. Guan was not disappointed about that either. The concert was held in the community hall. The members will meet again this Wednesday, as they have every week for two winters.

title: 博物馆的少年讲解员
material: Zhou Yang is fifteen and had never spoken to a group before. Last spring he walked into the small history museum because it was raining and he had nowhere to wait. A guide asked whether he would like to help on Saturday mornings, and he said yes. His first job was to carry a box of old photographs between two rooms, while the guide taught him the names. The main room has forty objects, and Zhou Yang can answer most questions about them. Two he still cannot: a brown cup and a wooden door handle. He keeps them on a card in his pocket. Visitors are not always easy. Last month a man asked him three times whether the ship in the big picture had really been built in his town. Zhou Yang does not know, so he said he would find out and tell the visitor the next day. He did find out, and the man came back on Sunday and waited. Zhou Yang says 'I don't know' at once when he has to. The guide calls it the most useful sentence a young guide can learn. The card in his pocket now has a third line on it: the date of the ship painting, which he looked up himself.

title: 清晨五点的蔬菜摊
material: Chen Shun's mother has sold vegetables at the same corner for nineteen years. She gets up at five, and by half past six the workers from the breakfast factory are already queueing, so Chen Shun used to think the job was easy. Last summer he offered to help, and his mother let him keep the money for one week. He wrote every number on the back of an old calendar. On the first day he took eleven hundred and forty yuan and was proud of it. On the seventh day he wrote the same number again, and his mother asked him a question he could not answer: the stall on the next corner had taken nine hundred yuan more than he had on Monday. She wanted him to find out why. It was not the price. Chen Shun had given away three bags of spinach because the man looked tired, and had thrown away half a box of beans at closing time without counting them. He says he still cannot answer all his mother's questions, and that this is fine, because her questions turn on numbers. Now he writes the numbers down before he gives anything away, and he counts the boxes before he empties them. On Sunday mornings he still goes to the corner with her.

title: 少了一天的暑期课
material: Lin Hao and Zhao Min went to a village summer school where the term was fifteen teaching days long. They taught English and art, and they had prepared forty picture cards for the first lesson. On the second morning the head teacher told them that the next day would have no lessons at all, because he had to take his mother to hospital in the county town. Lin Hao wanted to start anyway, but Zhao Min refused. She said that thirty-one children cannot learn from two strangers, so they spent that free day walking up and down the village road and learning every child's name. One whole day out of the fifteen was gone. They still finished the course, because they never gave the children a full morning of copying: every morning was a new lesson, and every afternoon the children played with the cards on the ground. On the last morning the head teacher asked them to leave the forty cards in the village. Lin Hao says they are still on a shelf there, and that is enough. The village school opens again in three years, and the two students have not decided yet whether they will go back.

title: 红灯笼电影院关门以后
material: The last film in the Red Lantern Cinema was shown nine years ago, and Zhou Deming still walks past it every Tuesday. He is seventy-nine now. He started in that hall at sixteen as the man who ran the projector, and he stopped at seventy, so he worked in the same room for fifty-four years. In his first winter the hall had a coal stove, and on a Saturday night about four hundred people came. He knew every one of them by the way they sat: the back rows were for the young, and the front for families with small children. Later a new cinema opened across the street with a bigger screen, and the Red Lantern went from four hundred a night to sixty. Zhou Deming did not try to fight that. He says a hall cannot win that race, and that he was paid to show the film correctly, not to keep an audience. Three years ago the building became a warehouse for a shop, and the seats are now under boxes. Zhou Deming has the key, but he keeps it in his pocket. On Tuesdays he walks the whole length of Green Street and home again, at the same hour as the films used to start.

title: 周末安排
scenario: 你的美国笔友 Peter 在信里问你周末的安排和原因。

questions.q: What **are you going to do** this weekend?
**Why** are you going to do that?

points: be going to 表计划，后接动词原形；答语用第一人称 I am going to + 动词原形的完整句子，如 I am going to see my cousin.
why 提问原因 + be going to 表计划；答语用第一人称 Because… 开头的完整句子，如 Because I want to see my cousin.

title: 去医院的路
scenario: 你要去医院看生病的朋友。一位外校的老师正好也要去那家医院，问你医院在哪儿、怎么去最快。

questions.q: **Where** is the hospital?
**How** can I get to the hospital?

points: where 问地点；答语用完整地点表达，如 It's next to the bookstore. 或 Next to the bookstore.
how 问方式，答语用 by bus / on foot / take a bus 等完整表达

title: 买运动鞋
scenario: 周末你陪妈妈去买运动鞋。售货员从架子上拿出两双鞋放在柜台上，先问你想买什么，再请你比一比两双的价钱。

questions.q: **What** would you like to buy?
Which one is **cheaper**, this pair or that pair?

points: what 引导的特殊疑问句；答语用第一人称完整句子说出具体物品名称，如 I'd like to buy a pair of sports shoes.
形容词比较级 cheaper 及其后的 be 动词 is，选择疑问句结构；答语用完整句子，如 This pair is cheaper. 或 That pair is cheaper.

title: 同学生日会
scenario: 你的同学生日快到了，他想请你参加他的生日聚会，还问你周六能不能来、聚会几点开始。

questions.q: **Could** you come to my birthday party this Saturday?
**What time** will the party start?

points: could 表示委婉请求 + 后接动词原形；答语用 I'd love to. / Sorry, I can't. 等委婉回应
what time 问时刻 + will + 动词原形（一般将来时）；答语用第三人称完整句子，will + 动词原形，如 It will start at seven.

title: 明天下雨
scenario: 天气预报说明天上午和下午都有雨。同桌看过天气预报后问你雨会下多久、你雨天打算做什么。

questions.q: **How long** will the rain last?
**What** will you do if it rains tomorrow morning?

points: how long 问持续时间 + will + 动词原形（一般将来时）；答语用第三人称完整句子并给出时长，如 It will last about two hours.
what 引导的特殊疑问句 + will + 动词原形（一般将来时）+ if 条件状语从句「主将从现」；答语用第一人称完整句子，will + 动词原形，如 I will stay at home and read.
keywords: will stay at home and read

title: 落在操场上的手套
scenario: 你在操场捡到一副手套，体育老师问你这副手套是谁的，并让你说说是在操场的哪个位置捡到的。

questions.q: **Whose** gloves did you find on the playground?
**Where** exactly on the playground did you find them?

points: Whose 问所属关系，答语用名词性物主代词（his / her / their）或「sb's + 名词」；问句里的 you 指考生（捡到手套的人），find 用一般过去时 did + 动词原形；答语切到考生视角，如 I picked them up, and they are Tom's.
where 问地点、用地点状语作答（不是 when 的时间点，也不是 how long 的时长）；问句的 you 指考生；答语用第一人称完整句并给出具体位置，如 I found them next to the basketball court.

title: 雨伞丢了
scenario: 早上到校发现雨伞丢了。老师帮你找了一会儿，问你的伞是什么样子的，又问楼下有没有失物认领箱。

questions.q: **What** does your umbrella look like?
**Is there** a lost-and-found box downstairs?

points: what 引导的特殊疑问句 + 助动词 does + 主谓一致；答语用第一人称完整句子描述雨伞的样子，如 My umbrella is black with white spots.
there be 疑问句 Is there…?；答语用完整句子，肯定答 Yes, there is. 并补全信息（如 Yes, there is. It's downstairs.），否定答 No, there isn't. 并补全信息（如 No, there isn't. Ask the school office.），两支均给分。

title: 晚间来电
scenario: 上周六晚上你给同学打电话，那天你正忙着准备期末考试，聊了几句就挂了。周一他回电话，反过来问你上周末做了些什么、为什么那么忙。

questions.q: **What** did you do last weekend?
**Why** were you so busy last weekend?

points: 特殊疑问句 + 一般过去时，助动词 did 后动词用原形；答语用第一人称过去式完整句子，如 I stayed at home and studied for the exam.
why 提问原因 + 一般过去时（be 动词过去式 were）；答语用第一人称 Because… 开头的过去时完整句子，如 Because I was preparing for the final exam.
keywords: was preparing for the final exam

title: 兴趣与季节
scenario: 外教想了解你的兴趣和季节偏好，请你说出喜欢的运动和更喜欢的季节。

questions.q: **What** sports do you like?
Which season do you like **better**, summer or winter?

points: what 引导的特殊疑问句；答语须列出具体运动项目，如 I like playing basketball and running.
比较级 better 的用法 + 选择疑问句；答语用 Summer. 或 I like summer better.（两种均给分）

title: 买苹果
scenario: 你在路边的水果店买苹果。店员称好苹果装进袋子，收钱前和你核对一下总价和找零。

questions.q: **How much** will these apples cost?
**How much** change will you get if you pay fifty yuan?

points: how much 问金额 + will 表将来 + cost 问价；答语用完整金额表达，如 Twenty-five yuan.
how much 问金额 + will + 动词原形（一般将来时）+ if 条件状语从句「主将从现」；答语用第一人称完整句子，数额须与 Q1 相符（五十元减去 Q1 的总价），如 I'll get twenty-five yuan change.

title: 校园开放日
scenario: 校园开放日，一位老师过来搭话，想了解大家课余做过的活动，还想请你带他去阅览室。

questions.q: What is the most interesting thing **you** have ever done?
**Could** you tell me where the reading room is?

points: 最高级 the most interesting，修饰 thing 而非动词；问考生自身经历，答语须把最高级放回完整句子，如 The most interesting thing I have ever done is riding a bike along the lake.
could 表委婉请求 + could 后接动词原形 tell；答语用完整地点表达，如 It's on the third floor, next to the computer room.
keywords: riding a bike along the lake

title: 课程表上的取舍
scenario: 新学期选课，班主任拿着课程表找你，问你觉得英语课和数学课哪门更有意思，又想了解计算机房几点开门。

questions.q: **Which** course do you think is **more** interesting, English or maths?
**Could** you tell me **when** the computer room opens?

points: 比较级 more interesting（两者相比，不用最高级）；答语用完整比较句，如 I think maths is more interesting.
could 表委婉请求 + could 后接动词原形 tell，when 问时刻；答语用完整时间表达，如 It opens at eight in the morning on weekdays.

title: 转学生问路
scenario: 一位新转来的外国同学在走廊上拦住你，问图书室有没有复印机，还问你喜欢读哪一类书。

questions.q: **Is there** a printer in the school library?
Which kind of book do you like **best**, story books or science books?

points: there be 疑问句 Is there…?，there 为引导词、be 动词随主语单数用 is；答语用 Yes, there is. / No, there isn't. 并可补全信息，如 Yes, there is. It's beside the front desk.（两种开头都给分）
最高级 like best；答语用完整比较结构，如 I like story books best.

title: 爸爸关心作息
scenario: 爸爸晚上回家，看你还在台灯下写作业，问你最近是不是睡得更晚，还提醒你别在外面玩太晚。

questions.q: Do you go to bed **later** now than you did last term?
**Must** you come home before nine on school nights?

points: 比较级 later + than 的省略比较结构（than you did last term）；答语先作 Yes/No 应答，再用含比较结构的完整句子重述，两个分支都给、比较形式随分支改变：Yes, I do. I go to bed later now than I did last term. / No, I don't. I go to bed at about the same time as I did last term. 或 No, I don't. I go to bed earlier than I did last term.（两支不可套同一模板）
情态动词 must 表示义务 + must 后接动词原形；答语用 Yes, I must. / No, I don't have to.，问句中的 you 指考生自身的约束。

title: 校医问运动
scenario: 校医在办公室给同学做体检，轮到你了，她问你平时锻炼得勤不勤，还问什么运动对身体更有好处。

questions.q: **How often** do you do sports?
**Which** sport is **better** for your health, swimming or running?

points: 频度副词 how often 提问动作频度（不是 how long）；答语用含频度短语的完整句子，如 I do sports twice a week.
比较级 better + 介词短语 for your health；答语用完整比较句，如 I think swimming is better for my health.
keywords: i do sports twice a week
swimming is better for my health

title: 体育馆的课后
scenario: 放学后你在体育馆练球，值班老师问你会不会打羽毛球，又想问问你知不知道体育馆附近有没有新开的店。

questions.q: **Can** you play badminton?
**Are there** any new shops near the gymnasium?

points: 情态动词 can 表示能力 + can 后接动词原形；答语用 Yes, I can. / No, I can't.，能答时可补一句，如 Yes, I can. I play it every weekend.
there be 复数疑问句 Are there…?，be 动词随复数主语用 are，any 修饰可数名词复数；答语用 Yes, there are. / No, there aren't. 并可补全信息，如 Yes, there are. They're next to the school gate.

title: 社团招新谈话
scenario: 学校社团招新，指导老师和你聊了聊，让你说说最喜欢哪门课，还问起你参加社团活动的次数。

questions.q: Of all the subjects you study, which one do you think is **the most** interesting?
**How often** do you take part in the club activities?

points: 最高级 the most interesting，比较范围由句首 of all the subjects you study 限定；答语用完整句子，如 Of all the subjects, I think Chinese is the most interesting.
频度副词 how often 提问动作频度；答语用频度短语作完整句子，如 I take part in them twice a week.
keywords: take part in them twice a week

title: 体育课借器材
scenario: 体育课上分组练习，同桌说要用你手里的秒表计时，还想借你的跳绳一起用。

questions.q: **May** I use your stopwatch?
Is your rope **longer** than mine?

points: 情态动词 may 表示请求许可 + may 后接动词原形 use；问句中的 I 指同桌（提问者）、your 指考生；答语用 Of course you may. / Sorry, I'm using it now.

比较级 longer + than；问句中 your 指考生手里的跳绳、mine 指同桌的跳绳；答语先作 Yes/No 应答，人称随答语人切换到考生视角（考生自己的绳用 mine、同桌的绳用 yours）：Yes, it is. Mine is longer than yours. / No, it isn't. Yours is longer than mine.（两支的 mine/yours 方向相反，勿写反；两绳一样长也属 No 分支，答 No, it isn't. Mine is as long as yours.）

title: 陪奶奶散步
scenario: 周末你陪奶奶在小区花园散步，她说想找个安静的地方坐坐，还问花园里有没有大树。

questions.q: **Are there** any big trees in **this** garden?
**Which** place is **quieter**, this garden or your home?

points: there be 复数疑问句 Are there…? + any 修饰可数名词复数；this garden 指情景中的小区花园；答语用 Yes, there are. / No, there aren't.
比较级 quieter；this garden 指情景中的小区花园、your home 指考生自己的家；答语用完整比较句，人称随答语人切换（your 换成 my），如 I think this garden is quieter than my home.

title: 月考后的谈话
scenario: 开学第一次月考结束，班主任找你谈话，问你这学期哪门课最吃力，还问你周末去图书馆的次数。

questions.q: **Which** subject do you think is **the hardest** for you this term?
**How often** do you go to the library on weekends?

points: 最高级 the hardest，比较范围是本学期考生所学的各科；答语用完整句子，如 I think maths is the hardest for me this term.
频度副词 how often + on weekends 时间状语；答语用完整频度句，如 I usually go there once a month.
keywords: i usually go there once a month

title: 补笔记的同学
scenario: 上周你发烧缺了两天课，同桌翻你的笔记，想知道你落下哪些内容，还问你平常记不记笔记。

questions.q: What **did** **your classmates** learn in the classes you missed last week?
**How often** do you take notes in Chinese class?

points: 一般过去时叙述，助动词 did 后用动词原形 learn；问句里的 your classmates 指考生同班的同学（非提问者、非考生），the classes you missed 锚定情景中的「上周缺了两天课」；答语用过去式完整句并把问句的 your 切换为考生视角的 my，如 **My classmates learned two new lessons about plants last week.**
how often 提问动作频度（不是 how long）＋ do + 动词原形 take；答语用频度短语作完整句子，如 I take notes in Chinese class almost every day.

title: 病假回校
scenario: 你病假两天刚回校，数学老师问你缺课那两天讲了什么，还问你每天写作业要多久。

questions.q: What **did** you miss in maths during the two days you were absent?
**How long** does it take you to finish your homework every evening?

points: 一般过去时叙述，did 后用动词原形 miss；问句里的 you 指请假的考生，the two days you were absent 锚定情景中的「病假两天」；答语用过去式完整句，如 I missed two lessons about the new unit and the practice exercises.
how long 问做一件事所需的时间长度（不是 how often）＋ does + 动词原形 take；答语须把问句的 your 换成考生视角的 my，如 It takes me about forty minutes to finish my homework every evening.
keywords: the new unit and the practice exercises

title: 小区散步
scenario: 晚饭后你陪爸爸散步，他提起楼下那块空地，想起你小时候常在那儿玩，问你现在还常去不去。

questions.q: What **did** you **use to** do on the empty ground downstairs?
**Do** you still go down there to play now?

points: used to + 动词原形 do 表示过去的习惯（现已不如此），句中的 did 后仍用原形；on the empty ground downstairs 锚定情景里的「楼下那块空地」；答语用过去式习惯作完整句，如 I used to play football there with my cousins after school.

used to 与现在时的对比——Q1 的 **used to 按定义已确立「过去常常如此、现在已不如此」**，因此本题的预期答语只有**否分支**：**No, I don't. I usually stay at home now.**（本组的情景提示「想起你小时候常在那儿玩，问你现在还常去不去」是中性二选一提问，未预设任一分支，故否分支与情景不冲突；而 Yes, I do. I still go down there to play… 与 Q1 的 used to 前提直接矛盾，**不作为可接受答案**。）
keywords: i usually stay at home now

title: 书店买书
scenario: 周末你在书店买书，店员问起你上次来是什么时候、当时买了什么书，想多了解你买书的习惯。

questions.q: **When** did you last come to this bookshop?
What **did** you buy here the last time you came?

points: when 提问时间点（此处为过去时间），助动词 did 后用动词原形 come；this bookshop 指情景中的这家书店；答语用完整时间状语句，如 I came here last Saturday morning.
一般过去时叙述，did 后用动词原形 buy；the last time you came 中的 came 是不规则过去式；here 指情景中的这家书店；答语用过去式完整句，如 I bought a Chinese-English dictionary here the last time I came.
keywords: i came here last saturday morning

title: 运动会报名
scenario: 运动会报名，赛程贴在操场门口，你看过；体育委员核对上午比赛的钟点，还问你跑步勤不勤。

questions.q: **What time** does the race start in the morning?
**How often** do you run after school these days?

points: what time 问具体钟点（区别于 when 的较宽时间口径），does + 动词原形 start；the race 指情景中时间表上的上午比赛；答语用钟点作完整句，句首 It 锚定 the race，如 It starts at eight thirty in the morning.
how often 提问动作频度（不是 how long）＋ do + 动词原形 run；答语用频度短语作完整句子，如 I run after school three times a week.
keywords: starts at eight thirty in the morning
i run after school three times a week

title: 外婆家整理相册
scenario: 你去外婆家整理旧相册，妈妈指着照片问起你小时候在外婆家做什么，还问你在外婆家待多久。

questions.q: What **did** you **use to** do at your grandmother's when you were little?
**How long** do you usually stay at your grandmother's?

points: used to + 动词原形 do 表示过去的习惯（现已不如此），句中的 did 后仍用原形；your grandmother's 指情景中的外婆（提问者妈妈的母亲），不指考生本人；答语把问句的 your 换成考生视角（外婆家改用 there 指代），如 I used to play with my cousins there when I was little.
how long 问停留的持续时间（不是 how often）＋ do + 动词原形 stay；your grandmother's 指情景中的外婆家（提问者妈妈的母亲家）；答语同样切到考生视角，用 there 代替 your grandmother's，如 I usually stay there for about three hours.
keywords: i used to play with my cousins
used to play with my cousins there
stay there for about three hours

title: 社区篮球赛之后
scenario: 上周学校队打了社区篮球赛，值班老师问你在场上做了什么，还问那场比赛是什么时候开始的。

questions.q: What **did** you do in the basketball game last weekend?
**When** did our basketball game start last weekend?

points: 一般过去时叙述，助动词 did 后用动词原形 do；in the basketball game 锚定情景中那场球赛；答语用过去式完整句并切到考生视角，如 I played on the school team and scored six points.
when 提问时间（此处为过去时间）＋ 一般过去时 did + 动词原形 start；our 指提问者所在的学校队那一场，即提问者一方，不指考生个人；答语用完整时间状语句，如 It started at eight thirty on Saturday morning last weekend.
keywords: i played on the school team
played on the school team and scored
started at eight thirty on saturday morning

title: 校医室
scenario: 你有点咳嗽去校医室，校医问你昨晚几点睡的，还问你平时每晚睡多久。

questions.q: **What time** did you go to bed last night?
**How long** do you usually sleep every night?

points: what time 问具体钟点（区别于 when 的较宽时间口径）；问的是昨晚，用一般过去时 did + 动词原形 go to bed；答语用钟点作完整句并切到考生视角，如 I went to bed at about eleven last night.
how long 问睡眠的持续时长（不是 how often 提问频度）＋ do + 动词原形 sleep；答语用时长作完整句，如 I usually sleep for about nine hours every night.
keywords: i went to bed at about eleven
went to bed at about eleven last night
i usually sleep for about nine hours

title: 书法班练习
scenario: 你在书法班学了一个月，书法老师让你写两个字，问你以前练过什么，还问现在一周去几次。

questions.q: What **did** you **use to** practice before you joined this class?
**How often** do you go to this class now?

points: used to + 动词原形 practice 表示过去的习惯（现已不如此），句中的 did 后仍用原形；this class 指情景中的书法班；答语用过去式习惯作完整句，如 I used to practice drawing at home every evening.
how often 提问频度（不是 how long）＋ do + 动词原形 go；now 与 Q1 的 used to 构成过去／现在对比，this class 指情景中的书法班；答语用频度短语作完整句，如 I go to this class twice a week now.
keywords: used to practice drawing at home
i go to this class twice a week now

title: 期中成绩之后
scenario: 期中成绩出来，英语老师找你谈话，问你每天早上花多久背单词，还问你晚上几点开始写作业。

questions.q: **How long** do you study English every morning?
**What time** do you usually begin your homework in the evening?

points: how long 问花费的时间长度（不是 how often 提问频度）＋ do + 动词原形 study；every morning 与情景中的「每天早上」一致；答语用时长作完整句，如 I study English for half an hour every morning.
what time 问具体钟点（区别于 when 的较宽时间口径）＋ do + 动词原形 begin；答语须把问句的 your 换成考生视角的 my，如 I usually begin my homework at seven in the evening.
keywords: i study english for half an hour

title: 报刊亭买杂志
scenario: 放学路上你在街边报刊亭挑杂志，摊主走来问你打算买几本，还想知道你什么时候再来。

questions.q: **How many** magazines do you want to buy?
**When** will you come back to the newsstand?

points: how many 提问可数名词复数的数量；问句里的 you 指考生（要买杂志的顾客），答语必须切成考生视角用 I，并说清「数词 + 复数名词」，如 I want to buy three magazines.（数字取考生自定，只判形式；漏复数 -s 写成 three magazine，或漏谓语动词只写 three magazines，均扣分）
when 提问时间点 + will 表将来；the newsstand 指情景中的报刊亭，有先行词锚点；答语用完整时间状语句，如 I will come back to the newsstand at three in the afternoon.（答语须出现 will 与具体时刻，只答 next week 不给分）
keywords: i want to buy three magazines
will come back to the newsstand

title: 面包店买面包
scenario: 你在学校附近的面包店买面包，店员过来问你要买几块，还问你的面包该放哪里。

questions.q: **How many** pieces of bread would you like to buy?
**Where** should I put the bread **you** bought?

points: how many + 复数名词 pieces of bread；问句里的 you 指考生，答语切成考生视角用 I，并用「数词 + 复数名词」作完整答语，如 I would like to buy three pieces of bread.
where 提问放置位置，答语用方位介词短语开头且不可漏 be 动词；问句里 I 指店员（提问者）、you 指考生，答语须整体换向为 You should put the bread I bought in a paper bag by the window.（答语把 you bought 改成 I bought，误写成 your bread 即人称错位）
keywords: i would like to buy three pieces
in a paper bag by the window
put the bread in a paper bag

title: 门诊预约检查
scenario: 候诊登记时一位护士走过来帮你登记，问你希望几点做检查，还问你下次打算什么时候来复诊。

questions.q: **What time** would you like the check to start?
**When** are you going to come back for the check-up?

points: what time 提问具体时刻（答语含 at + 钟点）；the check 指情景中要做的那项检查；问句里的 you 指考生，答语用 I 承接，如 I would like the check to start at nine in the morning.（答不出钟点只答 in the morning 不给分）
when 提问时间点 + be going to 表已定计划；答语必须保留 be going to 并补完整时间状语，如 I am going to come back for the check-up next Friday morning.（换成 will 或只答 next Friday 都不完整）
keywords: start at nine in the morning
the check to start at nine

title: 图书馆还书
scenario: 你在图书馆还书，手里那张罚款通知单写着三本超期的书要交多少罚款；管理员问你要交多少，还问手上那本何时看完。

questions.q: **How much** will you have to pay for the three late books?
**When** will you finish reading the book **you** borrowed?

points: how much 提问金额；the fine 指情景中三本超期书产生的罚款（情景锚点：考生手里那张罚款通知单已写明罚款数额，问的就是这个数额），the three late books 与情景中的「三本」一致、不得改成 four；问句里的 you 指考生（缴费一方、看得到通知单金额的一方），答语须切成 I 并保留 will，如 I will have to pay six yuan.（数额以通知单为准、考生按通知单自定，只判形式与「三本」不冲突；答语须出现具体金额，只答 cheap 不给分）
when 提问时间点 + will 表将来；the book you borrowed 指情景中考生手上那本，you 指考生；答语必须换成 my 视角，如 I will finish reading the book I borrowed before the winter holiday.（答语误写 the book I borrowed 之外的 your 版本即人称错位）

title: 校门口问路
scenario: 一位陌生阿姨在学校门口拦住你打听路，问最近的地铁站该往哪边走，还有多远。

questions.q: **Which way** should I walk to get to the nearest station?
**How far** is it from here to the station?

points: which way 提问方向，答语用方位词 + 介词短语串联路线；问句里 I 指阿姨（提问者），答语须换成 You，the nearest station 指情景中的地铁站；如 You should walk straight along this road and turn left at the second crossing.（this road 指学校门前这条街，答语须先给方向再给路口）
how far 提问距离；here 指学校门口、the station 指情景中的最近地铁站，两处都有先行词锚点；答语用完整距离表达，如 It is about five hundred metres from here.（只答 far 或 very near 不给分）
keywords: turn left at the second crossing
it is about five hundred metres

title: 公交车买票
scenario: 你在公交车上去博物馆，同车一位游客问你票价是多少，还问你末班车几点开。

questions.q: **How much** does the ticket to the museum cost?
**What time** will the last bus leave from here?

points: how much 提问票价；the ticket to the museum 指情景中考生去博物馆坐公交用的车票（情景锚点「你在公交车上去博物馆」）；问句不含第一/第二人称，不涉及人称切换；答语用完整金额句，如 It costs two yuan.（金额由考生自定，只判形式；答语须出现具体金额，只答 cheap 不给分）
what time 提问时刻 + will 表将来；here 指提问者所在的这个车站（与考生同车，位置相同）；答语用完整时刻表达，如 It will leave from here at half past ten in the evening.（答语须含具体钟点，只答 in the evening 不给分）
keywords: it will leave from here at half past ten

title: 和妈妈商量下周
scenario: 周末在家和妈妈商量下周和这周末的安排，她问你下周打算几点练琴，还问周末想去哪里玩。

questions.q: **What time** are you going to play the piano next week?
**Where** do you want to go this weekend?

points: what time 提问时刻 + be going to 表已定安排；the piano 即情景中的练琴；答语用完整时刻句并保留 be going to，如 I am going to play the piano at seven in the evening next week.（答语须出现 be going to 与具体钟点；换成 will 或只答 next week 都不给分）
where 提问地点，答语用方位介词短语作地点中心词；问句里的 you 指考生，答语须切成考生视角用 I，如 I want to go to the park near the river this weekend.（答语默认用 I；若答语用 We，表示考生与妈妈同行，两种答法都给分；问句里没有 us，不要把考点文字混入答语）
keywords: am going to play the piano
be going to play the piano
i want to go to the park

title: 修理铺修车
scenario: 你在修理铺修自行车，师傅的邻居也想修车，来问自己该付多少修理费、你想什么时候来取车。

questions.q: **How much** should I pay for the repair?
**When** do you want to come back for the bike?

points: how much 提问金额；问句里 I 指邻居（提问者、付钱一方），答语须换成 You，即由考生把应付的数目告诉邻居；the repair 指邻居那辆要修的车（情景锚点「邻居也想修车」），不是考生自己那辆；答语如 You should pay forty yuan for the repair.（答语写成 I should pay forty yuan，即考生把自己当成付钱的一方，人称未切换）
when 提问取车时间点；the bike 指情景中考生那辆自行车；问句里的 you 指考生，答语切成 my 视角，如 I want to come back for my bike tomorrow afternoon.（答语误写 your bike 即人称错位；只答 tomorrow 不给分）
keywords: pay forty yuan for the repair
i want to come back for my bike

title: 邮局寄包裹
scenario: 你在邮局寄一个包裹，工作人员问你要付多少邮费，还问包裹要寄到哪里。

questions.q: **How much** will you have to pay for sending this parcel?
**Where** are you going to send this parcel?

points: how much 提问邮费；this parcel 指情景中考生要寄的包裹（情景锚点「你在邮局寄一个包裹」）；问句里的 you 指考生，答语须切成 I 并保留 will，如 I will have to pay eighteen yuan for sending this parcel.（金额由考生自定，只判形式；答语须给具体金额，只答 cheap 不给分）
where 提问目的地，答语用完整地点表达（介词 + 地名），如 I am going to send this parcel to Shanghai.（只答 China 或只答 my cousin 缺地点结构，不给分；答语可保留 this——同一指称对象，包裹在考生手中）
keywords: i will have to pay eighteen yuan

title: 运动会项目登记
scenario: 运动会项目登记开始了，体育老师拿着表格过来，问你打算报几个项目，还问表格交到哪里。

questions.q: **How many** events are you going to take part in?
**Where** can I hand in this sign-up form?

points: how many 提问可数名词复数数量 + be going to 表已定安排，两个考点同题；答语须同时给出数词、复数名词 events 与 be going to，如 I am going to take part in two events.（漏 events 或漏 be going to 各扣一处）
where 提问地点，答语用方位介词短语 + 场所；问句里 I 指老师（提问者），答语须换成 You，如 You can hand in the form at the sports meeting office.；若考生复述表格，需把 this 改成 that（表格在提问者手中），只答 At the sports meeting office 同样给分。
keywords: am going to take part in two events
you can hand in the form

title: 雨具店买雨衣
scenario: 你在雨具店挑雨衣，店员抬头看了眼窗外，说等下可能会下雨，问你为什么不把手上这件带上，还问你要不要现在先查一下天气。

questions.q: **Why don't you take** this raincoat with you?
**Let's check** the weather report before we leave.

points: 提建议句型 Why don't you + 动词原形；问句里 you 指考生（要带走雨衣的顾客），答语须切成 I 视角并给出理由，如 I think I will take it with me, because it may rain later.（答语写成 You should take it 即人称未切换；只答 Yes 属 Yes/No 回答，不给分）
Let's + 动词原形 提共同行动；we 指考生与店员二人，答语须用 me / my 视角，如 Let me check it on my phone now, I have the weather app.（答语漏动词原形只写 Let's check the weather，缺补语不给分）
keywords: i think i will take it
let me check it on my phone

title: 教室午休
scenario: 午休时同学从门外进来，看见你还在摊着一堆本子写字，走过来问你正在做什么，又问你为什么笑。

questions.q: **What are you doing** at the moment?
**Why are you smiling** now?

points: 现在进行时 be + doing 提问此刻正在进行的动作；答语须给出完整的进行时结构，如 I am writing a letter to my cousin at the moment.（漏 be 动词或漏 doing 各扣一处；只答 Writing 不给分）
