现在进行时 + why 提问此刻情绪的原因；答语须用 Because 引导完整原因从句，如 Because I have just read a funny message from my cousin.（答语只答 Because I am happy，原因过泛不给分）
keywords: writing a letter to my cousin
to my cousin at the moment
a funny message from my cousin

title: 班级图书角
scenario: 你在班级图书角借了一本书，图书管理员走过来，问你上周借的那本看完了没有，还问你以前有没有按时还过别的书。

questions.q: **Have you finished** the book you borrowed last week?
**Have you ever returned** a book to this library on time before?

points: 现在完成时 have/has + 过去分词；问句里 you 指考生，答语须切成 I 视角并保留 have，如 Yes, I have finished it already.（答语写成 I finished it 即误用一般过去时）
现在完成时 + ever 提问经历；答语须有 have + 过去分词并与 ever / never 呼应，如 I have never borrowed a book here without returning it on time。（答语漏过去分词只写 I have borrow，扣分）
keywords: yes, i have finished it already
i have never borrowed a book

title: 转述老师的话
scenario: 外教把你叫到办公室，说他听同事讲你对英语戏剧很感兴趣，问你同事到底说了什么，还问首演安排在什么时候。

questions.q: **What did your teacher say** about your English drama?
**Did she say when** the first show would be?

points: 宾语从句 say + that / wh- 引导；答语须给出完整的转述从句，如 Your teacher said that you were good at acting and that he wanted you to join the play.（答语只答 He said it，缺从句内容不给分）
宾语从句 + wh- 疑问词 + would be 表将来；答语须含时间从句，如 Yes, she said that the first show would be in December.（答语把 would be 改成 will be，时态错不给分）
keywords: the first show would be in december

title: 约同学爬山
scenario: 同学约你这个周末一起去爬山，告诉你要是明天下雨就改期，反过来问你怎么看。

questions.q: **If it does not rain tomorrow, will you go** climbing with us?
**What will you do if** it rains tomorrow?

points: 第一条件句 if + 一般现在时 + will；问句里 us 指提问者与考生，答语须保留 if 从句并把 us 换成 you，如 If it does not rain tomorrow, I will go climbing with you.（答语把 if 从句换成 when 从句，结构错不给分）
第一条件句 + what 提问；答语须完整回答该条件引发的行动，如 If it rains tomorrow, I will stay at home and read.（答语只答 I don't know，不给分）
keywords: if it does not rain tomorrow
i will go climbing with you
i will stay at home and read

title: 社团招新
scenario: 社团招新处的人过来问你对哪个社团感兴趣、打算什么时候报名，还问你放学以后喜欢做点什么。

questions.q: **What club do you want to join**, and **what do you hope to learn from it**?
**What do you enjoy doing** after school, and why?

points: want to do 与 hope to do 两个不定式同题；答语两处不定式须齐全，如 I want to join the photography club, and I hope to learn how to take better pictures.（任一处漏 to + 动词原形，各扣一处）
enjoy + doing 动名词搭配；答语须用动名词而非不定式，如 I enjoy taking pictures of the river after school because it is quiet there.（答语写成 enjoy to take，搭配错不给分）
keywords: i want to join the photography club
hope to learn how to take better pictures
enjoy taking pictures of the river

title: 拿错书了
scenario: 同桌看见你桌上摊着的其实是语文书，走过来问你是不是把两本拿错了，并问你要怎么补救。

questions.q: **Is it because both books have the same blue cover** that you took the wrong book?
**What will you do so** that you can use the right book today?

points: 原因状语从句 because + it is ... that 结构；问句里 you 指考生（拿错书的本人），答语须切成考生视角用 I 确认，如 Yes, it is, because both books have the same blue cover。（答语漏 because 或不用 I 确认，人称或结构缺一不给分）
so that 引导目的状语从句；答语须含 so that + 完整主谓的从句，如 I will go to the office so that I can exchange it for the right one.（so that 从句缺主谓不给分）
keywords: because both books have the same blue cover
so that i can exchange it
i will go to the office so that
exchange it for the right one

title: 帮外国游客
scenario: 一位外国游客在校门口拦住你问路，你决定带他走一走；他问你要带他去哪里，还问你为什么愿意这样做，并说自己刚才在车站把一个包落在了长椅上。

questions.q: **What do you hope to do so** that I can get my bag back from the station?
**Did you see where** I left my bag?

points: hope to do + so that 目的状语从句；问句里 I 指提问者（丢包的游客），答语须切成考生视角用 you 回指对方，如 I hope to go back to the station with you so that you can get your bag back.（答语把 I 当成自己丢包，人称未切换不给分；任一处缺 to + 动词原形或缺从句，各扣一处）
宾语从句 + wh- 疑问词；问句里 you 指考生、I 指提问者（丢包的游客），答语须保持考生视角并保留从句，如 Yes, I did see you put it on a bench near the station.（答语把 I 当成自己丢包，人称未切换不给分；漏从句不给分）
keywords: i hope to go back to the station with you
so that you can get your bag back
i did see you put it on a bench

title: 操场上的惊叹
scenario: 新来的英国交换生第一次看到你们的操场和图书室，很惊讶地跟你说话，问你觉得学校有什么特别的地方。

questions.q: **What a big library** your school has!
**How spacious** the reading room is!

points: What + a/an + 形容词 + 名词 + 主谓 感叹句；答语须用感叹句回应，如 What an interesting place it is!／How nice your library is!（答语写成普通陈述句，感叹形式不给分）
How + 形容词 + 主谓 结构；答语里 your 指考生所在的学校，答语须以 How 开头作评价，如 How spacious your reading room is!（答语不用 How 开头，结构不给分）
keywords: what an interesting place it is
how spacious your reading room is

title: 宿管查寝
scenario: 宿管老师来查寝，问你是不是每天都得整理床铺，又问你哪些事其实完全可以不做。

questions.q: **Do you have to make** your bed every morning?
**What don't you have to do** on weekends?

points: 半助动词 have to 表义务，助动词 do / does 随人称与时态变化；问句里 you 指考生，答语须切成 I 视角，如 Yes, I have to make my bed every morning before breakfast.（答语换成 I must… 即改用情态动词，不算本考点）
半助动词 don't have to 表「不必」；答语须保留 have to，如 I don't have to make my bed on weekends.（答语写成 I am not allowed to do，意思变成「被禁止」，不给分）
keywords: yes, i have to make my bed
have to make my bed every morning
i don't have to make my bed

title: 垃圾分类扔哪只桶
material:
Boy: Ms. He, where do I put this empty paper box?
Ms. He: In the blue bin. It is clean paper.
Boy: What about the banana skin and the used tissues?
Ms. He: They go in the green bin, not the red one. The red bin is only for batteries.

questions.question: Where will the boy put the banana skin and the used tissues?

title: 春游要租几辆车
material:
Boy: Ms. Tang, grades seven and eight will go on the spring trip. How many coaches?
Ms. Tang: 380 students altogether, and one coach takes 45.
Boy: My friend says seven coaches.
Ms. Tang: Seven seats 315. Eight seats 360 and leaves twenty out. Ten is too many. Book nine.

questions.question: How many coaches will the class book for the spring trip?

title: 书法课要带什么
material:
Girl: Mr. Fang, what shall I bring for the calligraphy class tomorrow?
Mr. Fang: Bring a brush and a felt mat. Not a pencil.
Girl: Do I need an ink stone and an ink bottle?
Mr. Fang: Yes, and a small cup for water. The school has no paper, so buy eight sheets on the way.

questions.question: What shall the girl buy on her way to school?

options.B: A brush and an ink stone.
options.C: An ink stone and an ink bottle.
options.D: A pencil and a felt mat.

title: 绿豆芽第七天多高
material:
Boy: Ms. Gu, our sprouts are seven days old. How tall are they now?
Ms. Gu: They came out on day three. On day seven they are five centimetres high.
Boy: My partner says ten centimetres. He keeps the jar in the sun.
Ms. Gu: Too much sun dries them. Move it away from the window.

questions.question: How tall are the bean sprouts on the seventh day?

title: 朗读比赛奖品是什么
material:
Girl: Mr. Pei, what do the winners of the reading contest get?
Mr. Pei: First prize is a bookshop ticket worth fifty yuan, not a schoolbag.
Girl: My cousin came second. What does she get?
Mr. Pei: Two science books and a blue notebook. The ticket only goes to first place.

questions.question: What will the girl's cousin get for second place?

options.A: A bookshop ticket worth fifty yuan.
options.B: Two science books and a blue notebook.

title: 台风天停课怎么上课
material:
Boy: Ms. Dai, a typhoon may come tomorrow. Will we go to school?
Ms. Dai: No. All lessons move online. Log in at nine with your student card.
Boy: Then the football match on the playground is cancelled, too?
Ms. Dai: Yes. No match and no club. Stay in your own room at home.

questions.question: What will the boy do on the typhoon day?

options.A: Play the football match on the playground.
options.B: Join the club meeting in the school hall.
options.C: Go to school at nine and hand in his student card.
options.D: Watch the lessons online in his own room at home.

title: 停水什么时候来
material:
Girl: Mr. Hao, our building has no water again. When will it come back?
Mr. Hao: The workers shut the main off at seven this morning.
Girl: My mother wanted to wash the bowls before we left for school at eight.
Mr. Hao: Water returns at one in the afternoon and stays till eight tonight.

questions.question: When will the water come back?

title: 大扫除第三组做什么
material:
Boy: Ms. Ren, our class is cleaning this afternoon. What does group three do?
Ms. Ren: Group one washes the windows, group two sweeps the floor.
Boy: My friend says group three cleans the blackboard.
Ms. Ren: No. Group three carries the desks out and carries them back at five.

questions.question: What will group three do this afternoon?

options.B: Carry the desks out of the classroom.

title: 全班一共捐了多少钱
material:
Girl: Mr. Tao, our class is sending money to a school in the mountains.
Mr. Tao: How much did you collect?
Girl: Forty-two students gave two yuan each. My mother added fifty yuan.
Mr. Tao: Two times forty-two is eighty-four. With fifty, that is one hundred and thirty-four yuan.

questions.question: How much money will the class send to the school in the mountains?

title: 花圃里种什么花
material:
Boy: Mr. Wei, our class garden is by the playground. Shall we plant roses?
Mr. Wei: Roses need too much care. Plant mint and marigolds instead.
Boy: My sister says roses are prettier than marigolds.
Mr. Wei: They are, but a class garden needs plants that grow fast and need little water.

questions.question: Which plants will they put in the class garden?

title: 全班合影女生站哪里
material:
Girl: Mr. Yu, the class photo is being taken on the steps at nine.
Mr. Yu: The tall boys sit in the back row, not the front.
Girl: Where do the girls stand?
Mr. Yu: In the front row, beside me. The monitor stands on my left.

questions.question: Where will the girls stand for the class photo?

options.B: In the front row, beside Mr. Yu.
options.C: On the steps behind Mr. Yu.

title: 干洗大衣多少钱
material:
Boy: Mr. Long, my winter coat is dirty. Should I wash it at home?
Mr. Long: Too thick for our machine. Send it to the dry cleaner's.
Boy: My mother says it takes two days and costs ten yuan.
Mr. Long: Two days is too short; it takes four. The price is twenty yuan, not ten.

questions.question: How much will the boy's coat cost at the dry cleaner's?

title: 地震演习怎么做
material:
Girl: Ms. Cui, our class will have a drill next Monday morning.
Ms. Cui: Yes. When the bell rings, get under your desk and hold its leg.
Girl: Then we all run out to the playground?
Ms. Cui: No. Stay under the desk till the second bell. Do not stand in the hall.

questions.question: What should the girl do when the bell rings?

options.A: Get under the desk and hold its leg.
options.B: Run out to the playground with the other classes.
options.C: Stand in the hall with her teacher.
options.D: Hold her desk and carry it to the playground.

title: 端午节吃什么
material:
Boy: Mr. Yan, what does your family eat at the Dragon Boat Festival?
Mr. Yan: We make zongzi on the fifth day.
Boy: My mother buys mooncakes for it. My aunt makes dumplings.
Mr. Yan: Dumplings are for Spring Festival and mooncakes for September. For the fifth day, zongzi.

questions.question: What will Mr. Yan's family eat on the fifth day of the fifth month?

title: 家长开放日家长做什么
material:
Boy: Ms. Kan, parents' open day is Wednesday. What will they do?
Ms. Kan: They come to room 203 at eight.
Boy: My mother wants to see the PE lesson on the playground.
Ms. Kan: The PE lesson is on Thursday. The hall show is on Friday. On Wednesday parents sit at the back and hear Chinese.

questions.question: What will the parents do on the open day?

options.A: Watch a PE lesson on the playground.
options.B: Go to the school hall for the show.
options.C: Hear a Chinese lesson in room 203.
options.D: Watch the PE lesson on Thursday.

title: 空调设成二十六度
material:
Girl: Ms. Fang, our classroom is too cold. The air conditioner is on.
Ms. Fang: Set it at twenty-six, not at twenty-two.
Girl: Twenty-six. Should we turn it off when we leave?
Ms. Fang: Turn it off at ten, not at nine. Our class ends at nine.
Girl: Twenty-six, and off at ten. All right.

questions.question: At what temperature will the girl set the air conditioner?

title: 口袋里的纸票和钥匙
material:
Boy: Mr. Hu, I'm going to wash my school clothes.
Mr. Hu: Turn out your pockets first.
Boy: Why? There is only a little money in my pocket.
Mr. Hu: There is a paper ticket and a key in the left pocket. Check it, not just the money.
Boy: Then I'll look in both pockets before washing.

questions.question: What is in the left pocket of the boy's school clothes?

options.A: A paper ticket and a key.

title: 微波炉不用金属盘
material:
Girl: Mr. Ren, I want to heat my milk in the microwave.
Mr. Ren: Use a glass bowl, not a metal plate.
Girl: This spoon is metal too. May I put it in?
Mr. Ren: Take the spoon out. Put the bowl in for two minutes, not three.
Girl: A glass bowl for two minutes, with no spoon.

questions.question: What will the girl put in the microwave?

options.A: A metal plate for three minutes.
options.B: A metal plate for two minutes.
options.C: A glass bowl with a metal spoon for two minutes.
options.D: A glass bowl without a spoon for two minutes.

title: 出门前关掉家里的灯
material:
Boy: Ms. Hu, our flat is dark. I left for school in a hurry.
Ms. Hu: Which lights are still on?
Boy: The big light in the hall and my desk light.
Ms. Hu: Two lights for eight hours. Turn both off when you leave. Not one of them.
Boy: All the lights next time. I see.

questions.question: How many lights will the boy turn off next time?

title: 冰箱里不要塞满
material:
Girl: Mr. Tao, I put all our food in the fridge yesterday.
Mr. Tao: Did you fill every shelf?
Girl: Yes, even the door. The motor is very loud.
Mr. Tao: Take out two bottles. Cold air must move.
Girl: How much space should I leave on the shelves?
Mr. Tao: A little, not a full load.

questions.question: What should the girl do to the fridge?

title: 洗衣粉只放一勺
material:
Boy: Mr. An, how much washing powder shall I put in?
Mr. An: One spoon for a full load, not two.
Boy: My mother always puts in two spoons.
Mr. An: One is enough. Too much powder leaves marks on the clothes.
Boy: One spoon, then I press the button.

questions.question: How much washing powder will the boy put in?

options.A: One spoon for half a load.
options.B: Two spoons for a full load.
options.C: Two spoons for half a load.
options.D: One spoon for a full load.

title: 插线板最多接两样
material:
Girl: Ms. Deng, I want three things on one power strip.
Ms. Deng: How many? A rice cooker, a kettle and a lamp?
Girl: Yes, all at the same time.
Ms. Deng: Two at most, not three. The lamp needs another wall socket.
Girl: Two here, and the lamp goes over there.

questions.question: Where will the lamp be plugged in?

options.D: It will not be plugged in.

title: 洗澡只冲十分钟
material:
Boy: Mr. Gao, the shower water is too hot for me today.
Mr. Gao: Turn the tap to the left, not to the right.
Boy: How long shall I stay in?
Mr. Gao: Ten minutes, not twenty. Turn off the tap while you wash your hair.
Boy: Ten minutes, and the tap off for my hair.

questions.question: How long will the boy stay in the shower?

title: 洗手时先关水再冲
material:
Girl: Ms. Jin, I leave the tap on when I wash my hands.
Ms. Jin: How long does it run then?
Girl: Far too long. My two brothers wash after me.
Ms. Jin: Close the tap while you rub. Open it again to rinse.
Girl: Tap closed while I rub, then open it to rinse.

questions.question: When should the girl close the tap?

options.A: While she rubs her hands with soap.
options.D: Only when her brothers wash after her.

title: 洗菜水拿去浇花
material:
Boy: Mr. Yu, I throw the water away after I wash the vegetables.
Mr. Yu: How much water do you use each time?
Boy: About two bowls. I wash the vegetables every day.
Mr. Yu: Keep it in a bucket for the flowers on your balcony.
Boy: Two bowls in the bucket, and I water the plants after dinner.

questions.question: What will the boy do with the water after he washes the vegetables?

options.B: Use it for the flowers on his balcony.

title: 看完电视拔掉插头
material:
Girl: Mr. Bai, our television is on all evening, even with no picture.
Mr. Bai: That red light means the set is still working.
Girl: We watch until eleven. Then we just put the covers on.
Mr. Bai: Pull out the plug after eleven. Not a new TV.
Girl: The plug goes out at eleven then. Good.

questions.question: What will the girl do after eleven o'clock?

options.B: Put the covers on the set.

title: 天热先开电风扇
material:
Boy: Ms. Mo, it is thirty-five degrees today. Shall we open the air conditioner?
Ms. Mo: Not yet. Open the window and run the fan for an hour.
Boy: Then shall I turn the air conditioner on at two?
Ms. Mo: Yes, at two, and close the windows again.
Boy: Wind first, then the air conditioner at two.

questions.question: When will the boy turn the air conditioner on?

title: 水费单多了四吨
material:
Girl: Mr. Luo, our water bill went up. It is four tons more than June.
Mr. Luo: Where did the extra water go?
Girl: We washed the car at home twice, and the tap was on.
Mr. Luo: Each wash takes two tons. Use the car wash, not the yard.
Girl: Then we wash it there next time.

questions.question: Why was the water bill higher than June's?

options.A: They drank more water in the hot weather.
options.C: They used more water in the bathroom.
options.D: They washed the car at home twice.

title: 先甩干再拿到阳台晾
material:
Boy: Ms. Wei, my clothes are wet for a long time on the balcony.
Ms. Wei: Did you press the spin button before you hung them?
Boy: No. I just hung them straight from the machine.
Ms. Wei: Spin for three minutes. Then the balcony needs one hour, not four.
Boy: Spin first, and the balcony needs less time.

questions.question: How long will the clothes dry on the balcony?

title: 电熨斗别一直放在板上
material:
Girl: Mr. Guo, my iron is still warm. Can I leave it on the board?
Mr. Guo: Pull out the plug first, then put it on the board.
Girl: How long may the hot iron stay there?
Mr. Guo: Ten minutes is enough, not half an hour.

questions.question: How long may the iron stay on the board?

title: 洗衣店取衣不是周六
material:
Girl: Ms. He, my blue coat is at the laundry. When can I get it?
Ms. He: We wash clothes on Tuesday. Pick it up on Friday, not on Saturday.
Girl: What time on Friday? I leave school at four.
Ms. He: Not at four. Come at five. We close at six.

questions.question: When will the girl pick up her coat?

title: 配眼镜一共六十元
material:
Boy: Mr. Dai, I need glasses for the maths test. How much will they cost?
Mr. Dai: The blue frames are eighty yuan. The black ones are fifty.
Boy: Eighty is too much for me. Which ones do you advise?
Mr. Dai: Take the black ones. Glass lenses cost ten yuan, so sixty in all.

questions.question: How much will the boy pay for his glasses?

title: 阳台的花三天浇一次
material:
Girl: Dad, the leaves of my plant on the balcony are yellow. What should I do?
Dad: Water it today. The soil is dry, not wet. Don't move it at all.
Girl: How often should I water it?
Dad: Every three days. Not every day, or the roots rot.

questions.question: What should the girl do today?

options.A: Move the plant into the sun.
options.D: Move the plant into her room.

title: 停水从九点停到五点
material:
Boy: Mr. Guo, the notice says water is off all day. Is that right?
Mr. Guo: Not all day. It stops at nine and comes back at five, not at two.
Boy: My mother cooks at six. Will she have water?
Mr. Guo: Yes. Fill two buckets with cold water before nine.

questions.question: How long will the water be off?

options.A: From nine in the morning to five in the evening.
options.C: From nine in the morning to two in the afternoon.
options.D: From two in the afternoon to five in the evening.

title: 水管漏水报给物业
material:
Girl: Ms. Qian, water is leaking under my kitchen sink. Who do I tell?
Ms. Qian: Tell the property office. The shop downstairs only sells pipes.
Girl: My father is at work, and my neighbour in 503 fixed my bike.
Ms. Qian: Neither can fix a pipe. Leave it with the office. Room 502.

questions.question: Who should the girl tell about the leak?

title: 乒乓球台两小时六十元
material:
Boy: Mr. Fu, how much is one hour at a table?
Mr. Fu: Twenty yuan an hour on weekdays. On Saturday it is thirty.
Boy: We want two hours on Saturday. That is sixty, right?
Mr. Fu: Right. But half an hour is ten yuan.

questions.question: How much will the boys pay for two hours on Saturday?

title: 手机没电在他家充
material:
Girl: Mr. Ren, my phone has no power. My photo is still on it.
Mr. Ren: Don't buy a new phone. Use my charger here.
Girl: But I need it for the maths test on Friday.
Mr. Ren: Charge it at my home tonight, not at school. Bring it back on Saturday.

questions.question: What should the girl do tonight?

options.A: Charge her phone at Mr. Ren's home.
options.B: Buy a new phone at the shop.
options.D: Leave the phone at school until Saturday.

title: 墙报上我写标题和日期
material:
Girl: Mr. Wang, who should write on our class wall paper?
Mr. Wang: You write the title. Li Ming draws the picture, not you.
Girl: My pen is slow. What about the date?
Mr. Wang: Write the date too, on Monday, not on Friday.

questions.question: What will the girl write on the wall paper?

title: 运动会报名跳远
material:
Girl: Mr. Bai, which event should I enter for the sports meeting?
Mr. Bai: Not the high jump. Enter the long jump, not the relay.
Girl: My friend enters the hundred metres. Can we do both?
Mr. Bai: One event each. Long jump finals are at ten on Thursday.

questions.question: Which event will the girl enter?

title: 图书角收我的旧科学书
material:
Boy: Ms. Deng, our class book corner is empty. What books can I bring?
Ms. Deng: Story books, not picture books. Nobody reads a maths book there.
Boy: My science books are old. Do they fit?
Ms. Deng: Science books are fine. But your story books stay with you.

questions.question: Which books will the boy bring to the book corner?

title: 这月电费二百四
material:
Girl: Dad, the bill says we used two hundred degrees this month.
Dad: The air conditioner used a hundred and forty. What about the rest?
Girl: Sixty for the lights, the computer and the small machines.
Dad: Then we pay two hundred and forty yuan. Last month it was three hundred.

questions.question: How much will the family pay for the electricity this month?

title: 压岁钱捐五十元
material:
Boy: Grandma, my uncle gave me two hundred yuan. What do I do with it?
Grandma: Give a quarter of it to the school library fund.
Boy: A quarter? My friend gives half of his money to his uncle.
Grandma: Fifty yuan, not a hundred. Keep the rest in your money box.

questions.question: How much will the boy give to the school library fund?

title: 报刊亭买报和杂志
material:
Boy: Uncle, how much is today's newspaper?
Uncle: One yuan. The magazine with it is six yuan, not four.
Boy: I'll take both. Do I pay for the paper bag?
Uncle: No, the bag is free. That is seven yuan in all.

questions.question: How much will the boy pay?

title: 看星星要带暖外套
material:
Girl: Dad, there is a star show at the science museum on Sunday. What do I take?
Dad: Take a warm coat. It is cold in the hall.
Girl: Shall I take my own telescope?
Dad: No. They lend us one. Take a notebook and a pencil.

questions.question: What will the girl take to the science museum?

options.B: A warm coat, a notebook and a pencil.

title: 宠物店洗澡留两小时
material:
Girl: Ms. Pei, my dog needs a bath. How long will he stay at the pet shop?
Ms. Pei: He goes in at twelve and comes out at two.
Girl: Can I wait for him there?
Ms. Pei: The bath takes one hour, but he rests in a box until two. We close at nine.

questions.question: How long will the dog stay at the pet shop?

options.B: From nine in the morning until two.

title: 物业费下周五交
material:
Boy: Ms. Dai, has our building's service fee been paid?
Ms. Dai: Not yet. It is due next Friday, not this Friday.
Boy: How much is it for our family?
Ms. Dai: Two hundred yuan a month. Give it to me, not to the office.
Boy: Two hundred for March, then. Thanks, Ms. Dai.

questions.question: When is the service fee due?

title: 楼上半夜的钢琴声
material:
Girl: Mr. Fan, I can't sleep. The boy upstairs plays the piano until midnight.
Mr. Fan: His mother says he only practises for ten minutes.
Girl: Ten minutes? I hear it for an hour. What should I do?
Mr. Fan: Write down the hours for a week, then let the office call her.

questions.question: What does Mr. Fan suggest the girl do?

options.A: Write down the hours for a month, then let the office call her.
options.B: Write down the hours for a week, then call the mother herself.
options.C: Write down the hours for a week, then let the office call her.
options.D: Write down the hours for a month, then let the boy call her.

title: 数学题不会做
material:
Boy: Ms. Hu, question five is hard. I've been on it for half an hour.
Ms. Hu: Reading it again won't help. Copy it into your notebook and ask me at four.
Boy: Our math lesson is at four. Could I ask you at three fifteen?
Ms. Hu: Yes, but bring the notebook, not the test paper.

questions.question: When will the boy ask Ms. Hu for help?

title: 美术课要带什么材料
material:
Girl: Mr. Yu, what do we need for tomorrow's art lesson?
Mr. Yu: Two brushes, a bottle of black ink and some old newspapers.
Girl: How many sheets of paper should I bring?
Mr. Yu: Only small ones. Leave the big roll at home.
Girl: Two brushes and one bottle. Understood, Mr. Yu.

questions.question: What will the girl take to the art lesson tomorrow?

options.A: Two brushes, one bottle of ink and small sheets.
options.B: One brush, one bottle of ink and small sheets.
options.C: Two bottles of ink, one brush and small sheets.
options.D: Two brushes, one bottle of ink and the big roll.

title: 水表读数对不上
material:
Boy: Ms. Jin, my water bill is forty yuan, but my neighbour's is only twenty.
Ms. Jin: Read the meter again. His number is one thousand two hundred.
Boy: Mine says one thousand. Should I tell someone?
Ms. Jin: Yes, ring the office on Monday and say both numbers.

questions.question: What should the boy do about the bill?

options.A: Ring the office on Tuesday and say both numbers.
options.B: Ring the office on Monday and say one number.
options.C: Ring the office on Monday and say both numbers.
options.D: Ring Ms. Jin on Monday and say both numbers.

title: 秋游改到下周
material:
Boy: Ms. Qiao, our class trip is on Thursday, isn't it?
Ms. Qiao: Not now. The bus is being repaired, so we go next Tuesday.
Boy: Next Tuesday? Then we miss our geography lesson.
Ms. Qiao: Mr. Deng will move that lesson to Friday morning.

questions.question: Which day will the class go on the trip now?

title: 牛奶盒投哪个桶
material:
Girl: Mr. Wei, where do I put the banana skin?
Mr. Wei: In the green bin, not the blue one. The blue one is for paper.
Girl: And my empty milk carton?
Mr. Wei: That one goes to the yellow bin by the north gate.

questions.question: Where should the girl put her empty milk carton?

options.A: In the yellow bin by the north gate.
options.B: In the yellow bin by the south gate.
options.C: In the blue bin for paper.
options.D: In the green bin by the north gate.

title: 洗衣机滤网多久洗
material:
Girl: Ms. Luo, my washing machine leaves water in the door.
Ms. Luo: Clean the little filter under it every month.
Girl: Every month? My mother never does it.
Ms. Luo: Then write it on the fridge door and start now.

questions.question: How often should the girl clean the filter?

options.C: Only when the door has water in it.

title: 停电后读书会去哪儿
material:
Girl: Ms. Bai, our floor has no electricity this evening.
Ms. Bai: The office is fixing it, but it will be on before seven.
Girl: Then our reading club can't use the classroom projector.
Ms. Bai: Take your reading to the library, not to your classroom.

questions.question: Where will the reading club meet this evening?

title: 班费交多少
material:
Girl: Mr. Wu, class money is twenty yuan this term, isn't it?
Mr. Wu: Yes, but only twelve. The other eight comes from the book fund.
Girl: Twelve yuan to Ms. Tang, then.
Mr. Wu: Yes, and bring coins, not a note.

questions.question: How much must the girl bring this term?

title: 墙报要用几张纸
material:
Girl: Ms. Fan, we have to paint the notice board today. How many sheets?
Ms. Fan: Six. Three colours only, and no green one.
Girl: Then what colour is the title?
Ms. Fan: Red, not green. And I'll paint the big letters.

questions.question: How many sheets of paper will the class need?

title: 修路期间怎么上学
material:
Boy: Mr. Gao, my home is far from school. Should I ride a bike?
Mr. Gao: Not yet. The road by the bridge is under repair.
Boy: How long will that last? Riding takes me five minutes.
Mr. Gao: Two weeks. Walk for now, and bring a raincoat on Monday.

questions.question: What will the boy do during the repair?

options.A: Ride a bike on the road by the bridge.
options.B: Ask his father to drive him.
options.C: Walk to school and bring a raincoat on Monday.
options.D: Stay at home until the repair is over.

title: 鸡汤放几个蛋
material:
Girl: Ms. Ma, what can I cook with three eggs and some carrots?
Ms. Ma: Make an egg and carrot soup. Don't use the whole box of eggs.
Girl: Only two eggs then, is that enough?
Ms. Ma: Two eggs are fine. Add water after you cut the carrots.

questions.question: How many eggs will the girl use for the soup?

title: 视力检查在哪里做
material:
Girl: Ms. Guo, I can't read the board at the back of the room.
Ms. Guo: How long has your eyesight been like this?
Girl: Since last term. My glasses are two years old.
Ms. Guo: Then make an eye test first, in the clinic on Thursday.

questions.question: Where will the girl make the eye test?

options.C: In the school clinic on Friday.

title: 新衬衫怎么洗
material:
Boy: Mr. Ren, my new shirt says "wash at thirty". May I use hot water?
Mr. Ren: No, thirty is the warmest it can be. Use cold water at home.
Boy: Then I shall wash it by hand, not in the machine.
Mr. Ren: Right, and dry it flat, not on a hanger.

questions.question: How should the boy wash his new shirt?

options.B: In the machine with hot water.
options.C: In the machine with cold water.
options.D: By hand with water at thirty degrees.

title: 换到窗边第三排
material:
Girl: Ms. Deng, may I change my seat? The sun comes in here after lunch.
Ms. Deng: The front row is full. Take the seat by the window in row three, not the one near the door.
Girl: Is Mr. Hu's desk free?
Ms. Deng: No, Mr. Hu moves there on Monday. Come to me before class on Tuesday.

questions.question: Which seat will the girl take?

options.A: The seat in the front row.
options.C: The seat by the window in row three.

title: 零花钱分成三份
material:
Boy: Dad, I have thirty yuan this week. May I buy a toy?
Dad: Put ten yuan in a box for books, ten yuan in a box for the school trip, and keep the rest.
Boy: Then the toy must be very small.
Dad: That's right. Keep it in the box.

questions.question: How much money will the boy have for the toy?

title: 水龙头请人上门修
material:
Boy: Mr. Fang, the tap in our kitchen drips all night. Can you come and fix it?
Mr. Fang: I'm free on Tuesday afternoon, not on Saturday morning.
Boy: My parents are at work on Tuesday. Can you come on Thursday?
Mr. Fang: On Thursday I can come at nine. Bring a new washer, not a new tap.

questions.question: When will Mr. Fang come to the boy's home?

options.B: On Thursday at nine in the morning.

title: 停电只上半天的课
material:
Boy: Ms. Hu, there's no electricity in my building tonight. Will we have class tomorrow?
Ms. Hu: Yes, but only in the morning. The power will be off from one o'clock to six.
Boy: Then my class in the afternoon is off too, isn't it?
Ms. Hu: That's right. Go home at twelve, not at three.

questions.question: When will the boy go home tomorrow?

title: 科学小组看月亮
material:
Girl: Mr. Ma, our science club will watch the moon tonight. When shall we meet?
Mr. Ma: Not at eight. The moon comes up at half past seven.
Girl: The gate closes at nine. Shall we meet inside the lab?
Mr. Ma: No. Meet under the big tree by the east gate at a quarter to nine.

questions.question: At what time will the science club meet?

title: 墙报要做两米宽
material:
Boy: Mr. Ding, how big should our wall newspaper be?
Mr. Ding: Two metres wide and one metre high. My class used four sheets last year.
Boy: I drew it on four small sheets. Can we just use four again?
Mr. Ding: No, use eight this year. Join them and leave a white edge two fingers wide.

questions.question: How wide will the wall newspaper be?

title: 周记写一百字
material:
Girl: Mr. Guo, I never write my diary. How long should each entry be?
Mr. Guo: A hundred words, not thirty. Write it on Friday evening, not on Sunday night.
Girl: Sunday is my busiest day. What about a hundred and fifty words?
Mr. Guo: No. Keep to a hundred, not a hundred and fifty. Ten lines will do.

questions.question: How many words should each diary entry have?

title: 消防演习站到东墙前
material:
Boy: Ms. Qian, will our class have a fire drill tomorrow morning?
Ms. Qian: Yes, at ten, not at nine. When the bell rings, walk down the stairs and do not run.
Boy: Should I take my schoolbag with me?
Ms. Qian: No. Everyone will stand on the playground in front of the east wall, not in the hall.

questions.question: Where will the students stand during the fire drill?

options.B: On the playground in front of the west wall.
options.C: On the playground in front of the east gate.
options.D: On the playground in front of the east wall.

title: 拼图还差三块
material:
Girl: Mr. Yuan, this puzzle has ninety-six pieces. I can only find ninety.
Mr. Yuan: Look under the sofa. My son played with it there on Saturday.
Girl: Under the sofa I find three more pieces. How many are still missing?
Mr. Yuan: Three. Ninety on the table, three under the sofa, ninety-six in all.

questions.question: How many pieces are still missing?

title: 去草丛里找蚂蚁
material:
Boy: Ms. Song, we want to watch ants today. Where should we look?
Ms. Song: Not on the playground. Look in the grass behind the library, not near the car park.
Boy: My friend says ants come out in the rain. Is that true?
Ms. Song: No, they come out when the ground is dry. Look from the path.

questions.question: Where will the boy look for the ants?

options.A: In the grass behind the library.
options.D: In the grass behind the office building.

title: 晾衣服前先拧干
material:
Girl: Mom, I washed my T-shirt. Can I hang it out now?
Mom: Wring the water out first, not after. Hang it in the sun, not under the balcony.
Girl: It'll take long to dry. Shall I use the dryer?
Mom: No, that makes the shirt smaller. Hang it out before eight, and bring it in before six.

questions.question: When should the girl bring the shirt in?

title: 书法比赛用毛笔
material:
Boy: Mr. Wei, the writing competition is next week. What should I bring?
Mr. Wei: A brush and ink, not a pen or a pencil. Practice twenty minutes a day.
Boy: May I use my mother's brush? Mine is too old.
Mr. Wei: No, borrow one from the art room. Write your name on the handle.

questions.question: What will the boy use to write at the competition?

options.C: A brush from the art room.

title: 历史故事三人来讲
material:
Girl: Ms. Fang, our history class will tell stories on Friday. How many do you need?
Ms. Fang: Three, not four. Each of you has five minutes, not ten.
Girl: I want to tell the one about the Yellow River. May I be first?
Ms. Fang: Yes, you go first. The other two are Li Bo and Chen Jie.

questions.question: Who will tell a story first on Friday?

title: 借自行车要押证件
material:
Boy: Ms. Hu, can I borrow a bicycle from the school? What do I need?
Ms. Hu: Your student card. Not a passport. The lock is already on it, so bring none.
Boy: Do I have to give the card back at once?
Ms. Hu: Yes, at five, when you bring the bike back.

questions.question: What must the boy leave at the office?

title: 罚抄单词二十遍
material:
Boy: Ms. He, I forgot to hand in my homework again. How many times must I copy the word?
Ms. He: Twenty, not ten. Copy it in your notebook, not in the textbook.
Boy: Twenty times? My notebook is nearly full.
Ms. He: Then take a new one. Write it before dinner, not after.

questions.question: How many times must the boy copy the word?

title: 阳台的花两天浇一次水
material:
Boy: Grandma, my flowers look dry. Shall I water them today?
Grandma: I water them every two days. Not every day.
Boy: Every three days, or once a week?
Grandma: Two days, not a week. Water them before breakfast.

questions.question: How often should the boy water the flowers?

title: 水龙头滴水先关总闸
material:
Boy: Dad, the tap in the bathroom drips all night.
Dad: Turn off the main switch under the sink first.
Boy: Shall I buy a new tap, or put a towel under it?
Dad: No towel. It still drips. Call the plumber and send him a video.

questions.question: What should the boy do first?

options.D: Send a video to the plumber.

title: 作文要写什么体裁
material:
Boy: Mr. Hou, our English writing task is due on Friday. What should I write about?
Mr. Hou: A letter to a pen friend, not a diary page.
Boy: A diary page is easier for me.
Mr. Hou: Easier, but the marks want a letter. Start with Dear and keep it to one page.

questions.question: What will the boy write?

options.B: A letter to a pen friend.

title: 牛奶要放哪一层
material:
Boy: Mr. Qi, the milk is warm. Which shelf should it go on?
Mr. Qi: The second shelf from the top, not the door side.
Boy: My father put it on the bottom last time.
Mr. Qi: That is why it went bad. Take it out at night.

questions.question: Where should the boy put the milk?

options.C: On the second shelf from the top.

title: 老年食堂周日不开门
material:
Boy: Grandpa, shall we eat at the old people's canteen on Sunday?
Grandpa: It is closed on Sunday. Your mother is coming at twelve.
Boy: Then shall I buy lunch at the shop?
Grandpa: No need. I cook at half past eleven. We eat together at twelve.

questions.question: What will Grandpa do at half past eleven on Sunday?

options.A: Take the boy to the old people's canteen.

title: 写作比赛最多写三百字
material:
Mr. Ma: The writing contest is next Monday. Read the notice.
Girl: How many words can I write?
Mr. Ma: No more than three hundred. Five hundred is too many.
Girl: So one hundred words is too few?
Mr. Ma: Two hundred is fine. Three hundred is the limit.

questions.question: How many words at most can the girl write?

title: 图书角的新书谁登记
material:
Girl: Mr. Wu, four new books are on the shelf today.
Mr. Wu: Who writes them in the book corner book?
Girl: The monitor did it last term. Shall I do it now?
Mr. Wu: No. Ms. Hu keeps that book. I only keep the reading list.

questions.question: Who writes the new books in the book corner book?

title: 寒假读书每天二十分钟
material:
Boy: Ms. Bai, I read for half an hour, but it's only cartoons.
Ms. Bai: How many minutes of a real book?
Boy: Ten minutes, I think. An hour is too long.
Ms. Bai: Twenty minutes is enough. Do it at the same time each day.

questions.question: How long should the boy read a real book each day?

title: 钓鱼六点半出发
material:
Dad: Tomorrow is Saturday. We are going fishing at the lake.
Boy: Shall we set out at six, or at seven?
Dad: At half past six. It takes an hour to get there.
Boy: Shall I bring my hat?
Dad: Bring a hat and some water. We come back at ten.

questions.question: What time will they set out on Saturday?

title: 班会讲故事讲五分钟
material:
Mr. Qi: The class meeting is at three on Monday. How long can you talk?
Girl: Can we talk for ten minutes?
Mr. Qi: Ten is too long. Five for the story, two for the questions.
Girl: Half an hour for our group, then?
Mr. Qi: Half an hour is for the whole class.

questions.question: How long can the girl's group talk about its story?

title: 洗照片四点去取
material:
Boy: Ms. Song, how long do photo prints take?
Ms. Song: One hour at the shop near the cinema.
Boy: Then at one, or at six after my dinner?
Ms. Song: Come at four. The shop closes at five, and at six it is dark.

questions.question: When should the boy come back for the photos?

title: 体育课穿哪双鞋
material:
Mr. Fu: Tomorrow's PE class is on the playground, not in the gym.
Boy: Shall I wear my new shoes?
Mr. Fu: No. New ones are too narrow.
Boy: What about my old canvas ones, or my running shoes?
Mr. Fu: The canvas pair is flat. Take the running shoes, not leather ones.

questions.question: Which shoes should the boy wear for the PE class?

title: 三盒彩笔二十四元
material:
Girl: Mr. Guo, I want three boxes of crayons for our art class.
Mr. Guo: One box is eight yuan.
Girl: Two boxes would be sixteen. I have twenty yuan.
Mr. Guo: Three boxes are twenty-four, and twenty is not enough.
Girl: What about thirty-two?
Mr. Guo: No. Three boxes for your class.

questions.question: How much do the three boxes of crayons cost?

title: 周日素描课八点半开始
material:
Ms. Zheng: Are you going to the Children's Palace this Sunday?
Boy: Yes. My sketch class begins at nine.
Ms. Zheng: The gates open at eight, but your class is half past eight.
Boy: Then not at nine? Shall I go at ten?
Ms. Zheng: Take your drawing board. Ten is too late.

questions.question: What time does the boy's sketch class begin this Sunday?

title: 月底自己抄水电表
material:
Ms. Sun: The water office sends someone to read our meter.
Boy: When, Mum? I never see anyone.
Ms. Sun: On the last day of the month, before six.
Boy: Shall I leave the number on the door for them?
Ms. Sun: Read it yourself on Friday. We pay online, not in cash.

questions.question: What should the boy do on Friday?

options.A: Leave the number on the door.
options.B: Wait at home for the office worker.
options.D: Pay the water bill in cash.

title: 盆栽换个大点的盆
material:
Girl: Ms. Hu, my plant doesn't look well. The pot is too small.
Ms. Hu: Move it into a bigger pot tomorrow, but a medium one.
Girl: How much soil? A full bag is ten yuan.
Ms. Hu: Half a bag is enough. Put it by the window, not in the hall.

questions.question: What will the girl do with the plant tomorrow?

options.A: Move it into a large pot.
options.B: Move it into a medium pot.
options.C: Leave it in the small pot by the window.
options.D: Move it to a big pot in the hall.

title: 遥控器要几节电池
material:
Boy: Grandma, the remote control does not work. How many batteries?
Grandma: Two, not one. Change them every year.
Boy: My cousin changes them every month.
Grandma: That is too often. Put them back before you sleep.

questions.question: How many batteries does the remote control need?

title: 洗衣粉要放多少
material:
Girl: Mr. Fang, my father is washing. How much powder shall I put in?
Mr. Fang: For these five kilos of clothes, use half a bag.
Girl: The bag holds two kilos. My friend pours in a whole bag.
Mr. Fang: Don't. Soak the shirts for ten minutes, then wash them by hand.

questions.question: How much washing powder will the girl put in?

title: 羊毛衫要选冷水档
material:
Boy: Ms. Guo, my shirt is wool. Which program shall I choose?
Ms. Guo: Not the thirty-degree cotton one. Wool needs the cold program.
Boy: How long does the cold program take?
Ms. Guo: Fifty minutes. The quick one is only fifteen, and that is not enough for wool.
Boy: Then I shall dry it flat, not in the machine.

questions.question: Which program does Ms. Guo tell the boy to use?

title: 买鱼要不要代杀
material:
Boy: Aunt Xue, I'm buying a fish at the market. Should she kill it?
Aunt Xue: Yes, she does that for free. Ask her to clean it as well.
Boy: I need it only for tonight. My mother comes home late.
Aunt Xue: Then buy a big one, about one kilo, not the small ones.

questions.question: Which fish will the boy buy?

options.C: A big fish of two kilos.
options.D: A big fish of about one kilo.

title: 带饭要热几分钟
material:
Girl: Mr. Du, I bring a lunch box to school. How long should I heat it?
Mr. Du: Five minutes in the microwave, not three. Turn it over midway.
Girl: My friend heats hers for ten minutes. Her rice gets very dry.
Mr. Du: Let her add a little water and take the box back on Friday.

questions.question: How long should the girl heat her lunch?

title: 拍毕业照提前多久到
material:
Girl: Mr. Bai, our class photo is on Saturday. When shall we get to the park?
Mr. Bai: Be there at eight in the morning, not at nine.
Girl: The shop says nine. It is twenty-five minutes' walk from here.
Mr. Bai: Then leave home at half past seven. Bring your red scarf.

questions.question: When shall the class get to the park on Saturday?

options.B: At half past seven in the morning.
options.D: At half past eight in the morning.

title: 一分钟跳绳要练多少个
material:
Boy: Ms. Qi, our class has a rope-skipping test. How many shall I do in a minute?
Ms. Qi: Aim at a hundred and twenty, not a hundred and fifty.
Boy: I can only jump eighty now.
Ms. Qi: Do it at seven in the morning, before breakfast. Ten minutes a day is enough.

questions.question: How many jumps should the boy aim at in a minute?

title: 停电了在家吃面包
material:
Boy: Ms. Pei, our building has no electricity tonight. Can we cook dinner?
Ms. Pei: No. The repair men come at seven, so the lights are off until nine.
Boy: Shall we eat at the restaurant near the gate?
Ms. Pei: No. Eat the bread and eggs at home. I have two loaves here.

questions.question: What will they eat tonight?

options.A: Dinner at the restaurant near the gate.
options.B: Nothing at all, because there is no electricity.
options.C: Bread and eggs at Ms. Pei's home.
options.D: Bread and eggs at the restaurant near the gate.

title: 网断了先用手机流量
material:
Girl: Mr. Yan, my home net is down again. My homework is on the computer.
Mr. Yan: Call the company before seven. It opens at eight, not at nine.
Girl: The line was busy last time. A man comes at ten tomorrow.
Mr. Yan: Use your phone's data today. Don't change the router yourself.

questions.question: What will the girl do with her homework today?

options.A: Use the data on her phone.
options.C: Wait at home until the man comes.
options.D: Call the company at nine tomorrow.

title: 图书角还缺几本书
material:
Boy: Ms. Lu, our class reading corner has only twelve books. Can we donate more?
Ms. Lu: Yes. We need thirty in all, so bring eighteen from home.
Boy: My sister has ten. I have read them all twice already.
Ms. Lu: Give her old ones, not the new storybooks. Put them on the shelf today.

questions.question: How many books should the boy bring from home?

title: 衬衫的扣子掉了
material:
Girl: Ms. Shao, a button came off my white shirt. Where shall I take it?
Ms. Shao: A small shop near the station can do it for five yuan.
Girl: I have no time before six. Can I do it myself?
Ms. Shao: Yes, use white thread. Don't use the black one in your mother's box.

questions.question: What will the girl do about the button?

options.A: Take the shirt to a shop near the station.
options.B: Sew it on herself with white thread.
options.C: Sew it on with the black thread in her mother's box.
options.D: Buy a new white shirt at the shop.

title: 晒被子要晒多久
material:
Boy: Ms. Yu, my mother wants to dry the quilt on the roof.
Ms. Yu: Put it up at ten in the morning and take it in at one.
Boy: It rained at three last week, so my friend's quilt got wet.
Ms. Yu: That's right. Dry it on the sunny side, not the north side.

questions.question: When should the boy take the quilt in?

title: 楼道里的纸箱谁搬走
material:
Girl: Mr. Hou, three big boxes have stood in our hallway for two days.
Mr. Hou: Don't move them yourself. Ask Mr. Li on the fifth floor.
Girl: He says they are not his. A moving man brought them on Sunday.
Mr. Hou: Then call the manager's number on the wall.

questions.question: Whom should the girl call about the boxes?

options.A: Mr. Li on the fifth floor.
options.B: The moving man who brought them.
options.D: Nobody; leave the boxes where they are.

title: 单词一天记多少个
material:
Girl: Mr. Kan, I want to learn more English words. How many a day?
Mr. Kan: Fifteen new ones, not thirty. Ten of them before breakfast.
Girl: I write all thirty in my notebook. I never go over them again.
Mr. Kan: Go over the old ten first. Review them on Sunday, not on Friday.

questions.question: How many new words should the girl learn a day?

title: 迟到要罚站多久
material:
Boy: Ms. He, I got to school at seven fifty-two. Class begins at eight.
Ms. He: Yes, you are eight minutes late.
Boy: How long must I stand outside?
Ms. He: One minute for every minute you are late, so eight minutes by the door.
Boy: All right. Eight minutes.

questions.question: How long must the boy stand outside the classroom?

title: 早读几点开始
material:
Ms. Zhou: Our English reading starts at eight. The bell rings at eight.
Boy: But the first class begins at eight forty.
Ms. Zhou: Right. Reading comes first, so leave home at seven twenty.
Boy: Seven twenty, then eight for reading. Thank you, Ms. Zhou.

questions.question: When should the boy leave home for English reading?

title: 午休后几点回教室
material:
Girl: Mr. Ding, what time does lunch end?
Mr. Ding: Lunch is from eleven forty to twelve twenty.
Girl: And after that?
Mr. Ding: Twenty minutes' quiet time, so we go back at twelve forty.
Girl: Twelve twenty to twelve forty. That is twenty minutes.

questions.question: When will the students go back to class after lunch?

title: 二十四支铅笔怎么分
material:
Boy: Ms. Fan, we have twenty-four new pencils for the art class.
Ms. Fan: There are six of you. Share them equally.
Boy: Twenty-four for six. So each of us gets four, right?
Ms. Fan: Exactly. Not five, and keep the two long rulers in the box.

questions.question: How many pencils will each student get?

title: 离开教室要关什么
material:
Girl: Mr. Ye, our classroom is dark after the last class. Who turns off the computer?
Mr. Ye: The last student out does it. Switch off the computer, the screen and the lights.
Girl: What about the fan in summer?
Mr. Ye: The fan too, not only the lights.
Girl: Computer, screen, lights and fan. Four things.

questions.question: What should the last student switch off before leaving?

options.A: The computer, the screen and the fan.
options.B: The lights and the screen only.
options.C: The computer, the screen, the lights and the fan.

title: 煮鸡蛋要几分钟
material:
Girl: Grandma, the water is boiling. How long do we cook the eggs?
Grandma: Put the eggs in now, and count eight minutes on the clock.
Girl: Eight minutes, not ten? My mother usually says ten.
Grandma: Ten is too long. Take them out at eight and put them in cold water.

questions.question: How long should the girl cook the eggs?

title: 洗衣机要转多久
material:
Boy: Mum, these clothes are dirty. How long does the machine take?
Mum: It washes for thirty-five minutes, then rinses twice, five minutes each.
Boy: So thirty-five plus five plus five?
Mum: That's forty-five minutes in all. Hang them out right after.

questions.question: How long does the washing machine take altogether?

title: 仙人球多久浇一次水
material:
Boy: Mr. Bai, I bought a small cactus for my desk. How often should I water it?
Mr. Bai: In winter, once every twenty days. Not every day.
Boy: Then in summer it needs more, doesn't it?
Mr. Bai: Yes, every ten days, and never twice on the same day.

questions.question: How often should the boy water the cactus in winter?

title: 指甲多久剪一次
material:
Girl: Ms. Qi, my fingernails are getting long. How often should I cut them?
Ms. Qi: Once a week. Boys often cut them every two weeks.
Girl: Every two weeks seems too long for me.
Ms. Qi: Then cut yours on Sunday night. Short ones are easier to keep clean.

questions.question: How often should the girl cut her fingernails?

title: 电梯坏了走几层
material:
Boy: Mr. Ren, the lift is not working today. How many floors do I walk?
Mr. Ren: You live on the seventh, not the tenth. Seven floors, ten minutes.
Boy: Ten minutes? With two bags of books?
Mr. Ren: Take them one at a time. Do not wait for the lift at noon.

questions.question: How many floors does the boy need to walk?

title: 配眼镜要等几天
material:
Girl: Ms. Han, I need new glasses. How long do they take to make?
Ms. Han: Four days. You choose the frames today and come back on Thursday.
Girl: Not tomorrow? My old ones broke on Tuesday.
Ms. Han: You can still see with them for four days. Do not buy new frames.

questions.question: When can the girl pick up her new glasses?

title: 星期几还钱
material:
Boy: Mr. Xu, my cousin lent me twenty yuan last week. What should I do?
Mr. Xu: Pay him back on Friday, not today.
Boy: Should I also buy him a gift?
Mr. Xu: No need. Pay the money first, and keep the change in your wallet.

questions.question: When should the boy pay his cousin back?

title: 楼道灯坏了找谁说
material:
Boy: Ms. Guo, the light on our stair is out. Who do I tell?
Ms. Guo: Call the office on the first floor, not the shop next door.
Boy: The office closes at five, so I cannot go after class.
Ms. Guo: Then tell your landlord on your way home, not at the office.

questions.question: Who should the boy tell about the broken light today?

options.C: The office on the first floor.

title: 肉要放多久才能切
material:
Boy: Dad, I took the meat out of the fridge. Can I cut it now?
Dad: No. Leave it on the table for forty minutes.
Boy: Forty minutes? My mother says half an hour.
Dad: Half an hour is for thin meat. Ours is thick, so wait forty minutes.

questions.question: How long must the boy wait before cutting the meat?

title: 洗手要洗多久
material:
Girl: Ms. Song, how long should I wash my hands before lunch?
Ms. Song: Twenty seconds with soap, not ten, and rub the backs of your hands.
Girl: Twenty seconds? That sounds shorter than I thought.
Ms. Song: Count to twenty out loud. Then dry them with your own towel.

questions.question: How long should the girl wash her hands with soap?

title: 校车坐过站
material:
Boy: Ms. Fang, I fell asleep and the school bus went past my stop.
Ms. Fang: Don't worry. The bus turns round at the next stop.
Boy: Shall I walk back from there?
Ms. Fang: No. Get off there and wait. It comes back at half past four.

questions.question: What should the boy do when the bus goes past his stop?

options.A: Get off at the next stop and wait for the bus back.
options.B: Get off at the next stop and walk back to his stop.
options.C: Stay on the bus and ride to the school gate.
options.D: Ask the driver to turn back at once.

title: 灭火器先拔保险销
material:
Boy: Mr. Fang, the fire box is by the stairs. Can we use the extinguisher?
Mr. Fang: Yes, but pull out the safety pin first, not the handle.
Boy: Where do I send the water?
Mr. Fang: Aim at the base of the fire. Never use water on a cooking-oil fire.

questions.question: What should the boy do first with the extinguisher?

options.A: Send the water at the top of the fire.
options.D: Use water on the cooking-oil fire.

title: 坐后排要系安全带
material:
Girl: Ms. Ma, Uncle Li drives us to the park. May I sit in the back?
Ms. Ma: Yes, but the seat belt must be on. Sit in the back, not Uncle Li's lap.
Girl: The road is short. Is it still necessary?
Ms. Ma: Yes. Buckle up before the car starts, every time.

questions.question: Where will the girl sit in Uncle Li's car?

options.B: In the back seat with the seat belt on.
options.C: In the front seat next to Uncle Li.
options.D: In the back seat without the seat belt.

title: 闻到燃气味先关阀门
material:
Boy: Mr. Du, I smell gas in the kitchen.
Mr. Du: Close the gas valve first. Do not turn on a light and do not make a phone call here.
Boy: Shall I open the window?
Mr. Du: Not yet. Go downstairs and tell the manager. Call from outside.

questions.question: What should the boy do first?

options.B: Open the window in the kitchen.
options.C: Turn on the light to look for the leak.
options.D: Call his mother from the kitchen.

title: 打雷下雨躲到礼堂
material:
Girl: Ms. Yu, a storm is coming. Shall we wait under the big tree?
Ms. Yu: No. The tree is the worst place. Go to the hall with your friends.
Girl: What about the bike shed?
Ms. Yu: No, it is full of water. Stay in the hall until the rain stops.

questions.question: Where should the girls wait during the storm?

title: 见人落水不要自己下水
material:
Boy: Ms. Bai, a boy fell into the river!
Ms. Bai: Shout for help. Throw him a pole or a ball. Do not jump in yourself.
Boy: I can swim well.
Ms. Bai: Not this time. Call 110 from the bank and wait for the boat.

questions.question: What should the boy do instead of jumping in?

options.A: Swim across the river to him.
options.B: Throw the boy a pole or a ball.
options.D: Take a boat out on the river.

title: 走丢了在服务台等
material:
Girl: Mr. Zhou, I can't find my mother. She went to the shoe shop on the second floor.
Mr. Zhou: Stay at the service desk. Dad is waiting by the car.
Girl: Can I go upstairs and look for her?
Mr. Zhou: No. Stay here. She will come back to the desk.

questions.question: Where should the girl wait for her mother?

title: 陌生人的糖不能收
material:
Boy: Mr. Cui, a man at the gate gave me a sweet.
Mr. Cui: Throw it away. Take nothing from a stranger.
Boy: He knows my teacher.
Mr. Cui: Still no. Go and stand with your class at the gate.

questions.question: What should the boy do with the sweet?

options.B: Eat it, because the man knows his teacher.
options.D: Take it home for his sister.

title: 电梯里靠右站
material:
Girl: Mr. Liang, everyone pushes in when the lift arrives.
Mr. Liang: Yes. Let the people inside come out first.
Girl: Then I enter last, don't I?
Mr. Liang: Right. Stand on the right side and keep the door clear.

questions.question: Where should the girl stand in the lift?

options.A: In the middle of the lift.
options.B: Right in front of the door.

title: 药要放在高处
material:
Girl: Ms. Yan, my little brother says the pills in the box are sweets.
Ms. Yan: Keep all medicine in a high cupboard. Never count a pill as a sweet.
Girl: What should I do if he takes one?
Ms. Yan: Take him to the doctor at once and take the box with you.

questions.question: Where should the medicine be kept?

options.D: In a drawer by the bed.

title: 割破手指先用自来水冲
material:
Boy: Ms. Fu, I cut my finger on the tin.
Ms. Fu: Wash it under the tap first, not with your mouth.
Boy: Does it need a plaster?
Ms. Fu: A clean one, yes. Ask the school nurse, not your friend.

questions.question: What should the boy do first with the cut on his finger?

options.B: Put his finger in his mouth.
options.D: Ask his friend for a plaster.

title: 红灯要停在斑马线
material:
Boy: Mr. Gao, the lights are red but no car is coming.
Mr. Gao: Wait. Red means stop, even for a minute. Use the zebra crossing.
Boy: May I cross behind the bus?
Mr. Gao: No. Wait at the crossing, not behind a bus.

questions.question: Where should the boy wait before crossing the road?

options.B: In the middle of the road.
options.D: On the pavement by the bus stop.

title: 大风天把阳台东西收进来
material:
Girl: Ms. Ge, the wind is very strong. Shall we open the window?
Ms. Ge: No. Keep this one closed, and close the balcony window.
Girl: What about my clothes on the balcony?
Ms. Ge: Take them inside and bring the flower pot in as well.

questions.question: What will the girl do on the balcony?

options.A: Leave her clothes on the balcony.
options.C: Put the flower pot on the roof.
options.D: Take the clothes and the flower pot inside.

title: 地面没干走另一部楼梯
material:
Boy: Mr. Du, the floor by the stairs is wet.
Mr. Du: Yes, someone mopped it. Walk round, not across.
Boy: Is it still wet?
Mr. Du: The sign says dry at four. Before that, use the other stairs.

questions.question: What should the boy do before four o'clock?

options.D: Stand by the wet floor and wait.

title: 火警下楼走楼梯
material:
Girl: Mr. Pei, the alarm is ringing. Shall we take the lift down?
Mr. Pei: No. Use the stairs. The lift may stop at any floor.
Girl: Where do we leave our bags?
Mr. Pei: Take them with you. Gather at the sports ground, not the hall.

questions.question: Where will the girls gather after leaving the building?

title: 食堂没带饭卡
material:
Boy: Ms. Lu, I left my meal card at home. Can I pay with cash?
Ms. Lu: No, we can't take cash. Go to the office and ask for a temp card.
Boy: Will the office be open at lunch?
Ms. Lu: Yes, it is open from eleven to one. Pay me back this afternoon.

questions.question: How should the boy pay for his lunch today?

options.A: Pay with cash at the door.
options.B: Get a temp card from the office.
options.C: Go home to fetch his meal card.
options.D: Ask the office worker for money instead.

title: 图书馆的书要放回推车
material:
Girl: Mr. Ren, I read a book from shelf 12. Where do I put it back?
Mr. Ren: Return it to the trolley, not shelf 12. The number on the spine is 12-B.
Girl: So 12-B goes on the trolley until the librarian checks it.
Mr. Ren: Right. Books on the trolley are counted on Friday.

questions.question: Where should the girl put the book back?

title: 照片留三张今天交
material:
Boy: Ms. Lu, how many photos do we bring tomorrow?
Ms. Lu: Four one-inch photos in all. One goes on the form, and three come today.
Boy: Does my mother have to bring them tomorrow?
Ms. Lu: No, she should send them today. The office closes at four.

questions.question: How many photos will the boy's mother send today?

title: 旧校服交到班主任手里
material:
Girl: Mr. Guo, when do we get our new school clothes?
Mr. Guo: On Monday, after the last class. Not on Tuesday.
Girl: Do I bring the old ones back?
Mr. Guo: Yes, hand them to me in the hall, not to the office.

questions.question: What should the girl do with her old school clothes?

options.A: Give them to the office on Tuesday.
options.C: Hand them to Mr. Guo in the hall.

title: 合唱比赛穿白衬衫黑裤子
material:
Boy: Ms. Hu, what do we wear for the singing show?
Ms. Hu: A white shirt and black trousers. Not blue jeans.
Boy: My sister has a blue shirt at home.
Ms. Hu: Don't wear jeans. The show is on Friday morning in the hall.

questions.question: What will the boy wear for the singing show?

options.A: Blue jeans and a white shirt.
options.B: A white shirt and black trousers.
options.D: His sister's blue shirt and jeans.

title: 借教室要老师签字
material:
Girl: Ms. Qian, can our class use room 14 on Thursday afternoon?
Ms. Qian: Ask the office one day before. You cannot write on the form today.
Girl: Who has to sign the form?
Ms. Qian: Your head teacher, not the class monitor or me. The office only takes the paper.

questions.question: Who has to sign the form for room 14?

title: 下车要提前按铃
material:
Boy: Mr. Hu, how do we get off the bus?
Mr. Hu: Press the bell before the stop. Not after the doors open.
Boy: What if the bus is full at the front?
Mr. Hu: Walk to the back door, not the middle. Stand near the door.

questions.question: When should the boy press the bell?

title: 鞋湿了塞报纸晾干
material:
Girl: Ms. He, my shoes are wet after the rain.
Ms. He: Take them off and dry them first. Do not wear wet socks.
Girl: Can I dry them on the radiator?
Ms. He: No, not there. Put paper in them and leave them by the door.

questions.question: How should the girl dry her shoes?

options.A: Put paper in them and leave them by the door.
options.C: Wear them while they are wet.
options.D: Leave them in the sun on the balcony.

title: 阅览室九点关门
material:
Boy: Ms. Niu, when do the lights go out in our building?
Ms. Niu: At ten. The gate is locked at ten fifteen.
Boy: Can I study in the reading room then?
Ms. Niu: No, only until nine. The reading room closes at nine.

questions.question: Until what time can the boy study in the reading room?

title: 图书馆不能吃东西
material:
Girl: Mr. Zou, may I eat a sandwich in the library?
Mr. Zou: No. Food is not allowed here. Use the reading room upstairs.
Girl: Can I drink water at my desk?
Mr. Zou: A bottle with a cap is fine, but no juice boxes.

questions.question: What may the girl do at her desk in the library?

options.B: Drink water from a bottle with a cap.

title: 袖子破了找秦老师缝
material:
Boy: Mr. Ma, my sleeve is open at the seam.
Mr. Ma: Take it to Ms. Qian on the first floor. She mends clothes after four.
Boy: Is it free for students?
Mr. Ma: Yes, free. Bring the old uniform, not the new one.

questions.question: Who will mend the boy's sleeve?

options.A: Ms. Qian on the first floor.
options.C: The class teacher on the third floor.

title: 超市排队站在队尾
material:
Girl: Ms. Wu, there is only one till open.
Ms. Wu: Wait in line. Go to the end of the line, not the front.
Girl: Can I use my phone and pay?
Ms. Wu: Not for this shop. Pay at the till, not online.

questions.question: Where should the girl wait to pay?

options.A: At the front of the line.
options.B: At the till with her phone.
options.C: Outside the shop on her phone.
options.D: At the end of the line.

title: 换零钱只能去银行
material:
Boy: Mr. Ni, I need coins for the class sale.
Mr. Ni: The shop won't change a fifty. Go to the bank counter before four.
Boy: Can I change it at the school office?
Mr. Ni: No. Only the bank has coins for us. Come back by five.

questions.question: Where can the boy get coins?

title: 买药要医生写处方
material:
Girl: Ms. Ren, can I buy these cough tablets here?
Ms. Ren: Not without a doctor's note. You need a prescription.
Girl: My father is a doctor. Will that do?
Ms. Ren: His work card is not enough. He must write the prescription, then she comes back at four.

questions.question: What must the girl's father do before she buys the tablets?

options.A: Give the shop his work card.
options.C: Come to the shop at four with her.

title: 上课铃响老师没来
material:
Girl: Mr. Mu, the bell has rung and Ms. Bai is not here.
Mr. Mu: Wait five minutes. Then knock on the office door.
Girl: Shall we go back to our classroom?
Mr. Mu: Stay in the corridor, not in the classroom or the playground. Sit on the bench.

questions.question: What should the girls do first?

options.A: Wait in the corridor for five minutes.
options.B: Go back to the classroom and study.
options.C: Knock on the office door at once.
options.D: Sit on the bench in the playground.

title: 订两桶桶装水
material:
Boy: Ms. Liang, our water bottle is empty.
Ms. Liang: Call 6321 and order two. A full one costs eighteen yuan.
Boy: Do we pay the man who brings it?
Ms. Liang: Yes, pay him at the door. Don't send me a message.

questions.question: How much will the boy pay for two bottles of water?

title: 换灯泡要一百瓦
material:
Girl: Mr. He, the bulb in the hall has gone.
Mr. He: Buy a hundred-watt bulb, not a forty-watt one.
Girl: The old bulb says sixty watts. Why change it?
Mr. He: The room is dark now. A hundred watts is right. Fit it after you cut the power.

questions.question: Which bulb should the girl buy?

title: 春节前贴春联
material:
Girl: Mr. Wu, when shall we put up the couplets?
Mr. Wu: On New Year's Eve, before sunset. Not on the first morning.
Girl: Should we use glue or nails?
Mr. Wu: Glue, on the old paper. Take the old one down first.

questions.question: When will they put up the new couplets?

options.A: On the first morning of the year.
options.B: On New Year's Eve after sunset.
options.C: On New Year's Eve before sunset.
options.D: On New Year's Eve after dinner.

title: 厨房油污用洗洁精
material:
Boy: Mr. Zhou, there is oil on the kitchen wall.
Mr. Zhou: Use washing-up liquid and warm water. Not the dry powder.
Boy: How long must I wait after?
Mr. Zhou: Two minutes, then wipe it. The powder leaves white marks.

questions.question: What should the boy use to clean the oily wall?

title: 订煤气要留电话号码
material:
Girl: Ms. Gong, our gas bottle is nearly empty.
Ms. Gong: Ring the shop and leave your phone number.
Girl: Should I tell him which floor we live on?
Ms. Gong: Yes, the fourth floor. He comes in the morning, not at night.

questions.question: When will the gas man come?

title: 客人来了擦桌子
material:
Boy: Mr. Dai, my uncle is coming for dinner.
Mr. Dai: Wipe the table first. Cover it with the blue cloth, not the white one.
Boy: Shall I set out the big bowls?
Mr. Dai: Four people, so four small bowls. Put the big bowl away.

questions.question: How many small bowls should the boy set out?

title: 车位被占找保安
material:
Girl: Mr. Tong, another car is in my parking place.
Mr. Tong: Take the number of the car. Go to the office, not to the street.
Girl: Can I move the car myself?
Mr. Tong: No. The security man will move it. Don't call the police.

questions.question: Who will move the other car out of the parking place?

title: 窗帘布要两倍宽
material:
Girl: Mr. Yuan, how do I choose curtains for my room?
Mr. Yuan: Measure the window first. A wide one needs a double rail.
Girl: My window is 120 wide and 150 high.
Mr. Yuan: Then the cloth must be 240 wide, not 120. That is twice the width.

questions.question: How wide should the cloth be?

title: 换床单要三床
material:
Girl: Ms. Tao, how many sheets do I need for the two beds?
Ms. Tao: Two for the beds, one for your mother's bed. Three in all.
Girl: Do I wash the old ones first?
Ms. Tao: Wash them at the weekend. Not tonight.

questions.question: How many sheets will the girl wash at the weekend?

title: 腌咸菜放五十克盐
material:
Boy: Mr. Hu, how much salt do we need for one kilo of vegetables?
Mr. Hu: Fifty grams. Not eighty, or the food turns black.
Boy: Do we weigh it?
Mr. Hu: Yes, with the kitchen scale. Two hundred grams is too much.

questions.question: How much salt will the boy use for one kilo of vegetables?

title: 电饭煲预约六点半
material:
Boy: Mr. Fu, can the rice cooker start by itself?
Mr. Fu: Yes. Set it for six thirty, and dinner is ready at seven.
Boy: I have to leave at seven ten for football practice.
Mr. Fu: Then leave the cooker on, not off. It keeps warm for two hours.

questions.question: What time should the boy set the rice cooker?

title: 擦玻璃要用两块布
material:
Girl: Mr. Cui, the window in my room is very dirty.
Mr. Cui: Use two cloths, one wet and one dry. Not one cloth for both.
Girl: Is there a special order?
Mr. Cui: Wash the top first, then the bottom. Never use your sleeve.

questions.question: How many cloths does the girl need to clean the window?

title: 电视没图像先拔插头
material:
Boy: Mr. Wei, the TV has no picture today.
Mr. Wei: Unplug it and plug it in again. Don't press the buttons.
Boy: Should I call the repair man?
Mr. Wei: Try that first. Call him only if it still fails after ten minutes.

questions.question: When should the boy call the repair man?

options.D: After ten minutes if it still fails.

title: 地毯要用吸尘器
material:
Girl: Mr. Guo, our carpet is full of dust.
Mr. Guo: Vacuum it twice, not once. Move the chairs first.
Girl: Can I clean it with a wet cloth?
Mr. Guo: No, that is for the floor. Use the vacuum, not water.

questions.question: How should the girl clean the carpet?

title: 修鞋摊搬到市场东门
material:
Girl: Mr. Hao, my boots are broken. Is the shoe stall open today?
Mr. Hao: No. He moved to the east gate of the market. He opens at nine.
Girl: Can you mend them here?
Mr. Hao: I can't. Bring them back tomorrow and I will show you the way.

questions.question: Where is the shoe stall now?

options.A: At the west gate of the market.
options.C: At the east gate of the market.

title: 打印一页两毛钱
material:
Boy: Mr. Long, I want to print my report.
Mr. Long: Twenty cents a page. For twelve pages that is two yuan forty.
Boy: Can I print it in colour?
Mr. Long: No, black and white only. Colour is two yuan a page.

questions.question: How much will the boy pay for twelve black-and-white pages?

title: 放大照片三天取
material:
Girl: Mr. Yu, can you enlarge these photos today?
Mr. Yu: No. It takes three days. Come on Friday, not on Thursday.
Girl: How much is one big print?
Mr. Yu: Six yuan each. The small ones are two yuan.

questions.question: When should the girl come to collect the big prints?

title: 打车八公里二十元
material:
Girl: Mr. Hao, how much is the taxi from here to the station?
Mr. Hao: Ten yuan for the first three kilometres, then two yuan a kilometre.
Girl: It's about eight kilometres, isn't it?
Mr. Hao: Yes. So ten plus five times two, twenty yuan.

questions.question: How much will the girl pay for the taxi?

title: 话费要去营业厅充
material:
Girl: Mr. Xia, I have no money on my phone.
Mr. Xia: The school shop can't do that. Go to the service hall.
Girl: Can I pay by card at the hall?
Mr. Xia: Yes, or in cash. The hall closes at six.

questions.question: Where can the girl top up her phone?

title: 加油要加五十升
material:
Boy: Mr. Gu, my tank holds fifty litres and it is empty now.
Mr. Gu: Then fill it up. Fifty litres, not thirty.
Boy: Is it seven yuan a litre?
Mr. Gu: Seven yuan twenty. Fifty litres is three hundred sixty yuan.

questions.question: How much will the boy pay for the fuel?

title: 洗车要等一小时
material:
Girl: Mr. Yu, how long do I have to wait for the car?
Mr. Yu: About an hour. The queue has six cars in it.
Girl: Can I wait in the car park?
Mr. Yu: Wait in the coffee shop, not in the car park.

questions.question: Where should the girl wait?

title: 课间操要做五分钟
material:
Boy: Ms. Qi, how long is the break-time exercise?
Ms. Qi: Five minutes, not ten. We do it on the ground.
Boy: What music do we use?
Ms. Qi: The bell rings when we start, not when we stop.

questions.question: How long will the boy do the break-time exercise?

title: 卫生评比由班长记分
material:
Girl: Mr. Ren, who writes down the scores for the clean-class check?
Mr. Ren: The class monitor, not the cleaning boy.
Girl: What happens if we lose three points?
Mr. Ren: We clean again on Friday. Nobody gets punished.

questions.question: Who writes down the scores?

title: 社团报名周五截止
material:
Boy: Ms. Xiao, can I still join the chess club?
Ms. Xiao: Yes, but the form must reach me by Friday at four.
Boy: Is Monday too late?
Ms. Xiao: Too late. The list goes to the office on Friday evening.

questions.question: When is the last day to join the club?

title: 学费周一交
material:
Girl: Mr. Fan, when is the school fee due?
Mr. Fan: On Monday. The office takes money from eight to eleven.
Girl: My mother comes on Sunday. Is that all right?
Mr. Fan: No, she must come on Monday. Sunday the office is shut.

questions.question: When must the girl's mother come?

title: 放学要排队出校门
material:
Boy: Mr. Han, can I run out of the gate when the bell rings?
Mr. Han: No. Line up by class, then walk out quietly.
Boy: Can my sister wait at the gate for me?
Mr. Han: She must wait outside the rail, not inside the gate.

questions.question: Where should the boy's sister wait?

title: 宿舍洗澡要等多久
material:
Girl: Ms. Qu, how long is the wait for the shower?
Ms. Qu: Fifteen minutes at eight. At ten there is no queue.
Girl: Should I bring my own towel?
Ms. Qu: Yes. The house ones are for the sports class only.

questions.question: How long will the girl wait if she showers at ten?

title: 冬窗上会结霜
material:
Boy: Mr. Ji, my window is white in the morning.
Mr. Ji: That is frost on the inside. Wipe it after the room gets warm.
Boy: Can I use hot water straight away?
Mr. Ji: No. The glass will break. Use warm water, not hot.

questions.question: What should the boy wipe the frost with?

title: 拔河比赛怎么站位
material:
Girl: Mr. Deng, how shall our class stand for the tug of war?
Mr. Deng: Put the strongest boy at the back and the lightest at the front.
Girl: Do we all hold the rope at the same time?
Mr. Deng: Yes, and pull together on the word, not before it.

questions.question: Who should stand at the back of the team?

title: 借来的书要夹书签
material:
Girl: Mr. Zou, I can't finish this book before Monday.
Mr. Zou: Put a paper bookmark in it. Don't fold the page or write on it.
Girl: What if the next reader has no paper?
Mr. Zou: He uses his own. Never tear the corner off the page.

questions.question: What should the girl do before she puts the book back?

options.A: Write her name on the cover.
options.C: Tear the corner off the page.
options.D: Put a paper bookmark in it.

title: 健身器材九点关
material:
Girl: Mr. Guo, when do the exercise machines stop?
Mr. Guo: At nine. They are locked before nine, not after.
Girl: Can I use them on Sunday morning?
Mr. Guo: Yes, from seven. Sunday is the only day it opens early.

questions.question: What time will the girl have to stop using the machines?

title: 单元门要刷卡
material:
Boy: Mr. Hu, the door by the gate is open.
Mr. Hu: Use your card at the main door, not that side door.
Boy: My card is in my bag. Is that all right?
Mr. Hu: Yes, take it out first. The side door has no reader.

questions.question: Where should the boy use his card?

title: 早市七点开门
material:
Girl: Ms. Sun, when does the morning market open?
Ms. Sun: At seven. It closes at eleven, not at noon.
Girl: Is it open on Sunday?
Ms. Sun: Yes, every day except Monday.

questions.question: When does the morning market open?

title: 办老年证要两张照片
material:
Boy: Mr. Lu, what do I need for my grandmother's card?
Mr. Lu: Two photos and the old card. One photo is not enough.
Boy: Is there anything to pay?
Mr. Lu: The photo costs ten yuan. The card itself is free.

questions.question: How many photos does the boy need?

title: 打疫苗要带健康本
material:
Girl: Ms. Ren, do I need anything for the flu shot?
Ms. Ren: Take your health book, not the old card. The nurse writes in it.
Girl: Is there a charge?
Ms. Ren: No, it is free. The shot is given in the hall, not outside.

questions.question: What should the girl take to the flu shot?

title: 活动室最多两小时
material:
Boy: Mr. Hao, can our group book the activity room this afternoon?
Mr. Hao: Yes, but only two hours. Three hours is too long.
Boy: We want to start at two.
Mr. Hao: Then you must be out at four. The room closes at five, but your time ends at four.

questions.question: How long can the boy use the activity room?

title: 居委会开会改周四
material:
Girl: Mr. Wang, when is the residents' meeting?
Mr. Wang: On Thursday at seven in the evening, not on Tuesday.
Girl: Do I need to bring my number card?
Mr. Wang: Just come. Don't sign the list at the door.

questions.question: When is the residents' meeting?

options.D: On Thursday at seven in the evening.

title: 旧衣服送到回收点
material:
Boy: Ms. Kong, my old coats are too small. Where do they go?
Ms. Kong: Take them to the recycling point on Friday, not to the bin.
Boy: Do I have to pay anything?
Ms. Kong: No. Leave them in the green box by the gate.

questions.question: Where should the boy take his old coats?

title: 关东煮晚上才有
material:
Girl: Mr. Long, can I have the hot food now?
Mr. Long: The hot pot is ready only in the evening, not at noon.
Girl: What time does it start?
Mr. Long: At six. In the morning there is only bread.

questions.question: When is the hot food ready?

title: 义诊要带健康本和化验单
material:
Boy: Mr. Gao, what should I take to the free clinic?
Mr. Gao: Your health book and your blood test card. Not a bag of medicine.
Boy: Do I need to make an appointment?
Mr. Gao: No, but come before ten, not after.

questions.question: What should the boy take to the free clinic?

options.A: His health book and blood test card.

title: 草地不能踩要绕行
material:
Girl: Mr. Gu, the short way goes over the grass.
Mr. Gu: Walk round by the trees. The grass is not a path.
Girl: Is it only in summer?
Mr. Gu: All year. The sign by the gate says keep off the grass.

questions.question: How should the girl walk across the square?

title: 信报箱要用小钥匙
material:
Boy: Mr. Tong, my letter box is full and I can't open it.
Mr. Tong: You need the small key from the post office, not a knife.
Boy: Is the post office open now?
Mr. Tong: From half past one to five. The security man has no key, so don't ask him.

questions.question: How should the boy open his letter box?

options.B: With the small key from the post office.
options.C: By asking the postman to force it.
options.D: By asking the security man for his key.

title: 保安要查出入证
material:
Boy: Mr. Ni, can I walk into the building without my pass?
Mr. Ni: No. Show the pass at the desk. Call your host from there.
Boy: Can I ring the bell of his flat?
Mr. Ni: No, that wakes the family up. Use the desk phone.

questions.question: What should the boy do at the gate?

options.C: Show his pass at the desk.
options.D: Wait outside until his friend comes down.

title: 早市的秤要复称
material:
Girl: Mr. Zheng, is this stall's scale honest?
Mr. Zheng: Some stalls are short. Weigh it again at the desk by the gate.
Girl: Does that cost anything?
Mr. Zheng: No. Then pay the right money, not the small sum.

questions.question: What should the girl do with the vegetables?

options.A: Weigh them again at the desk by the gate.
options.B: Buy them at once and leave.
options.C: Pay the small sum the stall asks for.
options.D: Ask the stall owner to add one kilo.

title: 讲座要先签到
material:
Girl: Mr. Xie, can we go straight into the talk?
Mr. Xie: Sign in at the desk first. Without a name card they send you out.
Girl: Is the talk free?
Mr. Xie: Yes. Come at two, not at three.

questions.question: What should the girls do before the talk?

title: 错题要抄进错题本
material:
Girl: Mr. Han, how do I correct my mistakes in the maths book?
Mr. Han: Copy each one in the wrong-answer book and mark it in red.
Girl: Do I have to copy the whole question?
Mr. Han: No, just the question and the right steps. One line is enough.
