questions.question: What should the girl do with her mistakes?

options.A: Copy them in the wrong-answer book and mark them in red.
options.B: Tear the page out and start the book again.
options.C: Write them in a new notebook in pencil.
options.D: Say nothing and wait for the test.

title: 用过的粉笔放托盘
material:
Girl: Mr. Gao, the new box of chalk has only three sticks left.
Mr. Gao: Put the used sticks in the tray under the board, not in the bin or the new box.
Girl: Do the short ones work too?
Mr. Gao: They do. Anyone can take one from the tray at eight.

questions.question: Where should the girl put the used sticks of chalk?

options.C: In the tray under the board.

title: 跟不上只记关键词
material:
Girl: Mr. Pei, the teacher talks too fast for me.
Mr. Pei: Write only the key words, not every sentence.
Girl: Then how do I write it up afterwards?
Mr. Pei: Use those words at night, with the book open.

questions.question: What should the girl write down in class?

options.D: A full copy of the textbook.

title: 饮水机在三楼
material:
Boy: Mr. Niu, where can I get some hot water?
Mr. Niu: The water dispenser is on the third floor, not on this floor.
Boy: Can I bring my own cup?
Mr. Niu: Yes, a plastic cup. Not a glass one.

questions.question: Where is the water dispenser?

title: 实验室的药品不能尝
material:
Girl: Mr. Bao, can I taste this white powder?
Mr. Bao: No. Nothing in the lab tray is for eating, ever.
Girl: Even if it smells like sugar?
Mr. Bao: Especially then. Read the label first and tell me the name.

questions.question: What should the girl do with the white powder?

options.A: Read the label and tell Mr. Bao the name.
options.B: Taste a little to see if it is sugar.
options.C: Put it back in the tray and say nothing.
options.D: Take it home in her bag.

title: 投影仪提前十分钟开
material:
Boy: Mr. Gu, the projector shows nothing.
Mr. Gu: Switch it on ten minutes before the lesson, not at the bell.
Boy: Do I need to call anyone?
Mr. Gu: No, if it still fails then tell me. Don't open the box yourself.

questions.question: When should the boy switch on the projector?

title: 作业交到班级邮箱
material:
Girl: Ms. Wu, how do we hand in the writing homework?
Ms. Wu: Send it to the class email before eight. Paper is not accepted.
Girl: What if the line is busy at eight?
Ms. Wu: Then send it early, not at eight. The box closes at eight.

questions.question: How should the girl hand in the writing homework?

title: 复习先做数学卷
material:
Boy: Mr. Jia, how should I start my revision?
Mr. Jia: Do the maths paper first. It is the one you are worst at.
Boy: How many papers should I do a day?
Mr. Jia: Two, not five. Two papers and a review of the errors.

questions.question: How many papers should the boy do a day?

title: 忘带课本和同桌合看
material:
Girl: Mr. Tong, I left my Chinese book at home.
Mr. Tong: Borrow one from a classmate. Two people can share a book.
Girl: Can I just sit and do nothing?
Mr. Tong: No. Follow the reading on the board, then write it up at home.

questions.question: What should the girl do in class without her book?

options.A: Share a classmate's book and follow the reading on the board.
options.B: Sit and do nothing until the bell.
options.C: Go home and fetch the book.
options.D: Ask the teacher to stop the lesson.

title: 围棋比赛每局二十分钟
material:
Girl: Mr. Bai, when is the go tournament?
Mr. Bai: At two in the afternoon, in the reading room.
Girl: How long do we have for each game?
Mr. Bai: Twenty minutes. Put your watch on the table, not your phone.

questions.question: How long does each game last?

title: 集会按班号站队
material:
Boy: Ms. Kong, how do we line up for the school meeting?
Ms. Kong: By class number, one to forty. Not by height.
Boy: What if my class number is twelve?
Ms. Kong: Then you stand in the middle. Leave the front row to the first class.

questions.question: How should the students line up?

title: 抄完才能擦黑板
material:
Girl: Mr. An, the lesson is over. May I wipe the board?
Mr. An: Wait until the last student has copied it.
Girl: What if I am in a hurry for lunch?
Mr. An: Then ask the class monitor. Don't wipe it on your own.

questions.question: What should the girl do before wiping the board?

options.A: Wipe it at once, because the lesson is over.
options.B: Ask the teacher to wipe it for her.
options.C: Wait until the last student has copied it.
options.D: Wipe it before the next lesson starts.

title: 作业本封面写名字
material:
Girl: Ms. Qiu, my work book has no name on it.
Ms. Qiu: Write your name and class on the front, not inside.
Girl: What about the date?
Ms. Qiu: Every day, in the top corner. Then hand it in on Friday.

questions.question: Where should the girl write her name?

options.A: On the front of the work book.

title: 书按大小摆桌面
material:
Boy: Mr. Zhi, my books are all over the desk.
Mr. Zhi: Put the big ones on the left and the small ones on the right.
Boy: Do I need to do it every morning?
Mr. Zhi: Once a week is enough. Not every morning.

questions.question: How should the boy put the books on his desk?

options.A: All in one pile in the middle.
options.B: Small ones on the left and big ones on the right.
options.C: Big ones on the left and small ones on the right.
options.D: Stack them in any order he likes.

title: 预备铃要马上收书
material:
Girl: Mr. Yu, why does the bell ring twice?
Mr. Yu: The first bell is the prepare bell. Put your books away at once.
Girl: Do we go back to the dorm after the first bell?
Mr. Yu: No, you stay in the classroom. Only the second bell ends the class.

questions.question: What happens at the first bell?

options.B: The students put their books away.

title: 篮球走步只能两步
material:
Boy: Mr. Wei, I caught the ball and ran to the basket.
Mr. Wei: That is walking, not running. You may take two steps, but stop after them.
Boy: Can I walk again if the ball comes back?
Mr. Wei: No. Pivot, but do not step. Then pass or shoot.

questions.question: How many steps may the boy take after catching the ball?

title: 排球不能抱着过网
material:
Girl: Ms. Mao, I caught the ball above the net.
Ms. Mao: Then you must hit it over, not carry it. Holding it is a fault.
Girl: Can I hold it for one second?
Ms. Mao: No. Not one second. Hit it over or lose the rally.

questions.question: What must the girl do with the ball above the net?

options.D: Drop it and let the other team take it.

title: 足球只有守门员用手
material:
Boy: Mr. Zuo, I used my hand to stop the ball.
Mr. Zuo: Only the goalkeeper may use his hands inside his own area.
Boy: What about catching it with my arm on the field?
Mr. Zuo: That is the same fault. Use your chest, not your arm.

questions.question: Who may use his hands to stop the ball?

options.A: Any player inside the penalty area.
options.B: The boy, once in the second half.

title: 羽毛球不能过腰发球
material:
Girl: Mr. Fu, my serve keeps going out.
Mr. Fu: You must hit it below your waist, not above it.
Girl: Can the shuttle touch the net on the serve?
Mr. Fu: It may touch the net. It must not land on the line.

questions.question: Where must the girl hit the shuttle when she serves?

options.D: At the height of her chin.

title: 乒乓球要抛起来打
material:
Boy: Mr. Hu, my serve always goes into the net.
Mr. Hu: Throw the ball up and strike it as it falls. Do not push it.
Boy: How high should the throw be?
Mr. Hu: About twenty centimetres, not fifty. A high throw hits your own racket.

questions.question: How should the boy hit the ball when he serves?

options.A: Throw it up and strike it as it falls.
options.B: Push it gently with his fingers.
options.C: Press it down onto the table with his palm.
options.D: Hold it and drop it onto his own side.

title: 网球要落在对方场里
material:
Girl: Mr. Dai, my shots keep landing in the net.
Mr. Dai: Hit over the net and inside the other court, not outside it.
Girl: Does the ball have to clear the net by a metre?
Mr. Dai: It has to clear the net only. Height does not matter, direction does.

questions.question: Where must the girl's shot land?

options.A: On her own side of the court.
options.C: Inside the other court, over the net.

title: 罚球线后才能进线
material:
Boy: Mr. Gu, I keep stepping over the line before a free throw.
Mr. Gu: Stay behind the free-throw line until the ball is given to you.
Boy: Can I move onto the line to shoot?
Mr. Gu: No. Both feet stay behind the line. Step in only after you release.

questions.question: When may the boy step onto the free-throw line?

options.A: As soon as the ball is given to him.
options.B: Only after he releases the ball.
options.C: Before every shot, to get a better aim.
options.D: Just before the shot, so he can reach the board.

title: 短跑要用蹲踞式起跑
material:
Girl: Ms. Luo, how should I start in the hundred metres?
Ms. Luo: Use a crouch start. One foot in front, the other at your hand.
Girl: Is a standing start better because I am tall?
Ms. Luo: No. Standing start wastes the first half second. Start on "ready".

questions.question: How should the girl start the race?

options.A: Standing up straight with her arms down.
options.B: On her knees, with both hands behind her.
options.D: With one foot in front and the other at her hand.

title: 转身要摸壁再转
material:
Boy: Mr. Guo, I always swim past the wall at the end of the length.
Mr. Guo: Touch the wall with your hand, then turn. Do not stop in the middle.
Boy: Can I turn without touching?
Mr. Guo: No. A turn without a touch means you did not finish the length.

questions.question: What should the boy do at the end of the length?

options.A: Stop in the middle and rest.
options.C: Touch the wall with his hand, then turn.
options.D: Swim to the stairs and climb out.

title: 哨响立刻停下来
material:
Girl: Mr. Fu, the whistle went but I was still running.
Mr. Fu: Stop the moment you hear it. Do not finish the lap.
Girl: Does the other team get the ball?
Mr. Fu: They may take the ball. Walking on is a fault, not a strategy.

questions.question: What should the girl do when the whistle goes?

options.B: Finish the lap and then stop.
options.D: Keep running until she passes the line.

title: 号码要穿在背上
material:
Boy: Mr. Xu, where does the number go on my playing shirt?
Mr. Xu: On the back, above the number of the year. Not on the front.
Boy: And on my shorts?
Mr. Xu: Nothing on the shorts. Numbers are for the back only.

questions.question: Where should the boy put the number on his shirt?

title: 沙包靠肩带动臂
material:
Girl: Mr. Cui, my shot always goes too short.
Mr. Cui: Use the shoulder and the arm together. The elbow must be high.
Girl: Should I use my leg to push?
Mr. Cui: A small step is fine, but the power comes from the shoulder.

questions.question: Where should the power for the shot come from?

options.D: From the shoulder and the arm.

title: 跳高要等裁判信号
material:
Boy: Mr. Han, can I jump while the bar is still being moved?
Mr. Han: Wait for the referee's signal, then run up.
Boy: How many attempts do I get?
Mr. Han: Three. If you fail, the next competitor comes.

questions.question: When may the boy start his jump?

options.A: After the referee gives the signal.
options.B: While the bar is being moved.
options.C: Any time, as long as nobody is watching.
options.D: Only after he has failed three times.

title: 实心球单手推
material:
Girl: Mr. Gu, how do I throw the shot put?
Mr. Gu: Hold it at your neck and push with one hand. Not two.
Girl: Can I throw it underarm like a basketball?
Mr. Gu: No. The ball must stay above your shoulder until you let it go.

questions.question: How should the girl hold the shot put?

options.A: With two hands at her waist.
options.C: At her neck, and push with one hand.
options.D: Over her head with two hands.

title: 篮球场上五个人
material:
Girl: Mr. Han, how many of our players are on the court?
Mr. Han: Five from our side and five from theirs.
Girl: Can six play if one is tired?
Mr. Han: No. Six players on the court is a fault, and the game stops.

questions.question: How many players from one team are on the court in a basketball game?

title: 美术馆周三才开门
material:
Girl: Mr. Guo, is the art museum open today?
Mr. Guo: No, today is Monday. We open from Wednesday to Sunday, ten to five.
Girl: Can I come on Tuesday?
Mr. Guo: No. Tuesday is for schools only. Wednesday is the next open day.

questions.question: When can the girl visit the museum?

title: 画室里不能拍照
material:
Boy: Mr. Shen, may I take a photo of this painting?
Mr. Shen: No. No photos in the painting room. Sketching is fine.
Boy: Can I photograph the stone animals outside?
Mr. Shen: Yes, outside is fine. The rule is only about the paintings.

questions.question: What may the boy do in the painting room?

options.A: Take a photo of the painting.
options.D: Sketch the painting in a notebook.

title: 电影要坐第五排中间
material:
Girl: Mr. Pan, which seats are best for the new film?
Mr. Pan: The middle of the fifth row, not the first or the last.
Girl: The last row is cheaper, isn't it?
Mr. Pan: It is, but you cannot see the screen there. Book the middle seats.

questions.question: Which seats should the girl book?

options.B: The middle of the fifth row.
options.C: The last row, because it is cheaper.

title: 迟到要等中场入场
material:
Boy: Mr. Yu, I am ten minutes late for the play.
Mr. Yu: Wait outside and come in at the interval, not during the first act.
Boy: Can I stand at the back of the hall?
Mr. Yu: No. Outside is where you wait. The usher will not move on.

questions.question: When may the boy go to his seat?

title: 动物园不能自己喂
material:
Girl: Mr. Bai, may I feed the monkeys my bread?
Mr. Bai: No. You must not feed any animal here. The keeper does it.
Girl: Even the ducks by the pond?
Mr. Bai: Even those. Only the keeper may feed them. He takes your bread to them.

questions.question: What may the girl do with her bread?

options.A: Give it to the keeper for the animals.
options.B: Throw it to the monkeys herself.
options.C: Give it to the ducks by the pond.
options.D: Drop it on the ground for the birds.

title: 讲解要领十二号耳机
material:
Boy: Mr. Gu, how do I hear the guide's talk?
Mr. Gu: Take a headphone at the desk, number twelve. Not a loud speaker.
Boy: Do I have to give it back?
Mr. Gu: Yes, when the talk ends. Keep it for the whole hour.

questions.question: How will the boy hear the guide's talk?

options.A: From a loudspeaker in the hall.
options.B: From a headphone he takes at the desk.
options.C: By standing next to the guide.

title: 博物馆的地图免费拿
material:
Girl: Mr. Kuang, can I see the museum map?
Mr. Kuang: Take one from the desk by the stairs. It is free, not a shop.
Girl: Is the big paper one on sale?
Mr. Kuang: That one is, but you do not need it. The free one shows every floor.

questions.question: How can the girl get a museum map?

options.A: Buy the big paper one at the shop.
options.B: Borrow one from the next group.
options.C: Copy it from the wall label.
options.D: Take the free one from the desk by the stairs.

title: 展览学生票十元
material:
Boy: Ms. Zhai, how much is the exhibition?
Ms. Zhai: Twenty yuan. Students pay ten, not fifteen.
Boy: Can I pay half on the second floor?
Ms. Zhai: Half is for students only, and only at the desk on the first floor.

questions.question: How much will the boy pay?

title: 狮子要上午九点看
material:
Girl: Mr. Pei, when is the best time to see the lions?
Mr. Pei: In the morning. At noon the stone is hot and they sleep.
Girl: But the zoo opens at nine in the morning.
Mr. Pei: Then be there at nine, not at two. Two is the worst hour.

questions.question: When should the girl go to the lion house?

title: 剧院要把包存起来
material:
Girl: Mr. Hu, may I take my bag into the theatre?
Mr. Hu: No. Leave it at the cloakroom. Only the programme goes in.
Girl: Is the cloakroom free?
Mr. Hu: Yes. Take the ticket with you and keep it all evening.

questions.question: What should the girl do with her bag?

options.A: Take it into the theatre and sit near the door.
options.D: Give it to the usher at the door.

title: 电影票要有座位号
material:
Boy: Mr. Guo, are these two tickets any good?
Mr. Guo: Not unless the seat numbers are on them. Ask for numbered seats.
Boy: Can we sit anywhere if we pay more?
Mr. Guo: No. The hall is numbered and the numbers on the ticket must match.

questions.question: What should the boy ask for at the ticket desk?

options.B: Tickets for any seat, at a higher price.
options.C: Tickets with the film name only.

title: 画和画框都不能摸
material:
Girl: Mr. Tong, is this painting real or a photo of one?
Mr. Tong: Real, and that is one of our best works. You must not touch it.
Girl: Can I touch the frame at least?
Mr. Tong: No. Neither the paper nor the frame. Read the label beside it.

questions.question: What may the girl do with the painting?

options.B: Put her bag against the wall below it.
options.D: Sketch it by tracing it on the painting.

title: 自行车停在门口车架
material:
Boy: Mr. Ge, can I bring my bike into the museum hall?
Mr. Ge: No. Leave it at the rack by the main gate.
Boy: Will it still be there after two hours?
Mr. Ge: It will. The rack is watched all day. Bring your lock.

questions.question: Where should the boy leave his bike?

options.A: At the rack by the main gate.
options.C: In the bicycle room on the second floor.
options.D: At the rack in the tea room.

title: 园里的水都不能喝
material:
Girl: Mr. Bai, I am thirsty. Can I drink from the pond?
Mr. Bai: No. Nothing in this park is safe to drink. There is a tap by the gate.
Girl: Is bottled water sold here?
Mr. Bai: Yes, at the shop near the exit. Five yuan a bottle.

questions.question: Where should the girl get water?

options.A: From the pond in the park.
options.B: From a stream beside the path.
options.C: From the lake near the bridge.
options.D: From the shop near the exit.

title: 电影要等灯灭再说话
material:
Boy: Mr. Wei, the lights are still on. Can I start talking?
Mr. Wei: Wait until the lights go out. Then talk, but not loudly.
Boy: Why are there three short lights before the film?
Mr. Wei: That is the signal. Sit down and wait for the pictures to move.

questions.question: When should the boy start talking?

options.A: As soon as he sits down.
options.C: When the third light comes on.
options.D: Before the film starts, while people are finding seats.

title: 发电厂要戴安全帽
material:
Girl: Mr. Guo, may we look at the machines without a hat?
Mr. Guo: No. Wear a safety hat here, not a cap.
Girl: Do we need one indoors too?
Mr. Guo: Especially indoors. Overhead cables come down to this height.

questions.question: What must the girl wear in the power station?

title: 面包厂要换工作服
material:
Boy: Ms. Xin, can I wear my own shoes in the bakery?
Ms. Xin: No. Put on the white work coat and the cap we give you.
Boy: Do I have to give my cap back?
Ms. Xin: Yes, at the gate. Outdoor clothes stay outside the room.

questions.question: What must the boy put on at the gate?

options.A: A grey work coat and his own cap.
options.B: A cloth cap and his outdoor jacket.
options.C: Nothing; he keeps his own clothes.
options.D: A white work coat and the cap they give him.

title: 养鸡场不能拍手
material:
Girl: Mr. Dou, the hens all ran away when I clapped.
Mr. Dou: Never clap or shout here. Walk slowly instead.
Girl: Can I call them with food?
Mr. Dou: No. Only the keeper feeds them. Watch from the rail.

questions.question: How should the girl behave in the hen house?

options.A: Walk slowly and never clap or shout.
options.B: Clap loudly to call the hens to her.
options.C: Feed the hens herself from her bag.
options.D: Run between the cages to look at them.

title: 鱼塘边不能跳水
material:
Boy: Mr. Ku, may I jump into the fish pond to look at the carp?
Mr. Ku: No. The water is deep and cold. Stay behind the rail.
Boy: Can I put my feet in?
Mr. Ku: No. Not your feet. The keeper feeds the fish at four.

questions.question: What may the boy do at the fish pond?

options.A: Jump into the pond to look at the carp.
options.B: Stay behind the rail and watch.
options.C: Put his feet into the water.

title: 车间一次进八个人
material:
Boy: Mr. Dai, how many of us can go into the workshop at once?
Mr. Dai: Eight. The room takes eight, no more.
Boy: There are eleven. Do three of us wait outside?
Mr. Dai: Yes. The other eight go in with me.

questions.question: How many visitors can go into the workshop at once?

title: 气象站不能放风筝
material:
Boy: Mr. Gu, may we fly a kite on the field behind the station?
Mr. Gu: No. Never fly near the station. There are wires up there.
Boy: How far away is safe?
Mr. Gu: A kilometre. Two if the wind is strong.

questions.question: How far from the weather station may the boy fly a kite?

title: 法院旁听要安静
material:
Girl: Mr. Hao, may we talk during the trial?
Mr. Hao: No talking, no photographs, and put your phone on silent.
Girl: Do we have to stand when the judge comes in?
Mr. Hao: Yes, everyone stands. Sit only after the judge sits down.

questions.question: What must the girl do when the judge comes in?

options.C: Take a photograph of the judge.

title: 警察局参观要提前三天
material:
Boy: Mr. Yu, can we visit the police station tomorrow?
Mr. Yu: Not without a form. Ask for it three days before.
Boy: Can my class teacher send one tomorrow?
Mr. Yu: No. Three days, not one. The group is at ten.

questions.question: How far ahead must the boy ask for the form?

title: 铁厂要戴护目镜
material:
Girl: Mr. Quan, why must I put these glasses on before we go in?
Mr. Quan: Sparks fly from the welders. The glasses stop them.
Girl: Can I take them off inside?
Mr. Quan: Not while the welders work. Keep them on until they stop.

questions.question: Why should the girl wear the glasses in the iron works?

options.A: To stop sparks from the welders.
options.B: To help her see the dark room.

title: 仓库参观要跟导游
material:
Boy: Mr. Hui, may I go and look at the boxes by myself?
Mr. Hui: No. Stay with the guide. Do not touch the shelves.
Boy: Can I take a photo of the labels?
Mr. Hui: No. Labels are for the staff. Put the camera away.

questions.question: What must the boy do in the warehouse?

options.A: Go and look at the boxes by himself.
options.B: Touch the shelves to see what is on them.
options.C: Stay with the guide and keep his hands off the shelves.
options.D: Take a photo of the labels on the boxes.

title: 拖拉机只能司机坐
material:
Girl: Mr. Bai, may I sit on the tractor for a minute?
Mr. Bai: No. Only the driver sits there, and only while it is still.
Girl: Can I touch the steering wheel after it stops?
Mr. Bai: Even then no. Ask the driver before you touch anything.

questions.question: Who may sit on the tractor?

options.C: Anyone in a group of two.

title: 家具厂要开高窗
material:
Girl: Mr. Niu, the air in here smells strong.
Mr. Niu: Open the high window. The glue smell goes out that way.
Girl: Is the glue dangerous?
Mr. Niu: It is not, but the smell is. Open the window, not the door.

questions.question: What should the girl do about the strong smell?

options.B: Close the high window and keep the door shut.
options.C: Put her coat over her nose and stay.
options.D: Open the small window at floor level.

title: 低处的果子由果农摘
material:
Girl: Mr. Zhi, may I pull the low apples myself?
Mr. Zhi: No. Those are not ours. The farmer uses a pole for them.
Girl: May I pick up the ones on the ground?
Mr. Zhi: Only into the farmer's basket. Otherwise they go back on the tree.

questions.question: How may the girl get the low apples?

options.A: By pulling them down with her own hands.
options.B: By standing on a chair and reaching up.
options.C: By shaking the tree until they fall.
options.D: Not at all; the farmer picks them with a pole.

title: 玻璃厂末班车五点
material:
Boy: Mr. Kang, may I touch the glass that comes out of the furnace?
Mr. Kang: No. It is still hot enough to burn you. Look from the rail.
Boy: When does the shop open?
Mr. Kang: At nine. The last truck leaves at five, not six.

questions.question: When does the last truck leave the glass works?

title: 染布房只能摸干布
material:
Girl: Mr. Xie, may I touch the cloth in that vat?
Mr. Xie: No. The dye is still wet and it stains for weeks.
Girl: Can I hold the dry cloth on the rack?
Mr. Xie: Yes, the dry one only. And wash your hands after.

questions.question: Which cloth may the girl touch?

options.A: The cloth in the dye vat.
options.C: The dry cloth on the rack.
options.D: Neither the wet nor the dry cloth.

title: 耳机音量只开一半
material:
Girl: Mr. Guo, my ears hurt after I use my earphones.
Mr. Guo: Turn the volume down. Half of the maximum, not all of it.
Girl: How long may I use them a day?
Mr. Guo: One hour at a time. Take them out after that.

questions.question: What volume should the girl set?

title: 本子要对着鼻子放
material:
Boy: Ms. Ding, I have to twist my neck to see my notebook.
Ms. Ding: Turn the book so it points at your nose, not at your left hand.
Boy: What about the light?
Ms. Ding: It comes from the left, so your right hand does not cast a shadow.

questions.question: How should the boy place his notebook?

options.A: To the left of his body.
options.B: Straight in front of him, pointing at his nose.
options.C: Far to the right on the desk.

title: 课桌高度到腰
material:
Girl: Mr. Fu, my desk is too high for me.
Mr. Fu: Lower it until the top is level with your waist.
Girl: Then where do my knees go?
Mr. Fu: Under it, bent at right angles. Not against the desk edge.

questions.question: How high should the top of the desk be?

title: 打喷嚏用手肘捂住
material:
Boy: Mr. Zong, I sneezed right in front of my friend.
Mr. Zong: Cover your mouth and nose with your elbow, not your hand.
Boy: Why not the hand?
Mr. Zong: The hand then touches the desk and the next person. The elbow does not.

questions.question: What should the boy use to cover a sneeze?

title: 跑完要小口喝水
material:
Girl: Ms. Kong, I drank a whole bottle after the race.
Ms. Kong: Take small sips instead. A big drink makes you dizzy.
Girl: Should I drink at all right away?
Ms. Kong: Wait five minutes. Then water, not sweet drinks.

questions.question: How should the girl drink after the race?

options.B: Small sips, five minutes after finishing.
options.C: One big glass of sweet juice.
options.D: Nothing at all for an hour.

title: 文具盒只留三支笔
material:
Boy: Mr. Xin, my pencil case is full of broken bits.
Mr. Xin: Empty it once a week. Keep only three pencils and one pen.
Boy: What about the ruler and the eraser?
Mr. Xin: The ruler stays, the eraser stays. Everything else goes out.

questions.question: What should the boy keep in his pencil case?

options.A: Everything he has, including the broken bits.
options.B: Only the ruler and the eraser.
options.C: All his old pens and pencils.
options.D: Three pencils and one pen, plus the ruler and eraser.

title: 水果一天吃两个
material:
Girl: Mr. Liang, how many fruits should I eat a day?
Mr. Liang: Two. One apple and one orange is enough.
Girl: Can I have a banana as well?
Mr. Liang: Then skip the orange, not the apple. Two in all.

questions.question: How many fruits should the girl eat in a day?

title: 袜子要每天换一双
material:
Girl: Ms. Yun, my socks are always grey after one day.
Ms. Yun: Change them every day. Cotton socks, not nylon.
Girl: How many pairs do I need for a week?
Ms. Yun: Seven, one for each day. Wash them at forty degrees.

questions.question: How often should the girl change her socks?

options.D: Only when they begin to smell.

title: 头发要早晚各梳一次
material:
Boy: Mr. Gu, my hair gets tangled after two days.
Mr. Gu: Comb it every morning and every night, not once a week.
Boy: Should I wash it every day?
Mr. Gu: No, twice a week is enough. Combing matters more than washing.

questions.question: How often should the boy comb his hair?

title: 耳朵进水要侧头跳
material:
Girl: Mr. Pei, water went into my ear in the shower.
Mr. Pei: Turn your head to that side and jump, not the other way.
Girl: Should I put cotton in the ear?
Mr. Pei: No. Cotton pushes the water further in. Pull the ear up gently.

questions.question: What should the girl do to get the water out?

options.A: Turn her head to that side and jump.
options.B: Turn her head the other way and jump.
options.C: Put cotton wool deep in the ear.
options.D: Lie down with that ear on the pillow.

title: 流鼻血要低头
material:
Boy: Mr. Yu, my nose is bleeding again.
Mr. Yu: Sit down and lean forward. Do not tilt your head back.
Boy: Can I put cold water on my forehead?
Mr. Yu: No. Hold the soft part of the nose for ten minutes, not the bridge.

questions.question: What should the boy do when his nose bleeds?

options.A: Tilt his head back and lie down.
options.B: Lean forward and hold the soft part of his nose.
options.C: Press the bridge of his nose hard.
options.D: Put cold water on his forehead.

title: 误吞东西要说出来
material:
Girl: Mr. Fei, I swallowed a small stone by mistake.
Mr. Fei: Tell an adult at once. Do not keep it a secret.
Girl: Will it hurt if I do not say anything?
Mr. Fei: It may. Hiding it is what makes it dangerous, not the stone.

questions.question: What should the girl do after swallowing the stone?

options.B: Keep it a secret until it hurts.
options.D: Drink a lot of cold water and say nothing.

title: 走路不要看手机
material:
Boy: Mr. Gao, I nearly fell because I was reading a message.
Mr. Gao: Put the phone away when you walk. Watch the steps, not the screen.
Boy: Can I look at it at the crossing?
Mr. Gao: Not there either. Stop at the kerb before you look at anything.

questions.question: When should the boy look at his phone?

options.A: While he is walking to school.
options.B: At the crossing, before the light changes.
options.C: After he has stopped at the kerb.
options.D: While he is climbing the stairs.

title: 躺着看书要坐起来
material:
Girl: Mr. Wei, I read in bed every night because the lamp is there.
Mr. Wei: Sit at the desk for reading. In bed you read only ten minutes.
Girl: Is it the light or the position?
Mr. Wei: Both. The lamp belongs on the desk, not by your head.

questions.question: Where should the girl read?

options.A: In bed, for as long as she likes.
options.B: Lying on the sofa under a blanket.
options.D: At her desk, at the lamp.

title: 细嚼慢咽二十分钟才饱
material:
Girl: Mr. Zhu, I always feel hungry an hour after lunch.
Mr. Zhu: Chew each bite twenty times. You eat far too fast.
Girl: Does chewing really change how full I feel?
Mr. Zhu: Yes. The stomach tells the brain it is full after about twenty minutes.

questions.question: How long must the girl wait before she feels full?

title: 看成分标签才知道缩不缩
material:
Girl: Ms. Fu, how do I know if this shirt will shrink?
Ms. Fu: Read the label inside. Cotton shrinks, pure linen does not.
Girl: The label says sixty percent cotton. Is that bad?
Ms. Fu: Ask for a hundred percent linen if you can wash it often.

questions.question: What should the girl do to find out about the shirt?

options.B: Read the label inside the shirt.
options.C: Buy two and keep the better one.

title: 退鞋要带盒子和小票
material:
Boy: Mr. Dai, these shoes hurt my feet. Can I bring them back?
Mr. Dai: Yes, in seven days. Bring the box and the receipt.
Boy: I lost the receipt. Is the card enough?
Mr. Dai: The card is not enough. Without the receipt there is no refund.

questions.question: What must the boy bring when he returns the shoes?

options.C: A written promise from his mother.

title: 保修卡放在抽屉第一格
material:
Girl: Mr. Pei, I cannot find the warranty card for the kettle.
Mr. Pei: It goes in the top drawer, under the papers. Not in the cupboard.
Girl: How long does the warranty last?
Mr. Pei: Two years. Take the card with you when you go back.

questions.question: Where is the warranty card?

options.A: In the top drawer, under the papers.
options.C: In the box in the hall.
options.D: In the bag at the shop.

title: 缺货登记预订星期四到
material:
Girl: Mr. Huo, the blue size is not on the rail.
Mr. Huo: Write your name in the book. The parcel comes on Thursday.
Girl: Do I pay now?
Mr. Huo: No, not until it arrives. Pay at the door then.

questions.question: What should the girl do about the blue size?

options.A: Pay for it at once and wait.
options.C: Write her name in the order book.

title: 试衣间的门要拉好
material:
Girl: Mr. Wan, the fitting room door does not close properly.
Mr. Wan: Hold it shut with your foot, or tell me and I will fix the latch.
Girl: Should I keep my bag inside with me?
Mr. Wan: Take it in with you. Leave it outside and it will be taken away.

questions.question: What should the girl do in the fitting room?

options.A: Leave her bag outside the door.
options.B: Ask the shop assistant to stand at the door.
options.D: Take her bag in with her.

title: 购物车要推回门口那一排
material:
Boy: Mr. Cheng, may I leave the trolley in the car park?
Mr. Cheng: No. Push it back to the row by the door.
Boy: What if the row is full?
Mr. Cheng: There is always space in the row. Leave it nowhere else.

questions.question: Where should the boy leave the trolley?

options.A: In the middle of the car park.
options.B: Back in the row by the door.

title: 洗澡只能戴橡胶表带
material:
Boy: Mr. Gao, may I wear my watch in the shower?
Mr. Gao: No. Take it off. The strap is leather and water ruins it.
Boy: What about my sports watch?
Mr. Gao: That one is fine. It is rubber, not leather.

questions.question: Which watch may the boy wear in the shower?

options.C: His sports watch with a rubber strap.

title: 鞋柜里鞋头朝外放
material:
Boy: Mr. Zhi, I can never find my shoes in the dark.
Mr. Zhi: Put every pair with the toes pointing out. Not the heels out.
Boy: Where do the boots go?
Mr. Zhi: Bottom shelf, toes out as well. One pair per space.

questions.question: How should the boy arrange his shoes?

title: 毛巾要分开用两次一洗
material:
Girl: Ms. Deng, may I use the same towel for my face and my feet?
Ms. Deng: No. Two towels, one for the face and one for the body.
Girl: Do I wash them often?
Ms. Deng: After two uses. A damp towel grows things you cannot see.

questions.question: What should the girl do about towels?

options.B: Use two, and wash each after two uses.
options.C: Use the face towel for the feet too.
options.D: Keep them damp near the cooker.

title: 重书要搬去书架上
material:
Girl: Mr. Hui, my desk drawer will not close any more.
Mr. Hui: The books are too heavy. Move them to the shelf.
Girl: What can stay in the drawer?
Mr. Hui: Pens, rulers and paper. The dictionaries, the exercise books and the paint box all go to the shelf.

questions.question: What should the girl keep in her desk drawer?

title: 螺丝刀要收回工具盒
material:
Boy: Mr. Pei, where do I keep the screwdriver after I use it?
Mr. Pei: Back in its box with the other tools. Not loose on the shelf.
Boy: Is the box under the bed?
Mr. Pei: No. On the top shelf, out of the children's reach.

questions.question: Where should the boy keep the screwdriver?

options.A: In its box on the top shelf.
options.B: Loose on the shelf where he left it.
options.D: In the kitchen drawer with the knives.

title: 厨房抹布每顿饭后洗
material:
Boy: Mr. Tan, my kitchen cloth smells badly.
Mr. Tan: Wash it after every meal, not once a week.
Boy: Should I use hot water?
Mr. Tan: Hot water and soap. Then hang it over the sink, not on the rail.

questions.question: What should the boy do with the kitchen cloth?

options.A: Wash it once a week in cold water.
options.B: Wash it after every meal in hot water and soap.
options.C: Leave it wet on the rail overnight.
options.D: Keep it damp near the cooker.

title: 下水口每个星期六刷
material:
Girl: Ms. Luo, the sink takes ten minutes to empty now.
Ms. Luo: The outlet below is half full. Clean it every Saturday.
Girl: What do I use to clean it?
Ms. Luo: A wire brush and hot water, not the chemical cleaner.

questions.question: What should the girl do on Saturday?

options.A: Buy a stronger chemical cleaner and use it every Saturday.
options.B: Ask a plumber to clean the outlet below the sink.
options.C: Clean the outlet below the sink with a wire brush and hot water.
options.D: Leave the tap running all night instead of cleaning it.

title: 玻璃杯有裂纹要扔掉
material:
Girl: Mr. Li, this glass has a line across the bottom.
Mr. Li: That's a crack. Do not drink from it.
Girl: Can I cut the bottom off?
Mr. Li: No. Throw it away. Cracks grow while the glass is hot.

questions.question: What should the girl do with the cracked glass?

options.B: Cut the bottom off and use the top.
options.C: Fill it with cold water only.

title: 门厅地垫一个月洗一次
material:
Girl: Mr. Ding, the mat at our door is always wet.
Mr. Ding: Turn it over each time it dries. The back holds less water.
Girl: Should I wash it?
Mr. Ding: Once a month. Not every week. Then leave it outside to dry.

questions.question: When should the mat be washed?

title: 续借图书的次数
material:
Ms. He: You may renew a book twice.
Girl: I have already renewed this one once.
Ms. He: Then once is left.
Girl: May I renew it if somebody else has asked for it?
Ms. He: No. Give it back on Friday.
Girl: Friday it is.

questions.question: How many times can the girl still renew the book?

title: 水果摊的分档计价
material:
Boy: Ms. Lu, I need four kilos of oranges.
Ms. Lu: The first three kilos are four yuan a kilo. After that it is two yuan.
Boy: So twelve plus two?
Ms. Lu: Four kilos is fourteen yuan. Twelve for the first three, two for the last.

questions.question: How much will the boy pay for the oranges?

title: 药店的糖浆瓶数
material:
Girl: Mr. Fang, how many small spoons do I need?
Mr. Fang: One twice a day, and I need it for six days.
Girl: Twelve small spoons? Then how many bottles?
Mr. Fang: Each bottle has five small spoons in it. Buy three bottles.
Girl: And no more than that?
Mr. Fang: No more.

questions.question: How many bottles will the girl buy?

title: 眼镜店验光预约
material:
Girl: Ms. Tan, do I need an appointment?
Ms. Tan: Yes, we are full from ten on Saturday. Come at half past nine.
Girl: My brother needs one too?
Ms. Tan: One person per twenty minutes. He can come at ten, right after you.
Girl: More for two people?
Ms. Tan: No. Forty yuan each.

questions.question: At what time will the girl's brother have his eye test?

title: 修钟表的报价
material:
Boy: Mr. Qian, how much to mend a wall clock?
Mr. Qian: Twenty-five yuan if it only needs a new spring.
Boy: Mine needs a new spring.
Mr. Qian: Then twenty-five. I do not charge for the parts.
Boy: How long will it take?
Mr. Qian: A day. I open at nine and close at six.

questions.question: How much will the boy pay for the repair?

title: 租自行车的押金
material:
Girl: Mr. Bai, how much is the deposit for a bicycle?
Mr. Bai: Fifty yuan. It comes back when you return it.
Girl: I want it for two hours.
Mr. Bai: Still fifty. By the hour: four for the first hour, two after it.
Girl: Two hours would be six yuan.
Mr. Bai: Six yuan, and fifty yuan back.

questions.question: How much will the girl pay for the two hours, after the fifty yuan deposit comes back?

title: 衣柜挂衣杆的长度
material:
Boy: Ms. Wu, how long a rail do I need inside the wardrobe?
Ms. Wu: The wardrobe is ninety centimetres wide. The rail must be ten centimetres shorter, or the doors will not close.
Boy: Then eighty. Is that long enough for my coats?
Ms. Wu: Yes. Anything under seventy will not hang straight.
Boy: I will measure again.

questions.question: How long a rail will the boy buy?

title: 买猫粮要几袋
material:
Girl: How many days does a one-kilo bag last?
Mr. Wu: Sixty grams twice a day, so a hundred and twenty a day.
Girl: And a kilo is a thousand grams.
Mr. Wu: Yes.
Girl: So one bag is a little over eight days.
Mr. Wu: Right, and an opened bag must be used inside a month.

questions.question: How many bags will the girl need for one month?

title: 换纱窗的钱
material:
Girl: Mr. Yu, how much is it to have new screens put in?
Mr. Yu: Twenty yuan a window, and the material is included.
Girl: We have four windows.
Mr. Yu: The kitchen one is half price, so seventy yuan.
Girl: Can you do it next week?
Mr. Yu: Yes, on Saturday morning.

questions.question: How much will the girl pay for all four windows?

title: 陶艺课的费用
material:
Girl: How much is one pottery class?
Mr. Pan: Twenty yuan an hour, and a class is two hours.
Girl: I only have an hour on Saturday.
Mr. Pan: Then it is twenty yuan, but you will only get half a bowl.
Girl: I will pay for two hours.
Mr. Pan: The clay is five yuan extra, not included.

questions.question: How much will the girl pay in all?

title: 买年历送邻居
material:
Girl: Mr. Guo, how much is the wall calendar for next year?
Mr. Guo: Twelve yuan each. Two for twenty.
Girl: I need one for my grandmother and one for the neighbours.
Mr. Guo: Then two, and it is twenty, not twenty-four.
Girl: Shall I bring the money tomorrow?
Mr. Guo: Yes, or pay on the spot.

questions.question: How much will the girl pay?

title: 修剪阳台的树
material:
Girl: My balcony tree has three long branches.
Mr. Sun: Cut them to twenty centimetres. A balcony tree should be a little above the rail.
Girl: The rail is a metre high and the tree is a metre forty.
Mr. Sun: Then take twenty centimetres off the top, not thirty.
Girl: Will it grow back?
Mr. Sun: It will.

questions.question: How tall will the tree be after the cut?

title: 电风扇的噪音
material:
Boy: My old fan is very loud at setting two.
Ms. Gu: Is there dust behind the back?
Boy: I have never looked.
Ms. Gu: Take the back off and clean it. A loud fan is full of dust.
Boy: Is setting one enough?
Ms. Gu: Setting one is a breeze. Clean it before you buy a new one.

questions.question: What will the boy do first?

options.A: Take the back off and clean it.
options.D: Take the fan to a shop.

title: 存钱买足球
material:
Boy: Mr. Gu, I want to buy a football.
Mr. Gu: How much is it?
Boy: Ninety yuan.
Mr. Gu: Put aside five yuan a week and do not touch it.
Boy: Five a week is a lot of weeks.
Mr. Gu: A year is fifty-two weeks, not a hundred. Divide, do not guess.

questions.question: About how many weeks will the boy need?

title: 缩水衬衫的退换
material:
Girl: My new shirt shrank in the wash.
Ms. Pan: Did you wash it in hot water?
Girl: I followed the label; it says thirty.
Ms. Pan: It is not your fault, and it cannot be made bigger.
Girl: Shall I cut the sleeves?
Ms. Pan: Take it back to the shop within seven days, with the receipt.

questions.question: What will the girl do now?

options.A: Wash it again in hot water.
options.C: Take it back to the shop within seven days.
options.D: Iron it for a longer time.

title: 超市的散装坚果
material:
Boy: Ms. Qiu, how much are these nuts?
Ms. Qiu: Two yuan fifty a hundred grams. They are loose, so we weigh them.
Boy: The label says three hundred grams.
Ms. Qiu: Seven yuan fifty. A bag of the same nuts is twenty yuan for five hundred grams.
Boy: Then loose costs less.
Ms. Qiu: It does.

questions.question: How much will the boy pay for the loose nuts?

title: 小区宽带的付费
material:
Girl: How much is the broadband at home?
Ms. Luo: Thirty a month for the slow one, fifty for the fast one.
Girl: I want the fast one.
Ms. Luo: Pay for six months and the seventh is free, so three hundred.
Girl: And the slow one?
Ms. Luo: A hundred and eighty for six months.

questions.question: How much will the girl pay for the fast one?

title: 社区诊所的取药时间
material:
Girl: Ms. Kong, I had a prescription yesterday.
Ms. Kong: It will be ready at four this afternoon, not at noon.
Girl: Can I come at noon?
Ms. Kong: No. The shop upstairs is closed between twelve and two.
Girl: Then after four.
Ms. Kong: Bring the slip.

questions.question: When can the girl collect the medicine?

title: 家具城的送货费
material:
Boy: Mr. Dai, do you deliver a desk?
Mr. Dai: Delivery is thirty yuan inside the town, sixty outside.
Boy: I live about ten kilometres away.
Mr. Dai: Inside is up to five kilometres. Ten is outside, so sixty.
Boy: Can I collect it myself?
Mr. Dai: Then there is no charge, but you carry it in.

questions.question: How much will the boy pay for delivery?

title: 疏通下水道的费用
material:
Girl: Mr. Wu, the sink does not drain.
Mr. Wu: For a kitchen sink it is forty yuan, and I do not charge if nothing comes out.
Girl: Then it may cost nothing.
Mr. Wu: It may. A coin in the pipe takes ten minutes.

questions.question: How much will the girl pay at most?

title: 抽屉滑轨的修理
material:
Boy: Mr. Yuan, my desk drawer will not close.
Mr. Yuan: The slide is bent. Straightening is twenty yuan; a new slide is forty-five.
Boy: The desk is going to the tip next week.
Mr. Yuan: Then a new slide. I do not straighten one I will not see again.

questions.question: How much will the boy pay?

title: 旧电器的回收
material:
Girl: Mr. Ma, do you take old fridges?
Mr. Ma: Yes, but only if you bring it to the yard. We pay two yuan a kilo.
Girl: It is thirty kilos.
Mr. Ma: Sixty yuan. A working one is worth more, but that is not our business.
Girl: What about the water inside it?
Mr. Ma: Empty it.

questions.question: How much will the girl get for her old fridge?

title: 楼顶水箱的清洗
material:
Boy: Ms. Guo, when is the water tank on the roof cleaned?
Ms. Guo: Once a year, in the last week of June.
Boy: Our water was cloudy last week.
Ms. Guo: Then next month, not this week. It takes three hours.

questions.question: When will the tank be cleaned?

options.C: In the last week of June.

title: 给猫剪指甲
material:
Girl: Mr. Chen, can you cut my cat's claws here?
Mr. Chen: Yes, fifteen yuan. I do it on the table, not on the floor.
Girl: Will my cat be cross?
Mr. Chen: Some of them are. One claw takes about a minute.
Girl: Then about ten minutes in all.
Mr. Chen: Bring a towel, not a carrier.

questions.question: How long will the work take?

title: 会议室能坐几个人
material:
Boy: Ms. Yu, how many people fit in the meeting room?
Ms. Yu: Twelve at the table, and six more on chairs at the back.
Boy: Our club has fifteen.
Ms. Yu: Then all fifteen fit, with three chairs to spare. The hall holds forty.

questions.question: How many people can sit in the meeting room?

title: 雨伞的大小
material:
Girl: How big is the largest umbrella you have?
Ms. Wu: One metre ten, and it weighs half a kilo. That one is for two people.
Girl: I want one for my schoolbag.
Ms. Wu: Then take the ninety-centimetre one. It weighs a quarter of a kilo.
Girl: How much is it?
Ms. Wu: Thirty-five yuan.

questions.question: How much will the girl pay?

title: 烧水壶的水位
material:
Boy: Ms. He, how much water should I put in the kettle?
Ms. He: To the line. The kettle is one and a half litres.
Boy: I want two cups of tea.
Ms. He: Two cups are about a third of it. Fill it once for both of us.

questions.question: How much water does the boy need for two cups?

title: 电池的充电时长
material:
Girl: How long does this battery pack take to charge?
Mr. Liu: Four hours from empty, and about two from half.
Girl: I want it for tomorrow's trip, so it is empty now.
Mr. Liu: Then put it on at nine and it will be ready at one.

questions.question: At what time will the battery pack be ready?

title: 楼下便利店的关店时间
material:
Girl: Mr. Zhou, when do you close?
Mr. Zhou: Eleven, every night except Sunday, when I close at six.
Girl: I need milk at ten.
Mr. Zhou: Come before ten, because at ten I put things away.
Girl: Today is Sunday.
Mr. Zhou: Then come before six, not at ten.

questions.question: At what time should the girl come today?

title: 冰箱的除霜
material:
Boy: Mr. Gu, my fridge is making a noise again.
Mr. Gu: How old is it?
Boy: Nine years. The ice box is thick.
Mr. Gu: Then defrost it. Unplug it, leave the door open, and put towels in.
Boy: How long does it take?
Mr. Gu: Four hours, and not in the sun. A sunny window makes it worse.

questions.question: How long will defrosting take?

title: 楼上漏水
material:
Girl: Mr. Zhou, the ceiling in my bedroom is wet.
Mr. Zhou: That is from upstairs. Knock on their door first, politely.
Girl: What if they say it is not them?
Mr. Zhou: Then put a bowl under the wet place tonight.
Girl: And if the bowl fills?
Mr. Zhou: Take it to the manager on Saturday.

questions.question: What does Mr. Zhou tell the girl to do first?

options.A: Knock on the upstairs door and ask politely.
options.B: Put a bowl under the wet place tonight.
options.C: Take the bowl to the manager on Saturday.

title: 金鱼缸的水温
material:
Boy: Ms. Han, how warm should the water be for my goldfish?
Ms. Han: Between twenty-two and twenty-six degrees.
Boy: Our heater is set at twenty-eight.
Ms. Han: Then it is too warm, and they will not eat.
Boy: Should I change it every day?
Ms. Han: Once a week. Twice is too much for them.

questions.question: About how warm should the water be?

title: 阳台种葱的间距
material:
Boy: Ms. Tang, how far apart should I plant the spring onions?
Ms. Tang: Fifteen centimetres, and no closer.
Boy: My box is sixty centimetres long.
Ms. Tang: Then four rows, not six. Six would be ten centimetres apart.
Boy: So I save a row of onions.
Ms. Tang: And the ones you keep will be thicker.

questions.question: How many rows can the boy plant in the box?

title: 猫咪的驱虫药
material:
Girl: Mr. Song, how much deworming medicine does my cat need?
Mr. Song: One tablet for a cat under four kilos. Yours is five.
Girl: Then two tablets?
Mr. Song: No. Two is too much. Give one and ask again in a month.
Girl: And not with food?
Mr. Song: With food, or she will spit it out.

questions.question: How many tablets will the girl give her cat now?

title: 小区门口修路的绕行
material:
Girl: Mr. Zhao, the road outside our gate is dug up.
Mr. Zhao: Yes, three weeks. Walk out of the east gate instead. It is four minutes longer.
Girl: Is the east gate open then?
Mr. Zhao: From six to ten every day. Your bus comes at half past seven, and the stop is closer.

questions.question: Why is the east gate a good way for the girl?

options.A: It is open at half past seven and the stop is closer.
options.D: It is on the way to the bus stop.

title: 给同学讲题
material:
Boy: Ms. Qiao, my classmate does not understand fractions.
Ms. Qiao: Then do not explain. Give him three easy ones and wait.
Boy: He will say he still cannot.
Ms. Qiao: Then give him five, not thirty, and mark the ones he gets right.
Boy: Mark them in his book?
Ms. Qiao: On a separate paper.

questions.question: Where should the boy mark the questions his classmate gets right?

title: 邻居家的噪音时间
material:
Girl: Mr. Xu, the family next door drill at seven every morning.
Mr. Xu: Before eight it is quiet by law. After eight they may drill.
Girl: I study at seven, so what do I do?
Mr. Xu: Tell them before eight, not after eight. If they drill after eight too, go to the manager on Saturday.

questions.question: What does Mr. Xu advise the girl to do first?

options.D: Go to the manager on Saturday.

title: 向邻居借梯子
material:
Girl: Mr. Kong, may I borrow your ladder for an hour?
Mr. Kong: Yes, but you must be nineteen, or somebody must hold it.
Girl: My brother will hold it.
Mr. Kong: Then take it before six; after six the light is bad.
Girl: I only need ten minutes.
Mr. Kong: Ten minutes is fine.

questions.question: When may the girl take the ladder?

title: 买酱油的容量
material:
Girl: Mr. Tao, what size bottle of soy sauce shall I buy?
Mr. Tao: A family of three takes a small bottle in about two months.
Girl: Ours is four people.
Mr. Tao: Then a small bottle is not enough. Take the middle one.
Girl: And the large one?
Mr. Tao: About a year. It is for a restaurant.

questions.question: Which bottle should the girl take?

title: 超市的会员卡积分
material:
Boy: Ms. Dai, I have four hundred points on my card.
Ms. Dai: Four hundred is not enough for the rice. That is four hundred eighty.
Boy: And the soap?
Ms. Dai: The soap is three hundred. You would have a hundred left.
Boy: Points do not expire?
Ms. Dai: They expire after two years.

questions.question: How many points will the boy have left after he uses them for the soap?

title: 办事窗口的午休
material:
Boy: Ms. Wan, the office says nine to five, but the line is out of the door.
Ms. Wan: They stop taking numbers at half past twelve and open again at one.
Boy: I have number forty-two.
Ms. Wan: Then you are after lunch. Go and eat first, then come back at half past twelve.

questions.question: What does Ms. Wan tell the boy to do?

options.A: Keep his place in the queue.
options.C: Go and eat first, then come back.

title: 换季衣服的收纳
material:
Boy: Ms. Yan, how should I store my winter coats?
Ms. Yan: Clean them first. A coat stored with dirt will smell in August.
Boy: Then hang them?
Ms. Yan: Fold them. Hanging a wool coat for months stretches the shoulders.
Boy: How many will fit in the top box?
Ms. Yan: Three. Four will not shut.

questions.question: How many coats will fit in the top box?

title: 公共厕所的保洁时间
material:
Girl: Mr. Peng, why is the toilet locked at noon?
Mr. Peng: It is cleaned at noon. It opens again at one.
Girl: But the school closes at twelve.
Mr. Peng: Use the one at the square. That one stays open all day.
Girl: Is it far?
Mr. Peng: Six minutes' walk.

questions.question: Which toilet can the girl use at noon?

title: 调自行车坐垫的高度
material:
Boy: Ms. Zou, the seat on my bike is too high.
Ms. Zou: When you sit, your leg should be straight at the bottom.
Boy: It is bent.
Ms. Zou: Then take the seat down about five centimetres. Not ten, or your feet will not reach.
Boy: How do I measure five?
Ms. Zou: One finger is about a centimetre.

questions.question: By how much should the boy lower the seat?

title: 楼道堆物的清理
material:
Girl: Mr. Yu, the stairs are full of old furniture.
Mr. Yu: It comes down on the first Saturday of the month.
Girl: My mother's sofa is there.
Mr. Yu: Book the van on Friday. It is free.
Girl: How early does the van come?
Mr. Yu: At seven. It leaves at eleven, full or not.

questions.question: At what time will the van leave?

title: 订牛奶的配送时间
material:
Boy: Ms. Dai, what time do you deliver the milk?
Ms. Dai: Before seven every morning. I leave the bottles in the box outside the door.
Boy: We are out before seven on weekdays.
Ms. Dai: Then move the box to the side gate. I can leave it there until eight.

questions.question: What does Ms. Dai suggest the boy do?

options.A: Move the box to the side gate.
options.B: Come to her shop at seven.
options.C: Wait for her at the door.
options.D: Leave the box where it is.

title: 在食堂打饭的份量
material:
Boy: Ms. He, how much rice do I get?
Ms. He: One ladle for a small bowl, two for a large one.
Boy: I am having the fish today.
Ms. He: Then start with the vegetables, then the fish, then the rice.
Boy: Can I take the fish first?
Ms. He: No. The vegetables go first.

questions.question: Which does Ms. He tell the boy to take first?

title: 给花盆垫排水片
material:
Girl: Mr. Kong, my potted plant keeps having water in the bottom.
Mr. Kong: Put a stone or a broken tile over the hole. One tile is enough.
Girl: I have no stones, but I have an old saucer.
Mr. Kong: A saucer holds the water, so no.

questions.question: How many tiles does the girl need for her small pot?

title: 面包店买多少个吐司
material:
Boy: Ms. Cui, how many loaves do two people need?
Ms. Cui: One a day between you.
Boy: That is thirty a month.
Ms. Cui: Twenty-eight, because a month is four weeks.
Boy: So I buy four at a time.
Ms. Cui: Four loaves keeps for three days, not five.

questions.question: About how many loaves does the pair need in a month?

title: 旧书的折价
material:
Girl: Mr. Cui, how much will you give me for these three books?
Mr. Cui: A new book is thirty yuan. A second-hand one is a third of that.
Girl: And this one has no cover.
Mr. Cui: Nothing for that one. Ten yuan for each of the other two.
Girl: Then I get twenty yuan.
Mr. Cui: Twenty yuan.

questions.question: How much will the girl get in all?

title: 餐馆点几个菜
material:
Girl: Mr. Xie, can we order without seeing the menu?
Mr. Xie: Yes. But say the number of people first. Four people cannot share three dishes.
Girl: We are four. How many dishes then?
Mr. Xie: Four dishes and a soup. Rice is included.
Girl: And extra rice?
Mr. Xie: Extra rice is not free.

questions.question: How many dishes does Mr. Xie suggest?

title: 相框挂墙的高度
material:
Boy: Ms. Wan, how high should I hang the photo frame?
Ms. Wan: Its centre at the height of your eye. Not its top.
Boy: My eye is one metre fifty.
Ms. Wan: Then the centre is at one metre fifty, and the frame hangs down from there.

questions.question: At what height will the centre of the frame be?

title: 早上设几个闹钟
material:
Boy: Ms. Qin, I set my alarm for six, but I get up at six twenty.
Ms. Qin: Then set three alarms, five minutes apart.
Boy: Six, six five and six ten?
Ms. Qin: That is right. The last one is the one that works.
Boy: Mine is one alarm at six.
Ms. Qin: Then you are lucky.

questions.question: How many alarms does Ms. Qin suggest the boy set?

title: 手机充电线的长度
material:
Boy: Mr. Liang, which cable do I need for my phone?
Mr. Liang: The white one is one metre. The black one is two metres.
Boy: My desk is one metre from the wall socket.
Mr. Liang: Then take the white one. The black one will be in the way.

questions.question: Which cable does Mr. Liang suggest for the boy?

title: 在展馆看画的时长
material:
Boy: Ms. Qin, how long do people usually spend in the gallery?
Ms. Qin: About forty minutes. Most of them see ten pictures.
Boy: I want to see every one.
Ms. Qin: There are sixty. Then plan for four hours, not forty minutes.
Boy: Is there a rule about talking?
Ms. Qin: No talking in the first room.

questions.question: How long does Ms. Qin suggest the boy plan for?

title: 楼层的电费怎么分摊
material:
Boy: Ms. Qi, the electricity bill for our floor is ninety yuan.
Ms. Qi: Six flats, so fifteen each.
Boy: The top flat was empty for two weeks.
Ms. Qi: Then it pays nothing, and the five of you pay eighteen each.

questions.question: How much does each of the five flats pay?

title: 书包里书怎么放
material:
Girl: Ms. Wu, how do you keep your books upright in a bag?
Ms. Wu: Biggest at the bottom. Everything else leans on it.
Girl: But my bag is too full to stand them up.
Ms. Wu: Then take out the two you never open and carry them.

questions.question: Which book should the girl keep in the bag?

title: 遥控器电池怎么试
material:
Boy: Mr. Fu, how long does a remote control battery last?
Mr. Fu: About half a year.
Boy: Mine died last month.
Mr. Fu: Then you leave it on, or the buttons wear.
Boy: Can I test it now?
Mr. Fu: In a light, not in the sun. The meter is on the back.

questions.question: How does Mr. Fu say to test the battery?

title: 给盆栽浇多少水
material:
Girl: Ms. Pei, should I use tap water for my plants?
Ms. Pei: Let it stand overnight, or use yesterday's.
Girl: Why?
Ms. Pei: Hot water from the tap hurts the roots.
Girl: How much for one pot?
Ms. Pei: Two hundred millilitres is enough. More is how people kill their plants.

questions.question: How much water does one pot need?

title: 把旧课本送给低年级
material:
Boy: Ms. Cui, I have finished Grade Nine. May I give my books away?
Ms. Cui: Yes, and Grade Eight students are here next week.
Boy: My little brother is in Grade Six.
Ms. Cui: He may have two of them, not ten. Maths goes first. Nobody keeps a book they cannot read.

questions.question: Which books does Ms. Cui say should go first?

title: 公交车上的学生月票
material:
Leo: Miss Wang, how much is the monthly bus pass for students?
Miss Wang: A student pass is forty yuan a month and an adult pass is eighty. The pass is good on every bus except the express one. The express costs five yuan a ride unless you buy the express add-on, which is twenty yuan a month on top.
Leo: So sixty a month, and I can use the express as well.
Miss Wang: Yes. But the card must be bought before the tenth of the month, or the office asks for a month and a half now.
Leo: Today is the eighth, and I have my old card here.
Miss Wang: Then you pay for one month only, sixty yuan. Take the card to the office and they will put the photo on.
Leo: Is the photo extra?
Miss Wang: Ten yuan, and it is free when the card is two years old.
Leo: My card is only one.
Miss Wang: Then the ten yuan is for you.

questions.question: How much will Leo pay for the bus pass itself every month?
What does buying the card before the tenth of the month let him do?

options.A: Pay for one month only, instead of a month and a half.
options.B: Ride on the express bus without paying the add-on.
options.C: Skip the ten yuan for the photo.
options.D: Use the pass in another city.

title: 打印店付印班级纪念册
material:
Kate: Ms. Wei, I want fifty copies of a book for our class, with a coloured cover.
Ms. Wei: Each copy has ninety pages inside. Inside pages are twenty cents each. Fifty copies of ninety pages is four thousand five hundred pages, so that is nine hundred yuan.
Kate: And the cover?
Ms. Wei: The coloured cover is twelve yuan for every ten copies. Fifty copies need five sets, so sixty yuan.
Kate: In all?
Ms. Wei: Nine hundred and sixty yuan. Paying does not change the price, but it does change the waiting. We print a job in three days at most, and your job goes in on Monday morning, so it will be ready on Thursday evening.
Kate: I finish work at five. Can I collect it then?
Ms. Wei: No. The counter shuts at four and we send jobs out at half past four the next day. If you come on Friday morning you can have it.
Kate: Then Friday morning.

questions.question: How much will Kate pay for the fifty copies?
When can Kate collect the copies?

options.A: On Thursday at five, when she finishes work.
options.B: On Friday morning, because the counter shuts at four on Thursday.
options.C: On Thursday at half past four, when the job goes out.
options.D: On Monday morning, when the job goes in.

title: 社区游泳馆的儿童票
material:
Nina: Ms. Guo, my cousin is nine and his sister is eleven. May they use the children's pool this afternoon?
Ms. Guo: Children under fourteen, or under one metre forty, may use the children's pool. They may.
Nina: What time does it close?
Ms. Guo: The children's pool closes at half past five, because the big pool takes the water for cleaning after that. We open at one, and you must be out of the water at four thirty at the latest. The last hour is for lessons.
Nina: So we have three and a half hours.
Ms. Guo: Yes. The fee is eight yuan for an adult and five yuan for a child. A child under one metre twenty swims free, but neither of yours is that small.
Nina: Then it is four of us, two adults and two children.
Ms. Guo: Two times eight and two times five, twenty-six yuan. Pay at the desk; the pool is free for the first hour on Mondays, but today is Wednesday.
Nina: Fine. We will be out at four thirty.

questions.question: How much will the four of them pay for the afternoon?
What is the latest time they may be in the water?

title: 寄养店寄养一只猫
material:
Jack: Ms. Luo, can you look after my cat for three days while I go to my cousin's wedding?
Ms. Luo: Yes. The rate is sixty yuan a day, and the last day is free if you collect before noon.
Jack: I shall collect at ten, then. And food?
Ms. Luo: Food is charged for every day you are away: one tin a day at twelve yuan. So three tins.
Jack: Then the room is two charged days. Is that all?
Ms. Luo: Yes. Two days at sixty and three tins at twelve. About the cat herself, we open the tin at eight in the morning and again at six in the evening, and the boy next door lets her out into our yard at noon, but he gives her nothing to eat then.
Jack: Does she need the yard locked at night?
Ms. Luo: The yard gate is locked at nine, and we draw the curtains at eight so that she is not sitting at the window.

questions.question: How much will Jack pay for the three days in all?
How many times a day is the cat fed at the shop?

title: 快递柜里的三个包裹
material:
Emma: Dad, three parcels came for me in the locker, but my code has stopped working.
Dad: A code works for three days. The first day is free. On the second day you pay one yuan and on the third day two yuan.
Emma: One parcel came on Monday, one on Wednesday, and the small one today.
Dad: Then the Monday parcel is on its third day, the Wednesday one on its second, and today's is on its first.
Emma: Two yuan, one yuan and nothing. Three yuan.
Dad: Exactly. But the locker takes no coins, so bring a card. The parcel room round the corner closes at half past eight, and it is quarter past six now.
Emma: Then we have an hour and a quarter.
Dad: Two hours and a quarter, till half past eight. Take the stair, not the lift; the lift is slow after six.

questions.question: How much will the family pay in total to take out the three parcels?
How much time do they have before the parcel room closes?

title: 社区木工角做一只小鸟食盒
material:
Girl: Mr. Wu, I would like to make a bird box at the community wood shop. How much board do I need?
Mr. Wu: The box is made of six pieces, and every piece is twenty long, twenty wide and one thick. I sell boards one metre long and twenty wide, and each metre costs eight yuan.
Girl: So one metre gives me five pieces.
Mr. Wu: It does, and you need six, so two metres. You may take the four pieces left over home.
Girl: How long will it take me?
Mr. Wu: Cutting and nailing take twenty-five minutes if you work alone. The shop closes at five, and it is half past three now.
Girl: Then I can finish before you shut.
Mr. Wu: You can cut and nail, but the glue needs twenty minutes more, and I do not let glue dry inside. Wait in the yard.
Girl: All right. When may I take it home?
Mr. Wu: At a quarter past four, and not before, or the box falls apart on the walk.

questions.question: How many metres of board must the girl buy?
At about what time can she take the box home?

title: 学校食堂的午餐票
material:
Kate: Mr. Deng, how much does a lunch ticket cost?
Mr. Deng: A single ticket is five yuan and it is good for one lunch. A month of twenty school days is a hundred yuan, so the month costs the same as twenty single tickets. We do not sell single tickets on Fridays, because the kitchen is busy.
Kate: I need eleven days; I am away for nine.
Mr. Deng: Then eleven tickets, fifty-five yuan. The canteen also closes an hour early on the last Friday of the month, but you are not here then.
Kate: I finish at ten past seven. Can I buy a ticket then?
Mr. Deng: Yes, but on a Tuesday the queue is about fifteen minutes.
Kate: All right, I shall come at seven.

questions.question: How much will Kate pay for eleven lunches?
About how long must she wait at the window on a Tuesday?

title: 理发店门口的三个人
material:
Auntie Qiu: Mr. Sun, I have been waiting since one o'clock, and I need my hair done before I buy the cake.
Mr. Sun: I am sorry. The young man in my chair started at one and needs thirty minutes, so your turn begins at half past one.
Auntie Qiu: How long do I take?
Mr. Sun: You said thirty-five minutes last week. Half past one and thirty-five is five past two. The shop next door sells cakes and shuts at half past four, so you have time.
The girl: Is my turn after her?
Mr. Sun: Yes, and you told me forty minutes. That takes you from five past two to twenty-five to three. Your train is at two, so it will be late.
The girl: Then I shall take the four o'clock one.
Mr. Sun: Then I can finish you by half past four and I shut at five.

questions.question: About what time will Auntie Qiu's hair be finished?
Why will the girl not catch her two o'clock train?

options.A: Mr. Sun shuts the shop at two o'clock.
options.B: She is behind the young man in the chair.
options.C: Auntie Qiu bought the girl's ticket.
options.D: She will have forty minutes of her own, and only after Auntie Qiu.

title: 乐器店的钢琴调音
material:
Leo: Mr. Ren, how much does it cost to tune a piano?
Mr. Ren: A full tune of an upright piano is three hundred yuan and takes about two hours. A single note is forty yuan. Most people want the whole thing three times a year.
Leo: Mine was tuned in March. It is now August, so five months.
Mr. Ren: Then you are due. But I can only come on a Thursday, because I am at the school on the other days.
Leo: Is it cheaper to have a few notes done?
Mr. Ren: One note is forty, so three notes are a hundred and twenty and take a quarter of an hour, but the piano will sound wrong everywhere else. I tell people to do the whole thing.
Leo: Then the whole thing. How long must you have the piano?
Mr. Ren: Two hours, and I need the lid open, so please move the stool and the plants first. It is half past one now, so I shall finish at half past three.
Leo: My train home is at four.

questions.question: How much would Leo pay if he had only three notes tuned instead of the whole piano?
About what time will Mr. Ren finish tuning Leo's piano?

title: 电瓶车充电桩的充电费用
material:
Nina: Mr. Guo, how much does it cost to charge my e-bike here?
Mr. Guo: Two yuan for the first hour and one yuan for every hour or part of an hour after that. The meter starts when you plug in.
Nina: I came at half past six and I am charging now. When shall I come back?
Mr. Guo: The first hour takes you to half past seven. Charge to eight and you pay two yuan plus one yuan, so three yuan in all.
Nina: It is quarter to eight now. If the rain starts at nine, shall I wait?
Mr. Guo: Before half past eight it is three yuan, and half past eight is where the third hour begins, so if you wait for the rain it is four yuan.
Nina: Then I shall stop at eight.
Mr. Guo: Good. The cover over the meter keeps the rain off, but a strong wind blows it open. It is not worth four yuan to save one.
Nina: All right, at eight then.

questions.question: How much will Nina pay if she stops charging at eight o'clock?
How much more will she pay if she waits until the rain begins?

title: 社区羽毛球馆的场地费
material:
Kate: Ms. He, what does one court cost after school?
Ms. He: Eight yuan an hour for students and six for members. Membership is sixty yuan a term and it is open to anyone over twelve. A court is booked by the hour and cannot be booked for less than one hour.
Kate: We want it from a quarter past four until half past five, and then again from six until seven.
Ms. He: One hour and a quarter, then one hour. At eight yuan an hour that is ten yuan and eight yuan.
Kate: How many hours of play would pay back the membership?
Ms. He: At six yuan an hour, sixty yuan is ten hours. Most families reach that in a term, most young ones do not.
Kate: Our class has eleven names on the list, and we play on Tuesdays.

questions.question: How much will Kate pay for the two bookings if she does not take out a membership?
How many hours of play would pay back the membership?

title: 社区体检的项目与顺序
material:
Emma: I have an appointment for the health check on Tuesday. What shall I do first?
Nurse Lin: Come at seven in the morning, because the blood test must be done on an empty stomach. Then you have a light breakfast in the waiting room, and from half past eight the checks go one after another.
Emma: How long does the whole thing take?
Nurse Lin: The blood test is twenty minutes, the eye test is thirty, and the heart test is thirty. There are ten minutes' wait after each one.
Emma: That is more than two hours?
Nurse Lin: Twenty plus ten, thirty plus ten, thirty plus ten: one hour and fifty minutes from half past eight, so at twenty past ten.
Emma: Then I shall be out before eleven.
Nurse Lin: Yes, and the report is ready on Thursday at four, not before.

questions.question: What time must Emma arrive, and why?

options.A: At half past eight, because the checks start then.
options.B: At seven, because the blood test must be done on an empty stomach.
options.C: At eight, because the eye test takes thirty minutes.
options.D: At half past six, because breakfast ends at seven.

questions.question: At about what time will the three checks finish?

title: 银行换零钱与手续费
material:
Leo: Mr. Kong, I have ninety yuan in coins and I would like it in notes.
Mr. Kong: Above fifty yuan a day we charge a flat two yuan. Fifty yuan or less is free.
Leo: So I pay two yuan.
Mr. Kong: The fee is two yuan either way. Do you want the rest in notes?
Leo: I shall take ninety yuan in notes and pay the two yuan on top.
Mr. Kong: Very well. The counter closes at half past four, and it is a quarter past three now. On Friday the counter shuts at noon, so people come on Thursday.
Leo: Today is Thursday.
Mr. Kong: Then you have an hour and fifteen minutes.
Leo: Plenty. Is the small note of five yuan used here?
Mr. Kong: Yes, and one-yuan notes too. Two-yuan notes we stopped taking last year.

questions.question: How much will Leo pay to change the coins?
How much time does Leo have before the counter closes?

title: 家政阿姨上门做饭的小时费
material:
Nina: Ms. Xu, how much do you charge for cooking dinner at my home?
Ms. Xu: Forty yuan an hour, and I do not charge for the bus. Most jobs take an hour and a half and cost sixty yuan.
Nina: Our family is four. Can you come tomorrow?
Ms. Xu: Tomorrow I have another family at four, and the bus to your street takes fifty minutes, so I must leave that home at three. I can start at yours at four and finish at half past five.
Nina: Then dinner is early.
Ms. Xu: You can eat at half past five and keep the rest warm for seven. Setting the table is not charged.
Nina: What about the washing up?
Ms. Xu: Washing up takes thirty-six minutes, so that job is two hours and six minutes and costs eighty-four yuan.

questions.question: How much will Nina's family pay for tomorrow's cooking job?
How much more would the family pay if the washing up were included?

title: 宠物狗的洗澡卡
material:
Jack: Ms. Qiao, what does it cost to wash my dog?
Ms. Qiao: A single bath is sixty yuan. A card of five baths is two hundred and fifty, and it is good for twelve months from the day you buy it. A dog over thirty kilos pays ten yuan more for each bath.
Jack: Mine is twenty-two kilos, so no extra. How long is the card?
Ms. Qiao: Twelve months. One card may be used by two people in your family, but not by two dogs on the same day.
Jack: My sister has a small dog. May she use it?
Ms. Qiao: A dog under ten kilos may share your card. Yours is twenty-two kilos and hers is seven, so the card covers both of you, one dog a day.
Jack: When is the shop quiet?
Ms. Qiao: After four o'clock on Tuesdays.

questions.question: How much does one bath cost if Jack pays for each bath separately?
How much does Jack save if he uses all five baths on the card?

title: 照相馆拍证件照
material:
Emma: Mr. Sun, I need a passport photo. How much is it?
Mr. Sun: Four prints are twelve yuan. If you need six, it is sixteen. All of them are three point five by four point five centimetres, and we cut them on white.
Emma: Six, please. How long does it take?
Mr. Sun: We take the picture at once and the prints are ready in twenty minutes. We open from nine to seven, and we shut between twelve and one for lunch.
Emma: It is half past ten now. Then I can wait here?
Mr. Sun: You can, but your job goes in the morning queue, so the six prints will be ready at half past twelve, not at eleven.
Emma: Can I have them at three instead?
Mr. Sun: You can, but the afternoon queue is forty minutes long, so it would be twenty to four.

questions.question: How much will Emma pay for six prints?
If Emma comes back at three in the afternoon, about what time will she get the prints?

title: 钟表铺的学徒第一年
material: Mr. Qiao's watch shop is four steps wide and open from eight to six. He took on an apprentice last March, a boy of fifteen called Tian Yu. In the first month the boy only swept the floor and carried watches to the back room, because Mr. Qiao wanted him to hear a watch before he touched one. There are about two hundred watches in the shop and none of them is cheap; the cheapest is a thirty-yuan alarm clock, and the dearest one in the case is a five-hundred-yuan table clock that has stood on that shelf for eleven years. Tian Yu was surprised that nobody had asked about that one. Mr. Qiao said that people do not buy the dearest thing in a shop; they buy the one they can explain to their family. Now the boy changes a battery in ten minutes and a glass in twenty-five, and Mr. Qiao lets him do both alone. The shop shuts for an hour at noon and they eat at the counter. Last month Tian Yu was left alone at the counter for fifty minutes, and he wrote down the time of every customer who came in. Mr. Qiao read the list that evening and said nothing. He has said nothing about it since.

questions.question: What was Tian Yu allowed to do in his first month?

options.A: Sell watches across the counter to customers.
options.B: Sweep the floor and carry watches to the back room.
options.C: Change the glass in a watch by himself.
options.D: Read the price list aloud to the customers in the shop.

questions.question: How much does the dearest watch in the shop cost?
How long does it take Tian Yu to change a glass now?
What did Mr. Qiao do after he read the list that evening?

options.A: He asked Tian Yu to write the list again.
options.B: He raised the prices in the shop.
options.C: He said nothing, and has said nothing since.
options.D: He told Tian Yu to stop writing down the time.

questions.question: What is the passage mainly about?

options.A: Why a small watch shop never sells its dearest watch.
options.B: How a boy of fifteen learned to be a watchmaker.
options.C: What Mr. Qiao says about the way people choose a watch.
options.D: How many watches there are in a shop four steps wide.

title: 屋顶上的三箱蜜蜂
material: Fang Yi keeps bees on the roof of a twelve-storey block for six summers. Her father started with one box; she has three, and the third is the one that earns the money. A hive needs about four square metres of clear air around it, and the roof of a lift machine room is the only flat place far enough from the laundry lines. She goes up at six in the morning, before the heat, and again at nine at night. In between she works in an office eleven floors down. She never opens a box on a day when the wind is over level three, and she has lost two swarms that way. Honey is taken once a year, in the last week of July. That year she pulled ninety kilograms from the three boxes. Her father used to say that honey is not made by the bees but by the weather, and Fang Yi now writes the weather down before the honey. The neighbours complained once, in the second year, and she gave the first floor two jars. Now there is a waiting list, and the list has eleven names on it. The third box is the one that overwinters well; the other two are hers to take or leave.

questions.question: Why does Fang Yi choose the roof of the lift machine room?

options.A: Because the laundry lines there are the driest.
options.B: Because the lift machine room is the only place with water.
options.C: Because it is the only flat place with enough clear air.
options.D: Because the other roofs are too near the office windows.

questions.question: When does Fang Yi open the boxes?

options.A: At six in the morning and again at nine at night.
options.B: Only at nine at night, never in the morning.
options.C: At six in the morning only, well before the summer heat.
options.D: At any time when the wind is under level three.

questions.question: What happened when the wind was over level three?

options.A: The neighbours complained about the bees.
options.B: The office asked her to stop opening boxes.
options.C: She wrote the weather instead of the honey.

questions.question: How many names are on the waiting list?
What is the passage mainly about?

options.A: Why neighbours once complained about bees on a roof.
options.B: How ninety kilograms of honey is taken in the last week.
options.C: How one young woman keeps three bee boxes on a roof.
options.D: What her father said about weather and honey.

title: 灯塔看守人的最后一个冬天
material: Shen Hai has kept the light at Cape Yi for thirty-one years, and this winter is his last. The light is automated now, and the relay room runs on a timer, so a keeper is only needed to check the lens, cut the weeds off the path and keep a written record. His record this year has four lines a day: the hour the lamp was checked, the weather, the number of birds on the rocks, and the boats. In the last ten years he has written about fourteen thousand lines. He keeps the oldest book in a drawer and the newest one on the desk, because a book that is used is hard to read. Three boats a week still call in, mostly fishing boats, and he writes down each name. Two winters ago he began writing a fourth kind of line, the name of the student who came up with him, and last winter four students did. In January the fog came for eleven days and the record for those days says the same thing eleven times. He will not say whether that is the job he liked or the job he did not.
